reward: Implantul Inherent Implants 'Noble' Hull Upgrades HG-1008 și 2 425mm 'Popper' Railgun ca bonus în 8 ore și 20 de minute.
Inherent Implants 'Noble' Hull Upgrades HG-1008 and 2 425mm 'Popper' Railguns as a bonus within 8 hours 20 minutes.
steps: Naveta cade din Shuttle Storage Silo, în camera Supply Depot. Apare o dată pe zi.
The shuttle drops from the Shuttle Storage Silo in the Supply Depot room. It spawns once a day.
Mai simplu: o cumperi din piața locală, unde e ieftină.
Simpler: buy it on the local market, where it is cheap.
O predai agentului.
Hand it in.
m.brief:
Now that I've disabled the explosive device preventing me from leaving this place, it's time to make my getaway. I managed to forge some documents, using the prison's central computer, that should allow me to escape the Guristas installation unharmed, but they require that I fly a Guristas Shuttle. The documents say I am being moved to another installation in Okkelen, this should allow me to leave unharmed. Although I'm no expert on Caldari ships, I've had some basic training that should be adequate to fly those shuttles.

I know you're probably eager to bring me along in your own ship, , but I'd rather not risk your life needlessly, nor my own. This plan of mine is pretty much fool proof, as long as you can get the shuttle here in time. I don't know how you managed to get in here before, but I'm sure you can do it again.

You'll find a Guristas shuttle in their supply depot within this complex, to get past the acceleration gate you'll need a Guristas Crystal Tag. Once you've brought it here I'll reward you generously.

story: Akemon e prizonier Guristas în Contested Guristas Outrider Post, cu o bombă implantată în cap. Agentul aparține Caldari Navy, cu standing cerut 7,5.
Akemon is a Guristas prisoner in the Contested Guristas Outrider Post, with a bomb implanted in the head. The agent belongs to the Caldari Navy and needs 7.5 standing.

goal: Aduci Shady Acres Deed (0,1 m³), actul de proprietate furat.
Bring the stolen Shady Acres Deed (0.1 m³).
reward: 400 Caldari Navy Antimatter Charge L.
400 Caldari Navy Antimatter Charge L.
steps: Mergi în Contested Caldari Mining Facilities - Contested Plagioclase Field.
Go to Contested Caldari Mining Facilities - Contested Plagioclase Field.
Actul cade rar de la Black Mask Bandits, așa că s-ar putea să repeți site-ul.
The deed rarely drops from Black Mask Bandits, so you may need to repeat the site.
Tot aici omori Sanku Pansya și îi păstrezi capul pentru ultima misiune.
Kill Sanku Pansya here too and keep the head for the last mission.
m.brief:
Are you settling here in the Shady Acres as well? No? Lucky for you. My regiment retired last year after decades with the Navy. Our retirement gift was a piece of land in the Shady Acres. I can see the wisdom in it from the State's point of view; who are better suited to settle a bandit-infested territory than a group of Navy veterans? But that doesn't mean I have to like it. I was hoping that after a lifelong service they would cut me a little slack in my final days. But if life in the Navy has taught me anything it is never to give up. 
 
I'm the first of my regiment to arrive here, the others will arrive in the next few weeks. I'm aiming to make this place a little friendlier for their arrival than it was for me. A few days after I arrived this guy came along claiming he was a representative for the Shady Acres development firm. He even had credentials to back up his claim and everything. In my naivety I lent him the deed to my land here. He took it and I haven't seen him since. I've heard rumors that he's hanging out in the old mining facility over in Friggi system. Along with a lot of other bandits, I understand. All I can tell you is that he was a member of the black mask gang, so concentrate your search on them. 
 
I'm stuck here guarding my possessions, this territory is much too dangerous for me to leave them alone for even an hour. I would be much obliged if you could get my deed back. So much so that I would be willing to give you some navy issue ammo for your trouble.

goal: Aduci Rifles (2 m³) de la bandiții care se înarmează.
Bring Rifles (2 m³) from the bandits arming themselves.
reward: 1.000 Scourge Torpedo.
1,000 Scourge Torpedoes.
tip: Armele nu se pot cumpăra pe contracte. Trebuie să faci tu site-ul.
The rifles cannot be bought on contracts. You must run the site yourself.
steps: Site-ul e un complex deadspace aleatoriu în lowsec.
The site is a random deadspace complex in lowsec.
Distrugi trei nave de luptă. Ultima lasă armele într-un container.
Destroy three battleships. The last one drops the rifles in a container.
Le duci agentului.
Take them to the agent.
m.brief:
The bandits here in Ihakana aren't too happy with all these Caldari settlers coming here. Who can blame them? This constellation has been their little playground for years and now suddenly the State is arriving in force, effectively putting the bandits in a straight jacket. But they're planning something big, I can feel it in my bones. Call it an old warhorse's instinct, if you will.

I've pulled some strings with some friends in the Navy. One of them gave me the coordinates for a location favored by the local bandits for smuggling. And from another I got reliable news that a large shipment of armaments is due to be smuggled into the system. Even an old army idiot like me can put two and two together. The arms dealers are using the place as a rendezvous and if we could take them out in a lightning strike it will safe us all a lot of grief down the road.

Now, be careful. These bandits are not taking any chances, so don't expect them to be sitting in some indies waiting to be taken out. From past experience with these guys they're probably using battleships as smuggling vessels. I'm giving you some top-notch torpedoes as a reward for this mission, that should be incentive enough for you to round up a posse and take these guys down.

goal: O eliberezi pe Nakyo Fukoren (1 m³), logodnica agentului.
Rescue Nakyo Fukoren (1 m³), the agent's fiancée.
reward: 'Deuce' Co-Processor I BPC.
'Deuce' Co-Processor I BPC.
steps: Mergi în complexul aleatoriu din Ihakana (lowsec).
Go to the random complex in Ihakana (lowsec).
Omori toate gărzile. Nakyo e în Bandit Jail, pe asteroidul din centru.
Kill all guards. Nakyo is in the Bandit Jail on the central asteroid.
Dacă nu vezi închisoarea, pornește toate brackets sau filtrul General - All.
If you cannot see the jail, enable all brackets or the General - All overview filter.
O duci pe Nakyo agentului.
Bring Nakyo to the agent.
m.brief:
It seems these cursed bandits are more clever than I gave them credit for. They've become aware of my attempts to weaken them and are paying back in kind. Not since I was serving against the Anarchists way back when have I encountered such ruthlessness. My fiancé, Nakyo Fukoren, was making her way out here on my bequest. We've been looking forward to finally being able to settle down and start a family together. But she was ambushed on the way and kidnapped. 
 
She's being held in a secret prison facility operated by the local bandits. I called in all the favors owed to me to get this information, but I don't care. Nakyo is everything to me. I'm even willing to offer you all my life savings as a reward if you can get her back to me. And if you get her back to me within the hour I'll even throw in a very rare BPC. 
 
The jail she's being kept in is a high-security one, with stasis cells to make any break out attempts impossible. But those stasis cells are going to help us to set her free after all. They can withstand massive explosions, even the destruction of the jail itself. And that's exactly what I want you to do. Once you've blown up the prison, the stasis field around the cells will quickly run out of its internal power batteries. Then you'll be able to pick Nakyo up, but you'll have to act quickly because she will be exposed in space once the stasis field goes down. Please hurry, , I could never forgive myself if something happened to her.

goal: Aduci Pansya's Head (0,1 m³), răzbunarea agentului.
Bring Pansya's Head (0.1 m³), the agent's revenge.
reward: 'High Noon' Thermal Shield Amplifier BPC.
'High Noon' Thermal Shield Amplifier BPC.
steps: Sanku Pansya e în Contested Caldari Mining Facilities - Contested Plagioclase Field, în Friggi.
Sanku Pansya is in Contested Caldari Mining Facilities - Contested Plagioclase Field, Friggi.
Dacă l-ai luat deja la prima misiune, doar îl predai.
If you already took it during the first mission, just hand it in.
m.brief:
Beautiful! I'm totally devastated, . Those filthy bandits ravished my beautiful Nakyo while she was in their hands. Now she is but a broken shell, always breaking down in sobs and flinching every time I try to touch her. It's unbearable. I'm not usually a vengeful man, but these beasts went too far. I want you to be my avenging angel. Excuse me for sounding so melodramatic, it's my grief talking. 
 
I know the name of the man that gave the orders for the kidnapping and mistreatment of my fiancé, one Sanku Pansya. He and his gang hang out in the contested mining facility over in Friggi system, I'm sure you know where to find it. I want that son of a gun dead. Bring me his head as proof that his evil doings have been avenged. You will receive a great reward for doing this, a blueprint copy I intended to pass down to my first born son. I fear he may never be conceived now.

story: Chichiro e un veteran al Marinei care s-a retras cu regimentul în Shady Acres, un teritoriu plin de bandiți.
Chichiro is a Navy veteran who retired with the regiment to Shady Acres, a bandit-infested territory.

goal: Aduci 30 Guristas Gold Tag (3 m³) și primești un BPC de navă Navy.
Bring 30 Guristas Gold Tags (3 m³) and get a Navy ship BPC.
reward: Caracal Navy Issue BPC (2 rulări, ME 20, TE 8).
Caracal Navy Issue BPC (2 runs, ME 20, TE 8).
tip: Misiunea se poate repeta.
This mission can be repeated.
steps: Insignele cad de la Guristas sau le cumperi din piață.
The tags drop from Guristas or you buy them on the market.
Agentul stă la poarta din Friggi și cere standing 9,2 cu Caldari State.
The agent is at the Friggi gate and needs 9.2 Caldari State standing.
Predai insignele.
Hand in the tags.
m.brief:
We have a policy here within the Caldari State that our more prominent members fly a suitable ship according to their status, both to give them an edge during combat and to uphold our image, especially within our borders. We have recently decided to extend this benefit to mercenaries or freelancers employed by us that have shown admirable bravery and skill in the field, or earned the right through countless hours of dedicated service to our corporations.

As you undoubtedly already know I have been assigned the task of allocating these ships to their deserved owners. After looking at your record, we decided that you, , are worthy of such an honor. There is just one catch, since you aren't an official member we need something in exchange for this gift. Cough up 30 x Guristas Gold Tag and the Caracal Navy Issue Blueprint is yours.
 
I‘ll be expecting those tags soon. With your track record, I‘m sure I won‘t be disappointed.

goal: Distrugi dronele care păzesc depozitul și aduci containerele sigilate (200 m³).
Destroy the drones guarding the storage bin and bring the sealed containers (200 m³).
reward: Implantul Eifyr and Co. 'Alchemist' Neurotoxin Control NC-903, plus 5 mil. ISK bonus în 3 ore.
Eifyr and Co. 'Alchemist' Neurotoxin Control NC-903 implant, plus a 5M ISK bonus within 3 hours.
steps: Site-ul are restricții de mărime a navei.
The site has ship size restrictions.
Omori Drone Kamikaze de la distanță: explodează cu daune pe zonă și îți distrug dronele mici.
Kill the Drone Kamikazes at range: they explode with area damage and wipe out light drones.
Al doilea val apare peste container, cu 10 sentry tower. Nu poți lua containerul până nu omori tot.
The second wave spawns on the container with 10 sentry towers. You cannot scoop it until everything is dead.
Duci containerele agentului.
Take the containers to the agent.
m.brief:
Ok, just promise you won't laugh. You see, before I came here I was a computer programmer. I specialized in creating and maintaining artificial intelligence for Kaalakiota, probes and drones and that sort of stuff. Well after I got here, I realized I needed some heavy duty protection considering the relative lawlessness of this place, and the mercs here were just way too expensive.

So I used my expertise to set up a self-maintaining drone facility, which provided me with enough backup to safely harvest the gas fields around here. It worked like a charm to begin with ... until hardware failure wiped out the secret password I've been using to access the mother-drone computer's mainframe.

Now I can't even get into my own home! I've been sitting around here for days but none of these good-for-nothing mercs have the guts to face my drones. Maybe you've got it in you?

Anyway first I want my stash of extracted gas chemicals. You'll find a few containers full of it in my storage facility. I'll give you the coordinates, all you have to do is warp there, take out the drones guarding the stash, loot it, and bring it back here.

goal: Distrugi Drone Creation Compound, calculatorul-mamă al dronelor.
Destroy the Drone Creation Compound, the drones' mother computer.
reward: Standing la Caldari State, Caldari Navy Dual 250mm Railgun și 10,5 mil. ISK bonus în 3 ore.
Caldari State standing, a Caldari Navy Dual 250mm Railgun and a 10.5M ISK bonus within 3 hours.
steps: Agentul deschide poarta de accelerare spre buzunarul vecin.
The agent opens the acceleration gate to the next pocket.
Treci prin prima cameră, apoi în Drone Manufacturing Outpost.
Go through the first room, then into the Drone Manufacturing Outpost.
Distrugi structura. Uneori lasă Zainou 'Deadeye' Missile Bombardment MB-705 și Gas Cloud Harvester I.
Destroy the structure. It sometimes drops a Zainou 'Deadeye' Missile Bombardment MB-705 and a Gas Cloud Harvester I.
m.brief:
Yes, that is correct. I need you to clean up the mess I left behind, before things spiral out of control. I don't want to have any civilian deaths on my hands. To do this, the drone mother-computer must be taken care of. It is located near the place I just sent you. I have opened the acceleration gate leading into an adjacent deadspace pocket, which is where you'll find the target. Destroy it and return to me.

After accepting- Don't come back until the Drone Creation Compound has been destroyed, that's where the drone mother-computer is stored.

story: Erakki a programat drone de pază, dar inteligența artificială a luat-o razna și acum dronele construiesc altele.
Erakki programmed guard drones, but the AI went rogue and the drones now build more of themselves.

goal: Aduci Gatti's DNA (0,1 m³).
Bring Gatti's DNA (0.1 m³).
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Mergi în centura de asteroizi din misiune și distrugi nava de luptă a lui Gatti.
Go to the asteroid belt in the mission and destroy Gatti's battleship.
Iei ADN-ul din epavă și îl duci agentului.
Loot the DNA and take it to the agent.
m.brief:
Those bastards, the Zhara have gone over the line this time. First they offered to buy me out, then when I refused they sent in some of their goons to 'convince' me to change my mind. When that failed Gatti himself flew in on his blasted battleship and drove me out with force. And to top it all, the corrupt security forces won't do anything! That asteroid belt is mine, I tell you, MINE!

If you want to help me out, then you gotta prove yourself by killing Gatti. You'll find him camping the Otomainen XIII asteroid belt. He's a wealthy land-owner who has close ties with the Kazka Bandits. The Zhara family are very powerful in these parts, so I doubt killing Gatti will be enough to end this matter, but it's a start. Once you've finished the job, bring me evidence of his demise and I'll give you your reward.

m.t: Hotaru's Dilemma - Empty The Load (2 of 4)
goal: Duci 10.000 Veldspar (1.000 m³) la Ihakana VIII - Moon 6.
Carry 10,000 Veldspar (1,000 m³) to Ihakana VIII - Moon 6.
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Ihakana e lowsec. Un industrial cu 1.000 m³ liberi, zburat atent, e de ajuns.
Ihakana is lowsec. An industrial with 1,000 m³ free, flown carefully, is enough.
Predai minereul la destinație.
Deliver the ore.
m.brief:
Now what I need you to do is deliver a batch of veldspar ore to a location not far from here. I was supposed to drop off the batch there for one of my clients, but Gatti's attack 'complicated' matters. I dare not leave my current location, if an agent of the Zhara family or Kazka Bandits spots me, I'm done for.

I managed to smuggle the ore out of the asteroid belt during my escape, so as long as you can bring an industrial over here then you're all set to go.

m.t: Hotaru's Dilemma - Break The Blockade (3 of 4)
goal: Spargi blocada Kazka din jurul Otomainen XI și aduci Pata Wakiro's DNA (0,1 m³).
Break the Kazka blockade around Otomainen XI and bring Pata Wakiro's DNA (0.1 m³).
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Mergi la blocada din jurul planetei Otomainen XI.
Go to the blockade around planet Otomainen XI.
Distrugi nava lui Pata Wakiro și iei ADN-ul.
Destroy Pata Wakiro's ship and loot the DNA.
Îl duci agentului.
Take it to the agent.
m.brief:
I just received a transmission from my family on Otomainen XI, apparently the Kazka Bandits have erected a blockade at key areas around the planet to prevent anyone associated with me to leave or enter in one piece. Of course the local authorities haven't lifted a finger yet to stop these pirates from going along with their business, since XI is so sparsely populated and the Kazka Bandits have close ties to some of the corrupt officials here.

Since the planet is not technically habitable, my family has to live inside an enclosed bio dome, and we are totally dependent on supply convoys to survive. We have a little agriculture going on down there inside the dome, but not enough to feed the entire population. I'm afraid that if the Kazka become desperate, they might cut off our food supply and force the mayor to order my family to leave. That would surely be their death sentence.

The blockade is comprised of Kazka thugs, lead by one of their leaders, Pata Wakori. Kill their leader, and I'm sure you'll kill the blockade.

The deadpsace pocket is hidden from passive sensors. You will need to use probes to scan down the Kazka blockade. Take care of them quickly will you, time is of the essence here.

goal: Aduci 21 Moa Parts (630 m³) de la Otsela VI - Moon 13 - Ishukone Corporation Factory.
Bring 21 Moa Parts (630 m³) from Otsela VI - Moon 13 - Ishukone Corporation Factory.
reward: ISK, un BPC storyline și standing la Caldari State.
ISK, a storyline BPC and Caldari State standing.
steps: Briefingul spune Otanuomi, dar piesele se ridică din Otsela.
The briefing says Otanuomi, but the parts are picked up in Otsela.
Le aduci agentului.
Bring them to the agent.
m.brief:
Now for your final task, I need you to collect the parts for my new Moa cruiser. Once it has been assembled, I'll be ready to take on the remnants of those goons the Zhara sent to wreck havoc in my asteroid belt. With Gatti assassinated, I have no fear of those pirates anymore.

You'll find the crates containing the parts in Otanuomi IV - Moon 4 - Ishukone Corporation Factory, where I bought them off an old junk collector. I need them transferred to my workshop here in the Red Rock Outpost immediately.

You've been of enormous assistance so far, -name, so you fully deserve the generous reward I have in store for you when this job is done.

story: Familia pirată Zhara l-a alungat pe Hotaru din propria centură de asteroizi. Gatti Zhara a venit chiar cu nava de luptă.
The Zhara pirate family drove Hotaru out of their own asteroid belt. Gatti Zhara came in person with a battleship.

goal: Aduci 30 Guristas Silver Tag (3 m³) și primești un BPC de navă Navy.
Bring 30 Guristas Silver Tags (3 m³) and get a Navy ship BPC.
reward: Un BPC de navă Navy Issue.
A Navy Issue ship BPC.
tip: Misiunea se poate repeta.
This mission can be repeated.
steps: Insignele cad de la Guristas sau le cumperi din piață.
The tags drop from Guristas or you buy them on the market.
Agentul stă la poarta din Friggi și cere standing 8,5 cu Caldari State.
The agent is at the Friggi gate and needs 8.5 Caldari State standing.
Predai insignele.
Hand in the tags.
m.brief:
We have a policy here within the Caldari State that our more prominent members fly a suitable ship according to their status, both to give them an edge during combat and to uphold our image, especially within our borders. We have recently decided to extend this benefit to mercenaries or freelancers employed by us that have shown admirable bravery and skill in the field, or earned the right through countless hours of dedicated service to our corporations. 
 
As you undoubtedly already know I have been assigned the task of allocating these ships to their deserved owners. After looking at your record, we decided that you, ―name‖, are worthy of such an honor. There is just one catch, since you aren't an official member we need something in exchange for this gift. Cough up 30 x Guristas Silver Tag and the Caldari Navy Hookbill Blueprint is yours. 
 
I‘ll be expecting those tags soon. With your track record, I‘m sure I won‘t be disappointed.

goal: Duci mesajul lui Lauka la cartierul general Guristas din 1QH-0K.
Deliver Lauka's message to the Guristas headquarters in 1QH-0K.
reward: Caldari Navy Ballistic Control System, plus 800.000 ISK bonus în 2 ore.
Caldari Navy Ballistic Control System, plus an 800,000 ISK bonus within 2 hours.
steps: 1QH-0K e nullsec. Site-ul are restricții de mărime a navei.
1QH-0K is nullsec. The site has ship size restrictions.
Misiunea e gata imediat ce liderii resping mesajul. Poți pleca fără să lupți dacă nu ești blocat.
The mission completes as soon as the leaders reject the message. You can leave without fighting if you are not pointed.
Dacă rămâi, te atacă, iar după un timp vine al doilea val.
If you stay, they attack, and after a while a second wave arrives.
m.brief:
Your observation is correct. And I've been watching you, , for a while now, and you seem to fit the criteria I've been looking for.

Now I have a task for you that may prove to be extremely dangerous. As you probably know already we've had a long standing quarrel with the Guristas forces in 09-4XW. And it's really showing a toll on the settlers here. But I want to propose a truce, and I want you to be the one that brings them the offer. I will supply you a bookmark to the Guristas Headquarters in 1QH-0K, all you have to do is warp in there and bring it to their leaders.

goal: Aduci Dread Guristas Diamond Tag (0,1 m³) din comandamentul Guristas din 1QH-0K.
Bring the Dread Guristas Diamond Tag (0.1 m³) from the Guristas high command in 1QH-0K.
reward: Cybernetic Subprocessor - Improved și Eifyr and Co. 'Alchemist' Neurotoxin Control NC-903 ca bonus în 2 ore și 40 de minute.
Cybernetic Subprocessor - Improved and Eifyr and Co. 'Alchemist' Neurotoxin Control NC-903 as a bonus within 2 hours 40 minutes.
steps: Sunt patru camere. Poarta se deschide doar după ce omori tot din cameră.
There are four rooms. Each gate opens only after you kill everything in the room.
În camera 3, după ce moare căpitanul, apar sentry guns ascunse.
In room 3, after the captain dies, cloaked sentry guns appear.
În camera 4 nu distruge turelele: sunt capcane și explodează peste tine. La jumătate din armura stației apare o escadrilă nouă.
In room 4 do not destroy the sentries: they are booby-trapped and blow up on you. At half station armor a new squadron launches.
Misiunea e gata când moare Guristas War Installation.
The mission completes when the Guristas War Installation dies.
m.brief:
You are, huh. Unfortunately there is only one way to truly stop the Guristas from enslaving us, at least temporarily. And that is to annihilate their high command in 1QH-0K. I know it sounds foolhardy and it probably is, but it's the only way ... if we don't strike them down at the root they will just keep on coming.
I'm probably getting way ahead of myself here, I really can't ask you to try something insane like assault their most powerful stronghold in the entire constellation. But if you do, I will give you a very nice reward for the insignia from their leader.

story: Coloniștii din Pioneer's Sanctuary sunt hărțuiți de Guristas din 09-4XW. Lauka încearcă întâi un armistițiu, apoi lovește la rădăcină.
The settlers in Pioneer's Sanctuary are harassed by the Guristas in 09-4XW. Lauka first tries a truce, then strikes at the root.

goal: Cureți avanpostul Guristas de lângă poarta spre câmpul de gaze.
Clear the Guristas outpost near the gate to the gas field.
reward: Gas Cloud Harvester I, plus 5 mil. ISK bonus în 2 ore.
Gas Cloud Harvester I, plus a 5M ISK bonus within 2 hours.
steps: Site-ul are restricții de mărime a navei și o singură cameră.
The site has ship size restrictions and a single room.
Valurile vin unul după altul. Misiunea e gata când mor toți inamicii.
Waves arrive one after another. The mission completes when all enemies are dead.
m.brief: I'm in a bit of a dilemma at the moment. I managed to find an area of deadspace filled with lucrative gas clouds, but as always there was a catch. The Guristas had apparently erected an outpost next to an acceleration gate leading directly into the deadspace pocket containing the clouds. I haven't detected any signs of them actually harvesting the gas, but I dare not try to enter the area with them nearby. Could you please remove their presence for me?

goal: Aduci Nuomo's Scanner Data (0,1 m³) de la scanerul din I1-BE8.
Bring Nuomo's Scanner Data (0.1 m³) from the scanner in I1-BE8.
reward: Caldari Navy Ballistic Control System, plus 10 mil. ISK bonus în 2 ore.
Caldari Navy Ballistic Control System, plus a 10M ISK bonus within 2 hours.
steps: I1-BE8 e nullsec. Pirații pândesc lângă scaner.
I1-BE8 is nullsec. Pirates are waiting near the scanner.
Omori toți inamicii. Când ataci crucișătorul, apar întăriri.
Kill all enemies. Reinforcements arrive when you attack the cruiser.
Iei datele din Nuomo's Scanner și le duci agentului.
Take the data from Nuomo's Scanner and bring it to the agent.
m.brief: Hmmm, yes there is one more thing. I have a long range scanner in I1-BE8 which I use to look for promising sites which may harbor harvestable gas clouds. The problem is I'm afraid of going back there and retrieving the data, the last time I tried I noticed a couple pirates nearby who I thought might be waiting in ambush. Anyway I don't want to take any chances, but if you're willing then I'll pay you for getting me the data. This is an important mission, which will have significant impact on your faction standings.

story: Nuomo a găsit un câmp de gaze valoros, dar Guristas au un avanpost chiar la poarta de intrare.
Nuomo found a valuable gas field, but the Guristas have an outpost right at the entrance gate.

goal: Distrugi forța de invazie Guristas, care vine în valuri.
Destroy the Guristas invasion force, which arrives in waves.
reward: Neurotoxin Recovery, plus 5 mil. ISK bonus în 3 ore.
Neurotoxin Recovery, plus a 5M ISK bonus within 3 hours.
steps: Site-ul are restricții de mărime a navei și o singură cameră.
The site has ship size restrictions and a single room.
Fiecare val are un Pith Terror Strategist, de fapt o navă mai mare deghizată.
Each wave has a Pith Terror Strategist, actually a bigger ship in disguise.
Varianta rapidă: omori doar Terror Strategist din fiecare val. Misiunea e gata la cel din valul 6.
Quick route: kill only the Terror Strategist in each wave. The mission completes with the one in wave 6.
m.brief: Have I got any? Are you mad? I've been sitting here all day looking for contractors with some combat experience. Now I need someone I can rely on for this job, and I have to say I'm impressed with the way you've dealt with some of your previous assignments for Caldari agents. So maybe you're cut out for this ... Anyway, I've been informed that a few gangs of Guristas scoundrels have decided to attempt a full scale assault on our little town here. Inside sources tell me that they are not working for the core Guristas leadership in 09-4XW, so they won't be as deadly and organized as I first feared. But they're still a major threat, and as such I need someone to take care of 'em. If you can do the job, in other words take 'em out before they reach Pioneer's Sanctuary, then I'll reward you generously. It so happens that I know where one of their stopping points will be, I will give you the coordinates of course.

goal: Distrugi Guristas Relay Station din ZH3-BS.
Destroy the Guristas Relay Station in ZH3-BS.
reward: Caldari Navy Co-Processor, plus 10,5 mil. ISK bonus în 3 ore.
Caldari Navy Co-Processor, plus a 10.5M ISK bonus within 3 hours.
steps: ZH3-BS e nullsec. Sunt două camere cu mai multe valuri.
ZH3-BS is nullsec. There are two rooms with several waves.
În camera 2 ataci stația. Apar întăriri la 80% scut și la 25% structură.
In room 2 attack the station. Reinforcements appear at 80% shield and 25% structure.
Misiunea e gata când cade stația.
The mission completes when the station goes down.
m.brief: Now I'd like you to target a Guristas Relay Station in ZH3-BS which has been transmitting orders to dozens of pirate gangs in 09-4XW. They're the top dogs in this system, and get their information directly from the Guristas high command. By taking them out we will be dealing a serious blow to their plans. I will give you the coordinates, of course. This is an important mission, which will have significant impact on your faction standings.

story: Bandele Guristas pregătesc un atac asupra Pioneer's Sanctuary. Oduma îi vrea opriți înainte să ajungă.
Guristas gangs are preparing to attack Pioneer's Sanctuary. Oduma wants them stopped before they arrive.

m.t: Cattle Thieves - Brigands at Large (1 of 3)
goal: Recuperezi 240 Cattle (240 m³) de la bandiți.
Recover 240 Cattle (240 m³) from the bandits.
reward: ISK.
ISK.
tip: Strânge tot loot-ul: primești în jur de 16 Bandit, 18 Desperado, 15 Gunslinger, 8 Marauder și 20 Outlaw Spur, utile la alte misiuni COSMOS.
Loot everything: you get about 16 Bandit, 18 Desperado, 15 Gunslinger, 8 Marauder and 20 Outlaw Spurs, useful for other COSMOS missions.
steps: Prima poartă cere un Desperado Spur în cargo.
The first gate needs one Desperado Spur in cargo.
Buzunarul 1: nimeni nu atacă la sosire. Buzunarul 2: atacă grupul 1. Buzunarul 3: liniște.
Pocket 1: no aggro on arrival. Pocket 2: group 1 aggroes. Pocket 3: quiet.
În buzunarul 4 atacă toți. Ultima navă distrusă lasă vitele.
In pocket 4 everyone aggroes. The last ship destroyed drops the cattle.
m.brief:
It so happens that the School of Applied Knowledge ordered a very large shipment of cattle to their station here in Sakkikainen. I was given the job after losing a bet with one of my co-workers ― as you might expect, Okkelen is one of the least popular constellations within the State for delivery people like me. It's simply swarming with pirates and other scum. 

Needless to say, once I arrived through the stargate, I was immediately beset by pirates camping the other side of the gate. I hit my microwarpdrive and almost made it, but they managed to warp scramble me at the last moment. And of course my darned escort team fled like a bunch of pansies at the first sight of combat! So I had no choice but to eject my cargo. It was either that or death, and I'll be damned before I commit suicide in the name of those corporate pigs! 

Anyway, you now know my dilemma, and my question is simple: Will you help me get my cattle back!? I'm in no position to do it myself, obviously, and I'd rather not return home empty-handed. You certainly look like someone who has some combat experience... so if you're up to it, then I'll give you directions to the bandit outpost where I believe they are keeping my cattle.

m.t: Cattle Thieves - Making Ends Meet (2 of 3)
goal: Aduci 2.600 Cattle (2.600 m³) de la Kiainti IX - Moon 8 - Prompt Delivery Storage.
Bring 2,600 Cattle (2,600 m³) from Kiainti IX - Moon 8 - Prompt Delivery Storage.
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Ruta scurtă trece prin lowsec. Există și o rută mai lungă, doar prin highsec.
The short route goes through lowsec. A longer highsec-only route exists.
Îți trebuie un industrial cu 2.600 m³ liberi.
You need an industrial with 2,600 m³ free.
m.brief: Unfortunately, the cattle you retrieved from the pirates in your last mission are insufficient. In fact, I don't think the School of Applied Knowledge will even bother accepting such a low quantity of them; I need 2600 more units to complete the shipment. I'd like you to help me make ends meet: I've contacted my colleagues at Kiainti IX - Moon 8 - Prompt Delivery Storage, and they have the cattle I need. If you could pick up those cattle and deliver them to Sakkikainen VI - Moon 8 - School of Applied Knowledge, I would be extremely grateful.

m.t: Cattle Thieves - Revenge Is Sweet (3 of 3)
goal: Aduci Loki's DNA (0,1 m³), de la șeful bandei care a furat vitele.
Bring Loki's DNA (0.1 m³) from the leader of the gang that stole the cattle.
reward: ISK, un BPC storyline și standing la Caldari State.
ISK, a storyline BPC and Caldari State standing.
steps: Loki Machedo e în Contested Guristas Outrider Post - Prison Facility.
Loki Machedo is in Contested Guristas Outrider Post - Prison Facility.
Distrugi nava de luptă a lui Loki și iei ADN-ul.
Destroy Loki's battleship and loot the DNA.
Îl duci agentului.
Take it to the agent.
m.brief:
Damn that Loki Machedo. He headed up the bandit gang that stole my cattle and delayed me by many days. I'll probably get demoted for this! I will have my revenge. 

I heard he wasn't at the bandit site where you found some of the cattle, so he must still be at large. I know a guy, Midoki Urigamu, who is surprisingly knowledgeable about the Guristas pirates. He told me that Loki works as a prison guard in the Guristas Outrider Post in Otomainen. So you might find him in the Prison Facility, as long as he's on duty and not raiding defenseless convoys... 

I'll give you everything I have in exchange for proof that he's dead.

story: Ratan a pierdut un pariu și a primit livrarea de vite spre School of Applied Knowledge. Bandiții i-au furat transportul.
Ratan lost a bet and got the cattle delivery to the School of Applied Knowledge. Bandits stole the shipment.

m.t: Station In Crisis - Caldari Troublemakers (1 of 3)
goal: Aduci 60 Bandit Spur (6 m³).
Bring 60 Bandit Spurs (6 m³).
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Briefingul spune Ihakana (lowsec), dar pintenii cad și în site-uri highsec, de exemplu Contested Kazka Headquarters.
The briefing says Ihakana (lowsec), but the spurs also drop in highsec sites such as Contested Kazka Headquarters.
Îi predai agentului.
Hand them in.
m.brief:
I'm so glad to see you ―name‖. I had almost given up hope on finding a skilled mercenary to do some dangerous work for Lai Dai Corporation. I've looked everywhere in this run-down system but you're the first ray of hope that I've encountered so far.

We have a serious problem on our hands at the State And Region Bank in Ihakana. A gang of hooligans has been terrorizing passersby in the area, allegedly causing damage to our property and pestering our customers. We haven't been able to pin anything major on them yet, but our patience has worn out. I will pay you a large sum of ISK if you take care of these pests yourself, before they do any serious harm.

The deadspace pocket is hidden from passive sensors. You will need to use probes to scan down the Kazka blockade.

m.t: Station In Crisis - Militia Equipment (2 of 3)
goal: Duci 2.000 Pistols (4.000 m³) la Ihakana VI - State and Region Bank Depository.
Carry 2,000 Pistols (4,000 m³) to Ihakana VI - State and Region Bank Depository.
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Ridici pistoalele dintr-o stație NPC din Vouskiaho sau Vasala.
Pick up the pistols from an NPC station in Vouskiaho or Vasala.
Îți trebuie un industrial cu 4.000 m³ liberi. Ihakana e lowsec, deci zboară atent.
You need an industrial with 4,000 m³ free. Ihakana is lowsec, so fly carefully.
m.brief:
Because of the volatile situation here in Ihakana, we've been planning on funding a local militia to participate in the defenses of our station. CONCORD and the State have a very loose hold on the entire constellation, and Ihakana is no exception. We can't afford to ask them for any favors, we have to take matters into our own hands.

Because funding for our project here is limited, we've had to make due with cheap small arms, aka pistols. I've been promised a shipment of them at Vouskiaho III - Genolution Biotech Production, if you could be so kind as to transport them to the S.R.B. station in this system I would be very grateful.

m.t: Station In Crisis - Hooligan Gang Leaders (3 of 3)
goal: Aduci 25 Gunslinger Spur (2,5 m³) de la liderii bandei.
Bring 25 Gunslinger Spurs (2.5 m³) from the gang leaders.
reward: Large 'Sheriff' Shield Extender BPC (2 rulări), Ocular Filter - Standard și standing la Caldari State.
Large 'Sheriff' Shield Extender BPC (2 runs), Ocular Filter - Standard and Caldari State standing.
steps: Pintenii cad și în site-uri highsec, de exemplu Contested Caldari Mining Facilities.
The spurs also drop in highsec sites such as Contested Caldari Mining Facilities.
Îi predai agentului.
Hand them in.
m.brief:
Unfortunately your previous assignment for me was not a complete success. I was wrong about the bandits abandoning their plans of causing havoc near the State and Region bank in Ihakana when they start to get a taste of their own medicine. Despite a number of their ships having been destroyed, I've noticed a surge in their activity near the station. They are mainly compromised of the natives of Ihakana who are poor and jobless, and angry at the State for the lack of interest this system receives from the government. For some reason they believe attacking the State and Region Bank will help their cause … foolish if you ask me.

But when their leaders fall, we believe they will become discouraged and this temporary surge of unrest will dissipate. Bring me evidence of their demise and you shall be rewarded.

story: O bandă de huligani terorizează State and Region Bank din Ihakana. Varma vrea să plătească o miliție locală.
A gang of hooligans is terrorizing the State and Region Bank in Ihakana. Varma wants to fund a local militia.

goal: Elimini forța Guristas dintr-un avanpost.
Eliminate the Guristas force at an outpost.
reward: 485.000 ISK, plus 471.000 ISK bonus.
485,000 ISK, plus a 471,000 ISK bonus.
steps: Un singur buzunar, în Ihakana (lowsec).
One gated pocket in Ihakana (lowsec).
Omori toți inamicii și te întorci.
Kill all enemies and return.
m.brief:
As you may know, Ihakana and the surrounding systems are completely infested by Gurista pirates. In my work for Internal Security in this system, I've had a number of deputies under me, every single one of whom has fallen prey to these dirty dogs. Fiderer, my last deputy, was a particularly good lad, and I hated to see him go down to those bastards. 

I'm always on the lookout for people who know their way around a fight. If you're interested, I can deputize you: Plenty of work to be done around here. 

If you feel like proving your mettle, there's a small Gurista forward base in this area that's been no end of trouble for quite a while now. It's not a large outpost as outposts go, but according to our intelligence it plays host to some very powerful Gurista cronies, people not to be trifled with. If you can go in there and eliminate the Gurista force, I'd be much obliged. I'd also be likely to have more work for you.

goal: Distrugi Storage Silo din laboratorul de droguri Guristas.
Destroy the Storage Silo of the Guristas drug lab.
reward: 502.000 ISK, plus 523.000 ISK bonus.
502,000 ISK, plus a 523,000 ISK bonus.
steps: Buzunarul e într-un sistem vecin, highsec sau lowsec.
The pocket is in a nearby system, highsec or lowsec.
Varianta rapidă: distrugi doar Storage Silo și pleci.
Quick route: destroy only the Storage Silo and leave.
m.brief:
Okay, listen up. I have some more Gurista butt for you to kick. Yeah, I thought you'd be happy. 

There's another outpost in one of the outlying systems where the Guristas have a nice little drug lab going. This is a slightly bigger target than the last one we hired you to take out, so expect more opposition. Break through their defenses, destroy the outpost's storage silo, and get back to me for your reward. 

Get to it, deputy.

goal: Omori escadrila de fregate antrenată pentru raiduri.
Kill the frigate wing being trained for raids.
reward: 451.000 ISK, plus 442.000 ISK bonus.
451,000 ISK, plus a 442,000 ISK bonus.
tip: E ușoară, merge și cu un crucișător.
It is easy and can be done in a cruiser.
steps: Baza e în același sistem cu agentul.
The base is in the same system as the agent.
Omori doar fregatele și distrugătoarele. Structurile și nava de luptă le poți ignora.
Kill only the frigates and destroyers. You can ignore the structures and the battleship.
m.brief:
I have a report here on my desk stating that the Guristas have been training a special frigate wing for hit-and-run operations in the vicinities of Ihakana and Friggi. Intelligence has given us the location of one of the training bases for this frigate wing, and we intend to put a dent in this little scheme of theirs. 

I need you to go out to the next system, where the base is, kill the detachment of frigates being trained there, and destroy their training bunkers. Beware: The instructors are accomplished pilots, and there may be a battleship or two guarding the facilities. Go in with caution. Good luck.

goal: Îl vânezi pe Choiji Korakami, pilotul canonierei Guristas.
Hunt down Choiji Korakami, the Guristas gunship pilot.
reward: X-Large 'Locomotive' Shield Booster BPC (3 rulări, ME 8, TE 8) și mult standing la Caldari State.
X-Large 'Locomotive' Shield Booster BPC (3 runs, ME 8, TE 8) and a big Caldari State standing gain.
steps: Ascunzătoarea e în același sistem cu agentul.
The hideout is in the same system as the agent.
Distrugi Choiji the Vanquisher. Are scut activ de 115 HP/s, deci îți trebuie DPS peste atât.
Destroy Choiji the Vanquisher. It has a 115 HP/s active shield tank, so you need more DPS than that.
m.brief:
Deputy, we have a problem. The Guristas have brought in a special operative, rumored to be the cousin of Korako "The Rabbit" Korakami. His name is Choiji, and he's known throughout this area for his fearsome prowess in battleship combat. 

Now, we're not certain what exactly it is he's doing here, but we're not going to wait to find out. Internal Security High Command has given the go-ahead for us to eliminate him, and I'm giving the job to you. I've uploaded the coordinates of his hideout to your Neocom. Be careful - he has two fanatically devoted bodyguards who won't take kindly to your attempt to kill their master. 

Good luck.

story: Yochuko lucrează pentru Internal Security în Ihakana și și-a pierdut toți adjuncții în lupta cu Guristas. Acum te vrea pe tine.
Yochuko works for Internal Security in Ihakana and has lost every deputy to the Guristas. Now it is your turn.

m.t: Lost Love - Manchura The Pirate (1 of 3)
goal: Aduci Manchura's Logs (0,1 m³).
Bring Manchura's Logs (0.1 m³).
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Manchura zboară un crucișător în Contested Guristas Outrider Post, Otomainen.
Manchura flies a cruiser in the Contested Guristas Outrider Post, Otomainen.
Îl distrugi și iei jurnalele. Le duci agentului.
Destroy it, loot the logs and take them to the agent.
m.brief:
So ... tired. Michi has been holed up here for longer than he can remember ... and he won't leave until his broken heart has been mended ... his lost love must be returned! Old Michi won't rest until he has found the truth! Been digging up these old ruins for years, but her body is nowhere in sight. Dead she is, Old Michi thought. Dead after those blasted Guristas scoundrels attacked the remnants of this once prosperous community. Dead after the metal walls of these beastly stations caved in from the assault.

But then Old Michi stumbles upon an old pirate, in the Guristas stronghold of Otomainen, that he remembers from his younger years. A devilish man, who had a fancy for Old Michi's lost love he did. This troublesome pirate scoffed at Old Michi he did, and claimed his lost love was still alive! But reveal her location he did not. Old Michi will pay handsomely for that information. Bring it to Old Michi and you'll make him a happy man!

goal: O aduci pe Wei Todaki (1 m³).
Bring Wei Todaki (1 m³).
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Intri pe poarta de la sosire. Sunt cinci buzunare.
Take the gate at warp-in. There are five pockets.
Buzunarul 1 și 3: nimeni nu atacă la sosire. Buzunarul 2: atacă primul grup. Buzunarele 4 și 5: atacă toți.
Pockets 1 and 3: no aggro on arrival. Pocket 2: group 1 aggroes. Pockets 4 and 5: all aggro.
Unele nave te încetinesc cu web. O iei pe Wei și o duci agentului.
Some ships web you. Take Wei and bring her to the agent.
m.brief: Now that Old Michi has the location of his lost love,  needs to find her! ... Wei was the light of Michi's life, back when he had a reason to live ... she was the cornerstone of his existence ... lost so long ago. But now he has a chance of regaining that precious lost love, and reclaiming what was lost to him so long ago ... the logs you retrieved indicate that she is being held prisoner at a Guristas base in an asteroid belt in this very system ... you must find her, and bring her back to Old Michi. Do this quickly, the end draws near for poor Michi ...

goal: O duci pe Wei Todaki (1 m³) la Otsela VI - Moon 17 - Genolution Biotech Production.
Carry Wei Todaki (1 m³) to Otsela VI - Moon 17 - Genolution Biotech Production.
reward: Michi's Excavation Augmentor, Improved 'Guise' Cloaking Device II și standing la Caldari State.
Michi's Excavation Augmentor, Improved 'Guise' Cloaking Device II and Caldari State standing.
tip: Michi's Excavation Augmentor e un implant de minerit căutat.
Michi's Excavation Augmentor is a sought-after mining implant.
steps: O iei de la agent și o predai la destinație.
Take her from the agent and deliver her.
m.brief: Now that Michi and Wei have been reunited at long last, Michi has some worries ... Wei seems to have been brain washed by the Guristas scoundrels, she even thinks Michi is crazy! Wei needs to come to her senses, and Michi has lost all hope of convincing her himself. Therefore Old Michi has one final task for  ... bring Wei to an old acquaintance of Michi ... this acquaintance runs a health clinic on Otsela VI - Moon 17 - Genolution Biotech Production. Bring Wei there and she will be taken care of, until her health problems have been dealt with ... do this for Michi and you shall be generously rewarded.

story: Bătrânul Michi sapă de ani de zile în Rush Town Ruins după iubita pierdută, Wei Todaki, răpită de Guristas.
Old Michi has been digging in Rush Town Ruins for years, looking for a lost love, Wei Todaki, taken by the Guristas.

goal: Aduci 30 Guristas Diamond Tag (3 m³) și primești un BPC Raven Navy Issue.
Bring 30 Guristas Diamond Tags (3 m³) and get a Raven Navy Issue BPC.
reward: Raven Navy Issue BPC (2 rulări), plus 25.000 ISK bonus.
Raven Navy Issue BPC (2 runs), plus a 25,000 ISK bonus.
tip: Misiunea se poate repeta.
This mission can be repeated.
steps: Insignele cad de la Guristas sau le cumperi din piață.
The tags drop from Guristas or you buy them on the market.
Agentul stă la poarta din Friggi și cere standing 9,9 cu Caldari State.
The agent is at the Friggi gate and needs 9.9 Caldari State standing.
Predai insignele.
Hand in the tags.
m.brief:
We have a policy here within the Caldari State that our more prominent members fly a suitable ship according to their status, both to give them an edge during combat and to uphold our image, especially within our borders. We have recently decided to extend this benefit to mercenaries or freelancers employed by us that have shown admirable bravery and skill in the field, or earned the right through countless hours of dedicated service to our corporations.
As you undoubtedly already know I have been assigned the task of allocating these ships to their deserved owners. After looking at your record, we decided that you, , are worthy of such an honor. There is just one catch, since you aren't an official member we need something in exchange for this gift. Cough up 30 x Guristas Diamond Tag and the Raven Navy Issue Blueprint is yours.

goal: Aduci agentului 20 Viridian Cytoserocin (200 m³) și primești un blueprint de booster.
Bring the agent 20 Viridian Cytoserocin (200 m³) and get a booster blueprint.
reward: Standard Drop Booster BPC (10 rulări, ME 5, TE 2) și standing la Gallente Federation.
Standard Drop Booster BPC (10 runs, ME 5, TE 2) and Gallente Federation standing.
tip: Aceeași misiune există la Binnie Nigolier, Grisier Challier și Mabvrion Atlete. O poți face o dată la fiecare.
The same mission exists at Binnie Nigolier, Grisier Challier and Mabvrion Atlete. You can do it once with each.
steps: Cumperi gazul din piață sau îl minezi chiar tu în zonă, cu o Venture sau o Prospect și probe Core.
Buy the gas on the market or harvest it yourself nearby with a Venture or Prospect and Core probes.
Agentul e în nullsec, așa că pentru transport e bun un Blockade Runner sau o Prospect.
The agent is in nullsec, so a Blockade Runner or a Prospect is a good choice for hauling.
Predai gazul din fereastra misiunii.
Hand in the gas from the mission window.

goal: Aduci 30 Serpentis Gold Tag (3 m³).
Bring 30 Serpentis Gold Tag (3 m³).
reward: Vexor Navy Issue BPC (2 rulări, ME 20, TE 8).
Vexor Navy Issue BPC (2 runs, ME 20, TE 8).
tip: Predai insignele la Celestis-ul agentului, în Jolia. Misiunea se poate repeta.
Hand the tags in at the agent's Celestis in Jolia. This mission can be repeated.
steps: Insignele cad de la Serpentis sau le cumperi din piață.
The tags drop from Serpentis or you buy them on the market.
Agentul cere standing 9,2.
The agent needs 9,2 standing.
Predai insignele.
Hand in the tags.
m.brief:
We have a policy here within the Gallente Federation that our more prominent members fly a suitable ship according to their status, both to give them an edge during combat and to uphold our image, especially within our borders. We have recently decided to extend this benefit to mercenaries or freelancers employed by us that have shown admirable bravery and skill in the field, or earned the right through countless hours of dedicated service to our corporations.

As you undoubtedly already know I have been assigned the task of allocating these ships to their deserved owners. After looking at your record, we decided that you, , are worthy of such an honor. There is just one catch, since you aren't an official member we need something in exchange for this gift. Cough up 30 x Serpentis Gold Tag and the Vexor Navy Issue Blueprint is yours.

goal: Aduci 30 Serpentis Silver Tag (3 m³).
Bring 30 Serpentis Silver Tag (3 m³).
reward: Un BPC de navă Navy Issue.
A Navy Issue ship BPC.
tip: Agentul stă la poarta Augnais. Misiunea se poate repeta.
The agent is at the Augnais gate. This mission can be repeated.
steps: Insignele cad de la Serpentis sau le cumperi din piață.
The tags drop from Serpentis or you buy them on the market.
Agentul cere standing 8,5.
The agent needs 8,5 standing.
Predai insignele.
Hand in the tags.

goal: Aduci 30 Serpentis Diamond Tag (3 m³).
Bring 30 Serpentis Diamond Tag (3 m³).
reward: Megathron Navy Issue BPC (2 rulări, ME 20, TE 8).
Megathron Navy Issue BPC (2 runs, ME 20, TE 8).
tip: Predai insignele la Dominix-ul agentului, în Jolia. Misiunea se poate repeta.
Hand the tags in at the agent's Dominix in Jolia. This mission can be repeated.
steps: Insignele cad de la Serpentis sau le cumperi din piață.
The tags drop from Serpentis or you buy them on the market.
Agentul cere standing 9,9.
The agent needs 9,9 standing.
Predai insignele.
Hand in the tags.
m.brief: So you've come at last, . I have been expecting you. I assume you're here to acquire your new ship blueprint. If so you're in luck, I still have a few Megathron Navy Issue Blueprint copies in stock.

goal: Aduci 30 Serpentis Crystal Tag (3 m³).
Bring 30 Serpentis Crystal Tag (3 m³).
reward: Social Adaptation Chip - Improved și Cybernetic Subprocessor - Basic ca bonus în 10 ore.
Social Adaptation Chip - Improved and Cybernetic Subprocessor - Basic as a bonus within 10 hours.
tip: Agentul e Intaki Syndicate: standingul cerut e cu ei. Misiunea se poate repeta.
The agent is Intaki Syndicate: the required standing is with them. This mission can be repeated.
steps: Insignele cad de la Serpentis sau le cumperi din piață.
The tags drop from Serpentis or you buy them on the market.
Agentul cere standing 9,5.
The agent needs 9,5 standing.
Predai insignele.
Hand in the tags.
m.brief:
We have a policy here within the ORE that our more prominent members use certain implants to boost their mental ability, since it's important that our people in key positions perform at a level above what's considered normal for a human being. It's a competitive world we live in, and sometimes one has to take risks to achieve one's goals, even if it means meddling with the brain.

You may not be a full-fledged member of Outer Ring Excavations, but you've created such a name for yourself that we feel obliged to treat you as one of our own. And considering your record, we feel that our policy pertains to you as well. So I've been authorized to give you this implant in exchange for one simple task. Bring me a few insignias and the reward is yours.

goal: Aduci 100 Fertilizer (150 m³).
Bring 100 Fertilizer (150 m³).
reward: 244.000 ISK, plus bonus de timp.
244,000 ISK, plus a time bonus.
steps: Îl cumperi din Dodixie, aproape, sau îl produci din PI.
Buy it in nearby Dodixie or make it through PI.
Îl predai agentului.
Hand it in.
m.brief:
Something just came up that's right up your alley.

My name is Jannegiers Estacan, and I'm the Chief Indoctrination Officer for the Friends of Nature in this area. I bring new recruits in and teach them all about the wonders of nature and how awful the corporate behemoth is ... as the 12th Prophet put it, "trying to put an ISK sign" on everything that grows naturally in this splendid universe of ours. 

I also oversee most of the supplies that come to and from our fair little seminary. As a matter of fact, I have something on my desk right now that requires the attention of someone fast and competent. Couldn't help but notice that fine-looking vessel you're flying there. One of our fertilizer shipments was ambushed yesterday, and we need someone to replace what's missing. If you can find us 100 units of fertilizer, we'd be much obliged.

goal: Duci 160 Wheat (184 m³) pe Parchanier IV.
Carry 160 Wheat (184 m³) to Parchanier IV.
reward: 8.500 ISK, plus bonus de timp.
8,500 ISK, plus a time bonus.
steps: Patru salturi dus-întors.
Four jumps there and back.
m.brief:
Yes, I have something for you.

Great job with the fertilizer. My thanks. Next up, we have a shortage of wheat on one of our outposts on Parchanier IV. There's been a bit of a mix-up, it seems: A shipment of Quafe Ultra went to the planet instead of the wheat, and now those poor people have nothing to make their bread with. 

If you could pop over to the Egonics Inc. Development Studio at Parchanier V and deliver this wheat to them, you'd be greatly aiding the FON's cause in this area.

goal: Duci 180 Hydrogen Batteries (180 m³), furate de la Wiyrkomi în Augnais.
Carry 180 Hydrogen Batteries (180 m³), stolen from Wiyrkomi in Augnais.
reward: 12.000 ISK, plus bonus de timp.
12,000 ISK, plus a time bonus.
steps: Ridici marfa și te întorci. Două salturi.
Pick up the cargo and return. Two jumps.
m.brief:
I have just the thing you want.

Good news! One of our teams has just pulled off a major coup against the Wiyrkomi corporation in the Augnais system. They've managed to intercept the third shipment in a row of batteries for the workers' personal electronic entertainment systems. Things are at boiling point over there already, and I wouldn't be surprised if we saw a mutiny there sometime in the near future. 

We need someone to go grab the batteries, though, so we can put them to good use and absolve our people in the area of any suspicions, should the powers that be decide to conduct a hangar search. Head over to the Pend Insurance Investment Bank in Augnais and grab the batteries for me, and we'll reward you well.

goal: Duci 125 Small Arms (250 m³) în Deltole.
Carry 125 Small Arms (250 m³) to Deltole.
reward: 'Beatnik' Small Remote Armor Repairer BPC (3 rulări), standing la Gallente Federation și bonus de timp.
'Beatnik' Small Remote Armor Repairer BPC (3 runs), Gallente Federation standing and a time bonus.
steps: Două salturi. Poți preda de la distanță.
Two jumps. You can complete remotely.
m.brief:
Yes, I have something for you.

This is kind of strange. I've just been handed a shipment of small arms that is supposedly bound for an outpost of ours in the Deltole system. I'm not sure what this means, but the shipping slip seems correct. I'll have to get in touch with my superiors about this - we shouldn't be ferrying weapons around. Something fishy might be going on here. 

Should you decide you want to take this job, the small arms will be placed in your cargo hold and since I know you'll remain quiet about this, I'm going to throw in a little something special as a reward this time.

story: Jannegiers recrutează pentru Friends of Nature (FON), activiștii care luptă cu Wiyrkomi în Algintal.
Jannegiers recruits for the Friends of Nature (FON), the activists fighting Wiyrkomi in Algintal.

goal: Duci 10 Store Goods (800 m³).
Carry 10 Store Goods (800 m³).
reward: 20.000 ISK, plus 50.000 ISK bonus.
20,000 ISK, plus a 50,000 ISK bonus.
steps: Îți trebuie 800 m³ liberi. Ridici marfa și o predai.
You need 800 m³ free. Pick up the goods and deliver them.
m.brief:
Welcome to the Nickel & Dime Store, . It is a humble little shop owned and operated by the Thukker tribe, catering to the needy souls in this beautiful constellation. Hm, something tells me you can be of some assistance to us ― perhaps you've worked for the Thukkers in the past? 

Let's see if you've got what it takes to help our fledgling business grow. I have a small task for you: nothing complicated or risky, but it should let me gauge your talents. Deliver a few crates of goods to a nearby station for me. The rewards are modest, since this is such an easy task, but it's only the start.

goal: Recuperezi 5 Stolen Goods (400 m³).
Recover 5 Stolen Goods (400 m³).
reward: 'Shady' Sensor Booster BPC (3 rulări), plus 80.000 ISK bonus.
'Shady' Sensor Booster BPC (3 runs), plus an 80,000 ISK bonus.
steps: Misiunea nu-ți dă locația. Bunurile sunt în Contested Gallente Skeleton Comet, în Deltole.
The mission gives no location. The goods are in Contested Gallente Skeleton Comet, Deltole.
Cad de la fregatele Serpentis Junkie din prima cameră.
They drop from the Serpentis Junkie frigates in the first room.
Le duci agentului. Îți trebuie 400 m³ liberi.
Take them to the agent. You need 400 m³ free.
m.brief:
Good work on your previous assignment. Despite it being a tedious one, you pulled it off without any qualms. Now for something a little more interesting. 

You see, things have not been easy around here lately. The Caldari mega-corp Wiyrkomi is intent on tapping into the vast natural resources found in the constellation, much to the dismay of the many environmentalists here in the Federation. The struggle between the two sides draws unwanted attention to our little enterprise here and is making our operation difficult. Down the road, I might be tempted to have you help us with this unpleasant situation. But not just yet. First, we have to take care of another small problem that just came up. 

The Serpentis drug lords are out in force here in Algintal, overseeing traffic between Federation and Republic space. We Thukkers are not into the drug scene, so we generally leave them alone. The same applies for them, for the most part. Live and let live, huh? Thing is, many of the Serpentis have grown too fond of their own goods and can get a little wild at times. One such incident occurred the other night when a gang of renegade Serpentis junkies stole some goods we were receiving from our associates in the Republic. The goods aren't all that valuable, but we must send a clear sign to the Serpentis that our goods are to be left alone. 

I know that the fools who stole our goods are relaxing at the Skeleton Comet complex over in Deltole. If you're willing to go over there and teach them a lesson, a hard lesson ― a permanent lesson, get me? ― then I would be much obliged. And if you could return with some of the goods they stole, I'd be even happier.

m.t: Concerned Citizens - Run, Boy, Run! (3 of 3)
goal: Duci 15 Shady Goods (1.200 m³).
Carry 15 Shady Goods (1,200 m³).
reward: 1.000 Federation Navy Iridium Charge S, Trust Partners Business Card ca bonus și 0,41% standing la Thukker Tribe.
1,000 Federation Navy Iridium Charge S, the Trust Partners Business Card as a bonus and 0.41% Thukker Tribe standing.
tip: Cartea de vizită vine doar ca bonus de timp. Fără ea nu poți începe lanțul lui Iliere Angetyn.
The business card comes only as the time bonus. Without it you cannot start Iliere Angetyn's chain.
steps: Agentul te avertizează de vamă, dar marfa e perfect legală.
The agent warns about customs, but the cargo is perfectly legal.
Îți trebuie 1.200 m³ liberi.
You need 1,200 m³ free.
m.brief:
Oh, , you've come at an opportune moment. Things are progressing as I feared they would. The continuous struggle between Wiyrkomi and the activists have cast a spotlight on the constellation. While we here are the Nickel & Dime Store are running a perfectly legal business, our associates and clients like to operate in the dark. Already, I've lost several important clients, and some employees are getting restless. So much so that I'm having difficulties making my more demanding deliveries. 

Unfortunately, I do not have the means or the knowledge to do much about the situation, but my business associate Iliere Angetyn is a most resourceful Gallentean, and I'm sure he's already contemplating how to put things right. But Angetyn doesn't deal with just anyone. Only those clearly in favor with the Trust Partners company get his attention. So I have a proposal for you. Run an errand for me that one of my just-departed couriers was supposed to, and I'll give you a Trust Partners Business Card. Show this to Angetyn and he's certain to offer you something lucrative. 

The errand in question is a simple delivery over the border into the Republic. It has a very small chance of getting you in trouble with the customs, but I'm sure a resourceful pilot such as yourself can pick the right route to avoid any unwanted attention.

story: Pattok ține magazinul Thukker Nickel & Dime Store din Augnais. Lanțul dă cartea de vizită cerută de Iliere Angetyn.
Pattok runs the Thukker Nickel & Dime Store in Augnais. The chain gives the business card Iliere Angetyn needs.

goal: Aduci 3 Crates of Construction Blocks (210 m³) de la Balle VII - Moon 17 - Center for Advanced Studies School.
Bring 3 Crates of Construction Blocks (210 m³) from Balle VII - Moon 17 - Center for Advanced Studies School.
reward: 200.000 ISK, plus 200.000 ISK bonus.
200,000 ISK, plus a 200,000 ISK bonus.
steps: Ridici lăzile și le aduci agentului.
Pick up the crates and bring them to the agent.
m.brief: As I've already told you we have some problems with our transportation service. We're using some of our own freighters now to transport goods from Caldari space, but we're short on manpower. If you could stop by Balle VII - Moon 17 - Center for Advanced Studies School and bring the 50 construction blocks I had ordered to me, then I'll give you a reward. We need them for the next habitation module we're building for the workers stationed here.

goal: Aduci 18 Caldari Surveyor (54 m³) de la Tendhyes VIII - Kaalakiota Corporation Factory.
Bring 18 Caldari Surveyors (54 m³) from Tendhyes VIII - Kaalakiota Corporation Factory.
reward: 400.000 ISK, plus 100.000 ISK bonus în 4 ore.
400,000 ISK, plus a 100,000 ISK bonus within 4 hours.
steps: Ridici topografii și îi aduci agentului.
Pick up the surveyors and bring them to the agent.
m.brief:
I have something slightly more dangerous for you this time, . We have 18 surveyors stranded on Tendhyes VIII - Kaalakiota Corporation Factory after Prompt Delivery backed out on our deal to get them moved here a few days ago. Apparently they decided the risks of transporting them through Gallente space were too great. The Federation Navy has threatened to attack any corporations under the Caldari State other than Wiyrkomi, and even with our surveyors on board we fear they might hold true to their word.

If you can get the surveyors here today, I'll give you a hefty reward. Just watch out for those FON fanatics, they're everywhere these days.

goal: Distrugi navele FON care au atacat postul de supraveghere Temko.
Destroy the FON ships that attacked the Temko surveillance post.
reward: 'Executive' Remote Sensor Dampener BPC (3 rulări), plus 500.000 ISK bonus în 4 ore.
'Executive' Remote Sensor Dampener BPC (3 runs), plus a 500,000 ISK bonus within 4 hours.
tip: Ataci FON: pierzi puțin standing cu Gallente Federation.
You attack FON: you lose a little Gallente Federation standing.
steps: Buzunarul e în același sistem.
The pocket is in the same system.
Omori navele FON și te întorci.
Kill the FON ships and return.
m.brief:
I have a matter of urgency for you this time, . Temko, the Gallentean mercenary organization that we hired, reported to us that one of its surveillance posts in Colelie has been attacked. All of their personnel are currently unavailable, so they pleaded with us to find someone else to investigate the attack. And I think you are the man for the job.

It's been a while since the attack was reported, so we have absolutely no idea what the situation is out there. Hopefully you will be able to track down whoever is responsible and punish them. Good luck.

goal: Aduci Azure Canyon Tourist Pass.
Bring the Azure Canyon Tourist Pass.
reward: Wiyrkomi Voucher și 'Monopoly' Magnetic Field Stabilizer BPC (3 rulări, ME 10, TE 4) ca bonus.
Wiyrkomi Voucher and 'Monopoly' Magnetic Field Stabilizer BPC (3 runs, ME 10, TE 4) as a bonus.
tip: Cu voucher-ul mergi în Fluekele, la Veko Tallaja.
Take the voucher to Veko Tallaja in Fluekele.
steps: Permisul cade de la pirații de la intrarea în Contested Gallente Azure Canyon.
The pass drops from rats at the entrance of Contested Gallente Azure Canyon.
Îl duci agentului.
Take it to the agent.
m.brief:
This time I'd like you to obtain a pass into the Azure Canyon in Colelie. The Azure Canyon is located in a pocket of deadspace which has unusually dense ion clouds, which makes it ideal for creating a massive power plant. The reason we are in Colelie is to start constructing the power station, but so far we've been stuck at square 1 due to our inability to clear the area of Serpentis pirates and FON terrorists.

To get to the point, we're sending in a few squadrons of Temko mercenaries to conduct a quick reconnaissance operation in the Azure Canyon area. But we haven't been able to get past the first acceleration gate since Serpentis agents reconfigured the lock, and it would take far too long to manually navigate through the deadspace pocket. Hence we need the keycard.

You'll find a group of FON ships blockading the gate against anyone affiliated with Wiyrkomi. We believe their leader has the keycard we need in her possession. Her name is Apte Donie, and she should be located at the forward point into the complex. Use whatever means necessary to acquire that keycard, .

story: Aakeo lucrează pentru Wiyrkomi și pregătește o centrală electrică în Azure Canyon, din Colelie. Lanțul dă voucher-ul cerut de Veko Tallaja.
Aakeo works for Wiyrkomi, preparing a power plant in the Azure Canyon in Colelie. The chain gives the voucher Veko Tallaja needs.

goal: Salvezi turiștii blocați într-un buzunar plin de drone rogue, în Deltole.
Rescue the tourists stuck in a pocket full of rogue drones in Deltole.
steps: Un crucișător e de ajuns. Site-ul primește până la battleship.
A cruiser is enough. The site allows up to battleships.
Misiunea e gata când omori dronele din prima cameră. A doua cameră are doar turiștii, care îți mulțumesc.
The mission completes once the drones in the first room die. The second room only has the tourists thanking you.
m.brief:
Great to hear that. Now the first task I have for you is pretty dangerous. We were expecting a large group of tourists here from Du Annes today but unfortunately their cruiser's warp-drive broke down in Deltole. On top of that they stumbled into a deadspace pocket filled with rogue drones. The last we heard of them was their distress signal indicating they were under attack. I can only hope that they managed to escape, but at this time it's impossible to tell.

I would like you to fly into the deadspace pocket where they were last seen and search for them. Destroy every rogue drone ship that you find. If they are still alive they might need some help repairing their warp-drive, if not then they at least would need help fighting off the drones. Good luck. 

----
Mission completed:

You've done us a great favor, . The captain of the pleasure cruiser managed to contact us shortly after you finished your objective, and informed us that they were safe and on their way here. Their deaths would have been terrible publicity for the Information Center ...

goal: Îl transporți pe Federal Intelligence Officer (2 m³).
Transport the Federal Intelligence Officer (2 m³).
reward: 'Investor' Tracking Disruptor I BPC (3 rulări).
'Investor' Tracking Disruptor I BPC (3 runs).
steps: Douăsprezece salturi dus-întors.
Twelve jumps there and back.
m.brief:
The next mission in line is rather simple. A Federal Intelligence officer is scheduled to inspect our outpost this week. He was supposed to arrive later today but his ship was delayed. The Federal Intelligence Office demanded that we provide him with a quick transport so that he is able to complete his assignment on time. My take on this entire situation is that they did this on purpose just to see how far we're willing to go to please Federation authorities.

Now, considering that you completed your last assignment with flying colors I assume this will be a piece of cake for someone of your caliber. Just pick up the FIO officer at Eglennaert I - Moon 4 - Federal Intelligence Office Logistic Support and get him back here as quickly as possible.

Dismissed.

goal: Duci Data Sheets (1 m³) la Alentene VI - Moon 6 - Roden Shipyards Warehouse.
Carry the Data Sheets (1 m³) to Alentene VI - Moon 6 - Roden Shipyards Warehouse.
reward: Standing la Gallente Federation, Limited Cybernetic Subprocessor - Beta și 'Dealer' Light Ion Blaster I BPC ca bonus.
Gallente Federation standing, Limited Cybernetic Subprocessor - Beta and 'Dealer' Light Ion Blaster I BPC as a bonus.
steps: Destinația e la 10 salturi.
The destination is 10 jumps away.
Pentru BPC-ul bonus ai doar 40 de minute. Ia o navă rapidă.
You have only 40 minutes for the bonus BPC. Take a fast ship.
m.brief:
Now that you've finished the most pressing tasks I have, it's time to send my report to Miloise Roden in the Roden Shipyard headquarters. It contains some pretty sensitive information, so I want it kept safe and secure until it's in the hangar of Alentene VI - Moon 6 - Roden Shipyards Warehouse. Don't mess this up!

Dismissed. 

----
Completed: 

You've done all I've asked you to, with style. I suggest you take a look at the Wiyrkomi Survey Station in Colelie or the Command Center in Fluekele if you're in need of some more work. Good luck!

story: Ardoen primește turiști și inspectori federali la Grand Future Information Center.
Ardoen welcomes tourists and federal inspectors at the Grand Future Information Center.

goal: Aduci Trust Partners Business Card.
Bring the Trust Partners Business Card.
reward: 5.000 ISK, plus 5.000 ISK bonus.
5,000 ISK, plus a 5,000 ISK bonus.
steps: Cartea o primești ca bonus la ultima misiune a lui Pattok Nortul.
You get the card as the bonus of Pattok Nortul's last mission.
O predai. Bonusul de timp e de doar 10 minute.
Hand it in. The time bonus is only 10 minutes.
m.brief: Try talking to some in the vicinity and get back to me once you have a Trust Partners Business Card.

goal: Aduci Surveillance Recordings (0,1 m³) dintr-un post de supraveghere.
Bring the Surveillance Recordings (0.1 m³) from a surveillance post.
reward: Un BPC storyline aleatoriu (3 rulări, ME 10, TE 4), plus 100.000 ISK bonus.
A random storyline BPC (3 runs, ME 10, TE 4), plus a 100,000 ISK bonus.
tip: Pierzi standing cu Caldari State pentru fregatele distruse.
You lose Caldari State standing for the frigates you kill.
steps: Un distrugător sau crucișător e de ajuns.
A destroyer or cruiser is enough.
Ca să termini, trebuie să distrugi fregatele Caldari Navy.
To finish, you must destroy the Caldari Navy frigates.
m.brief:
Hm. Alright. You see, Algintal was such a nice place a few years back. The traffic through its systems and the many tourists meant we could operate with minimal risk. But now that has all changed with the arrival of the Wiyrkomi corporation and their lackeys, Roden Shipyards. What were once standard border-running operations now require much more time and effort to pull off. 

What is worse, the Caldari think they own the place just because they exploited a loophole in the trade agreement between the State and the Federation. They're trying to muscle us out. I want to nip that bullshit in the bud and strike back at the Wiyrkomi. That's where you come in, [Character]. 

The Wiyrkomi have installed a surveillance outpost here in Augnais. The problem is, I only found out about it a few days ago, after I'd just completed an important deal with a Republic contact of mine. If the Wiyrkomi listened in on the deal, they could compromise the Thukkers' position here in Algintal. I thought it was too late to do anything about it, but the security measures of the Wiyrkomi are working against them here. The surveillance outpost operates in total radio silence and only sends out its recordings in a shuttle once a week to the Wiyrkomi headquarters over in Fluekele. The shuttle will depart tomorrow, so there is still time to take care of this ... problem. I want you to head over to the surveillance outpost and take out that shuttle. Make sure you locate the surveillance recordings and confiscate them. Bring them back to me, and we're back on track.

goal: Aduci 2 Spoiled Drugs (0,4 m³).
Bring 2 Spoiled Drugs (0.4 m³).
reward: Un BPC storyline aleatoriu și 1.000 Federation Navy Thorium Charge M ca bonus.
A random storyline BPC and 1,000 Federation Navy Thorium Charge M as a bonus.
steps: Drogurile sunt în containerele arse din Contested Gallente Skeleton Comet, în Deltole.
The drugs are in the scorched cans of Contested Gallente Skeleton Comet, Deltole.
Le duci agentului.
Take them to the agent.
m.brief: Head over to the Skeletal Comet in Deltole, locate the wrecked ship, and get the drugs out

goal: Duci Sealed Container (50 m³) cu dovezi împotriva lui Veko Tallaja.
Carry a Sealed Container (50 m³) with evidence against Veko Tallaja.
reward: 75.000 ISK, plus 75.000 ISK bonus.
75,000 ISK, plus a 75,000 ISK bonus.
steps: Ridici containerul și îl predai.
Pick up the container and deliver it.
m.brief:
Yes, in fact. I'm feeling very confident in your abilities, so I'm setting up a big job for you. But before that, I need you to take care of a smaller matter for me. I have acquired certain items that cast Veko Tallaja, the operation supervisor for Wiyrkomi here in Algintal, in a rather negative light. I'm not going to use this stuff just now, but I need to store it somewhere safe.

I want you to head over to Fluekele and drop it off at the Pend Insurance station there. A friend of mine will then place it in a safe-deposit box there. I know it's a trivial thing I'm asking, but this is very sensitive material that absolutely can't get into the wrong hands ... and, besides, I need more time to prepare for your big mission.

m.t: Business Associates - Kill the Competition (4 of 4)
goal: Aduci 4 Smuggler DNA (0,4 m³) de la contrabandiștii rivali.
Bring 4 Smuggler DNA (0.4 m³) from rival smugglers.
reward: Un BPC storyline aleatoriu și 3 Ship Logs ca bonus.
A random storyline BPC and 3 Ship Logs as a bonus.
tip: Ship Logs îți trebuie la Krester Rupptofs.
You need the Ship Logs for Krester Rupptofs.
steps: Omori toți contrabandiștii și iei ADN-ul din epave.
Kill all the smugglers and loot the DNA.
m.brief:
Algintal has always been a favored spot for smugglers. It's far enough out of the way so as not to attract too much attention from the authorities. Besides us at Trust Partners, the Serpentis are out here in force, as well as several independents. Usually we try to stay well clear of each other, but sometimes a group arrives that thinks it can muscle everyone else out. One such group has been making a nuisance of itself recently, and it's time to take them out. We've played Mr. Nice Guy until now, but no longer.

The smugglers in question have built themselves a nice little hideout near here. We're not playing any games here, so killing them is the only item on the agenda. It was hell to track them down, so make sure you take them all out in one go so I don't have to repeat the process later. If you pull this off with style, I'm sure some associates of mine would love for you to work a bit for them. When you bring me those dead smugglers' DNA, I'll give you some ship logs that my associates need to tamper with a bit to make them seem as innocent as a virgin's butt. Those logs should be ample proof to them that you're a trusted friend.

story: Iliere conduce Trust Partners, o firmă de contrabandă din Algintal amenințată de Wiyrkomi și Serpentis.
Iliere runs Trust Partners, a smuggling outfit in Algintal threatened by Wiyrkomi and the Serpentis.

goal: Aduci Interview Transcripts (1 m³) din Fluekele.
Bring the Interview Transcripts (1 m³) from Fluekele.
reward: 40.000 ISK, plus bonus de timp.
40,000 ISK, plus a time bonus.
steps: Patru salturi dus-întors.
Four jumps there and back.
m.brief:
Sure, I've got something.

Here's the deal. I'm a senior journalist for the Scope, and I'm working on an in-depth piece about the Wiyrkomi project in this constellation and the FON's (Friends of Nature's) struggle to counteract their plans. It's a big piece, and I have several reporters working on different strands in different places, so assistance from a fast-moving capsule pilot such as yourself is always needed. 

As a matter of fact, I have a job for you right now if you want it. One of my reporters just completed a few interviews with Colelie project workers who are on break from the project at the Wiyrkomi Factory in Fluekele. He says he managed to get some juicy tidbits from them about the way Wiyrkomi handles its workers; grist for the cause, to mangle a metaphor. 

Bring me back the interview transcripts from Fluekele, and I'll pay you as much as the agency allows me to dole out. How about it?

goal: Duci un Scope Journalist (5 m³).
