Carry a Scope Journalist (5 m³).
reward: 10.000 ISK, plus bonus de timp.
10,000 ISK, plus a time bonus.
steps: Două salturi dus-întors.
Two jumps there and back.
m.brief:
Here is a mission suited for someone of your caliber.

It seems the Wiyrkomi Corporation isn't being entirely forthcoming when it comes to their labor practices. That was some very interesting material you brought back from Fluekele. So good, in fact, that I feel a sudden, almost physical urge to follow up on it. 

One of my top reporters just came in from Oursulaert. I want you to take him to the Wiyrkomi factory in Jolia, where some highly classified contacts are waiting for him. Since Wiyrkomi won't give us the straight dope, we're going to have to turn to alternative sources. I'll find out the truth yet. 

Take my guy to Jolia and I'll see to it that you're rewarded handsomely.

goal: Aduci Salvaged Data Core (2 m³) de la locul atacului din Colelie.
Bring the Salvaged Data Core (2 m³) from the attack site in Colelie.
reward: 38.000 ISK, plus bonus de timp.
38,000 ISK, plus a time bonus.
steps: Șase salturi dus-întors.
Six jumps there and back.
m.brief:
Yes, I have something for you.

Something fishy's going on here. Word just came in over the feednet: apparently, a FON strike squad staged an attack on a surveillance outpost in Colelie belonging to Temko, a mercenary organization contracted by Wiyrkomi to protect their holdings and help them gain a foothold in this constellation. 

This doesn't feel right at all. First, FON doesn't engage in out-and-out terrorism; their battles take place on politico-ideological fronts. Second, had it been FON, why would they advertise that fact? Their tactic is the swaying of public opinion, not the destruction of their opponents' assets. This has all the hallmarks of a frame-up. 

An old friend of mine who's well-connected in this area says he's managed to obtain the data core from one of the attacking ships' computers as it was brought in by salvager vessels. If we can get it into the hands of our specialists here, they might be able to extract some clues regarding the attackers' real identities and intentions. Head out to Parchanier and get me that data core. A lot may be riding on this.

goal: Duci Ardillan's Dossier (1 m³).
Carry Ardillan's Dossier (1 m³).
reward: FON Strike Scene Evidence, 1,8 mil. ISK, standing la Gallente Federation și bonus de timp.
FON Strike Scene Evidence, 1.8M ISK, Gallente Federation standing and a time bonus.
tip: Dovada îți trebuie la prima misiune a lui Preaux Gallot.
You need the evidence for Preaux Gallot's first mission.
steps: Ridici dosarul și îl predai.
Pick up the dossier and deliver it.
m.brief:
Here is a mission suited for someone of your caliber.

Okay, it's about to hit the fan. We've stumbled on to something very very bad indeed. It's so bad, in fact, that I'm not even going to come close to covering it in my article. The people behind this cannot know, under any circumstances, that we know about their plans. 

I can't tell you any more at this moment, but I'll tell you what I can do. I'm going to ask you for one more favor, and then I'm going to give you a contact within the FON. They have some work they need done, and since they're generally not the travelling types they could use a big strapping capsuleer to help them. But first I need to ask you one more favor. 

I've collected the data I've accrued in the making of my article into one dossier, which I need brought to a safe place. Word's just reached us that Wiyrkomi have this place under wraps, so I've become compromised. I'll have to jack in and do the rest of this remotely. 

Bring my dossier to my contact in Parchanier, and I'll hand over our analysis of the evidence you got for us. It's bad, friend. It's real bad. 

----
Mission completed:

Good work. I'm glad I found you. 

Take this data chip. On it, you will find evidence that the Wiyrkomi corporation have been engaging in terrorism against themselves in order to shift the public's opinion regarding both them and FON. It's not absolutely 100 percent reliable, but what there is seems solid enough. Bring this chip to Preaux Gallot in the Natura Seminary in Audaerne. There is more to be done yet, and I have a feeling this is all just beginning. 

Thank you for all your help. You've done us a great service.

story: Pandon e jurnalist la The Scope și scrie despre Wiyrkomi și FON. Ancheta dă peste ceva prea periculos.
Pandon is a journalist for The Scope writing about Wiyrkomi and FON. The investigation stumbles onto something too dangerous.

goal: Aduci FON Strike Scene Evidence (0,1 m³).
Bring the FON Strike Scene Evidence (0.1 m³).
reward: 314.000 ISK, plus bonus de timp.
314,000 ISK, plus a time bonus.
steps: Dovada o primești la ultima misiune a lui Pandon Ardillan.
You get the evidence from Pandon Ardillan's last mission.
O predai agentului.
Hand it in.
m.brief: First of all, do you have something for me...? If you know what I'm talking about, then hand it over, please. If you don't, then I'm sorry, but I don't have anything for you.

goal: Duci Aggregated FON Data (1 m³).
Carry the Aggregated FON Data (1 m³).
reward: 350.000 ISK, plus bonus de timp.
350,000 ISK, plus a time bonus.
steps: Patru salturi dus-întors.
Four jumps there and back.
m.brief:
Something just came up that's right up your alley.

First, a proper introduction. I'm Preaux Gallot, one of FON's chief coordinators in this area. As you may know, the Wiyrkomi corporation is trying to move into this area, corrupting the vast tracts of natural beauty found here with their horrible industry. Moreover, the piece of evidence you just brought me seems to indicate there are things at play here far worse than we originally suspected. 

It appears the Wiyrkomi corporation has been hiring mercenaries to stage attacks on their own outposts in the area, attacks which they then frame us for in order to lessen our stature in the public eye. We need to put a stop to this as soon as possible. If we lose our lobbyist support, the Federation is likely to succumb to the deals being proffered by the corrupt Caldari business machine, and this entire area will be turned into just another locale for these corporate bigwigs to ravage. 

An operative of ours, Suho Tatanal, has just returned from a protest on Parchanier II. He's a canny investigator with an eye for details; I want you to bring him the aggregated evidence we've gathered on the case so far, then report back to me. I'll have another assignment for you very soon.

goal: Duci 30 Fedo Blood (150 m³) la protestatari.
Carry 30 Fedo Blood (150 m³) to the protesters.
reward: 'Aura' Warp Core Stabilizer I BPC (3 rulări).
'Aura' Warp Core Stabilizer I BPC (3 runs).
steps: Patru salturi pentru ridicare, livrare și întoarcere.
Four jumps for pickup, delivery and return.
m.brief:
I have just the thing you want.

Okay, Suho's gears have started turning. The evidence you brought him helped greatly. His investigation will be a tremendous boon in our struggle against the corporate monster. We'll have to wait a while to see what he comes up with. I'm not worried about him, though; he works magic when he gets going. 

While we wait, , I have another job for you. Our organization is staging a massive protest tomorrow in the Wiyrkomi Corporation Factory in Jolia, but there seems to have been a slight miscommunication between some of our activists. If you could hop over to the Pend Insurance Investment Bank in Augnais and bring a few bags of fedo blood over to the Wiyrkomi station in Jolia, the Friends of Nature would be much obliged.

goal: Duci 15 Unassembled Drills (180 m³), furate.
Carry 15 stolen Unassembled Drills (180 m³).
reward: 'Peace' Large Remote Armor Repairer BPC (3 rulări).
'Peace' Large Remote Armor Repairer BPC (3 runs).
steps: Cinci salturi pentru ridicare și livrare.
Five jumps for pickup and delivery.
m.brief:
Here is a mission suited for someone of your caliber.

You've proven yourself a trustworthy operative, , so I'm going to give you an assignment slightly more clandestine than the ones you've gotten from me so far. Technically speaking, we're going to be breaking the law here, but I trust you realize we're doing what we're doing for a higher cause. Okay, that said, here goes. 

We just received word from our man on the inside that Wiyrkomi have just ordered 15 high-powered drills for their prospecting operations on Fluekele V, a planet home to many unique, highly endangered varieties of flora and fauna. The drills are currently sitting at the Wiyrkomi factory in Fluekele, awaiting transport to the site where they're intended to be used. 

Our operatives at Fluekele have managed, through their connections with sympathetic station personnel, to pilfer these tools, but we can't keep them hidden for long. We need someone to get the drills safely out to our people in the Poteque station in Augnais. Head out there and show me how devoted to our cause you truly are.

goal: Aduci 200 Soil (300 m³) pentru rezervațiile din Deltole.
Bring 200 Soil (300 m³) for the reservations on Deltole.
reward: 18.000 ISK, plus bonus de timp.
18,000 ISK, plus a time bonus.
steps: Îl cumperi din Dodixie sau îl iei de la Municipal Junkyard Beacon, din Deltole.
Buy it in Dodixie or collect it at the Municipal Junkyard Beacon in Deltole.
Îl predai agentului.
Hand it in.
m.brief:
Yes, I have something for you.

Something urgent just landed on my desk. One of our industrial ships, carrying a load of soil intended for our reservations on Deltole, was shot down yesterday with no survivors. We need to get some soil over there soon, or a large part of our efforts in the area will be wasted. 

Looks like Wiyrkomi are using our alleged aggression against them as an excuse to gun down innocent people whose aims they don't agree with. Can't say I'm surprised, frankly, although I wouldn't have thought they'd go this far. 

Bring 200 units of soil to me, and you will have done us a great service.

goal: Duci Suho Tatanal's Investigation Dossier (1 m³).
Carry Suho Tatanal's Investigation Dossier (1 m³).
reward: Preaux's Letter, 38.000 ISK, standing la Gallente Federation și bonus de timp.
Preaux's Letter, 38,000 ISK, Gallente Federation standing and a time bonus.
tip: Scrisoarea îți trebuie la Ystvia Lamuette.
You need the letter for Ystvia Lamuette.
steps: Patru salturi pentru ridicare și livrare.
Four jumps for pickup and delivery.
m.brief:
For you, my friend, there's always something.

Suho has made a lot of headway in his investigation, and the results are disturbing as all hell. What I'm about to tell you is for your ears only. I want to make that absolutely clear. 

It appears the attacks we've been hearing about against Wiyrkomi assets are not being staged by Wiyrkomi themselves, as we originally suspected. The most recent threads of Suho's investigation are, in fact, pointing squarely toward members of our own organization. I regret to say this, but it appears we have a vigilante rogue in our midst, someone who obviously has no conception of the harm he could be doing to our cause. 

Furthermore, there's compelling evidence to the effect that this party, whoever he or she is, have been in contact with the Serpentis smugglers operating in this area, conspiring to strike against Wiyrkomi assets, murdering people in order to further our cause. Makes me feel dirty just thinking about it. 

This weed in our garden needs to be rooted out, but first we need to learn its identity. The information is being held by Suho at his office in Parchanier. Needless to say, it's far too sensitive to be sent over normal channels, so I need someone I can trust to head out there and bring it back to me. That means you. We need to straighten this situation out, post-haste. 

And remember, not a peep about this to anyone.

story: Preaux coordonează FON în zonă. Cu dovezile lui Pandon, ancheta lui Suho Tatanal scoate la iveală cine atacă de fapt Wiyrkomi.
Preaux coordinates FON in the area. With Pandon's evidence, Suho Tatanal's investigation reveals who is really attacking Wiyrkomi.

goal: Duci Latent Submission Tapes (0,1 m³) de la Auberulle VIII - Moon 1 - Egonics Inc. Development Studio în Parchanier.
Carry the Latent Submission Tapes (0.1 m³) from Auberulle VIII - Moon 1 - Egonics Inc. Development Studio to Parchanier.
reward: 300.000 ISK și muniție Federation Navy Uranium Charge M ca bonus.
300,000 ISK and Federation Navy Uranium Charge M ammo as a bonus.
steps: Ridici benzile și le duci în Parchanier. Bonusul cere sub 30 de minute.
Pick up the tapes and take them to Parchanier. The bonus needs under 30 minutes.
m.brief:
Well, well, what have we here? An eager puppy pilot all raring to go? Asking every stranger to be his friend. Tut, tut, did your mother never tell you not to talk to strangers, ? But now that you're here, what to do with you? Ah, well, maybe you're not as green behind the ears as you seem. Might be I have something for you after all. You might not like it, but it's all I have at the moment. 

What I'm talking about is a simple errand, so it shouldn't tax your skills too much. My friends at Egonics Inc. have come up with new tapes for the Latent Transmitter that I need to collect from them. 

I can see you're curious about the transmitter, but what you don't know can't hurt you. Hm, I guess that's not exactly true, is it? Well, anyway, don't worry: I'll keep you all safe and tucked in. Run this errand for me and perhaps my opinion of you will rise above the level of "haughty indifference." Then I might allow you to sink your teeth into a juicier bone next time around.

goal: Aduci 5 Smuggler Tag (0,5 m³).
Bring 5 Smuggler Tags (0.5 m³).
reward: 'Hooligan' Heavy Ion Blaster I BPC (3 rulări), plus 500.000 ISK bonus în 2 ore.
'Hooligan' Heavy Ion Blaster I BPC (3 runs), plus a 500,000 ISK bonus within 2 hours.
steps: Insignele cad de la contrabandiștii Serpentis din regiune.
The tags drop from Serpentis smugglers in the region.
Le predai agentului.
Hand them in.
m.brief:
Perhaps on your long journey to Auberulle and back you spent the idle minutes wondering what a member of the Angel Cartel was doing here in Algintal? I asked that exact same question when our chief told me he was sending me here. What is there here in Algintal for the Cartel? We have no presence to speak of here and even less authority. The few Angels who frequent the area are loners and nuts, acting pretty much of their own accord. 

Well, to put things bluntly, we want to usurp the stranglehold the Serpentis and Thukkers have on smuggling and other lucrative activities here on the Gallente side of the Federation/Republic borders. The Thukkers, those devious buggers, are putting the latent transmission technology of Egonics Inc. to good use, but I've managed to worm my way into the deal. 

But while I'm engaged in political machinations with the Thukkers and Egonics, the Serpentis are running rampant. I need you to take them down a peck or two. One of their main areas of operation is over in the Skeleton Comet complex in Deltole. They wrenched the place from Federation hands some years ago and now consider it their own little haven. Hitting them there would send a clear message that there's a new player in the sandbox and that they'd better watch out. 

To put it simply: Go over there, locate some Serpentis smugglers, and pop them. Return with the smuggler tags they drop to claim your reward ... and of course glowing praises from me.

goal: Aduci Shattered Forgery Tools (1 m³) din fabrica Serpentis.
Bring the Shattered Forgery Tools (1 m³) from the Serpentis factory.
reward: 'Mafia' Kinetic Energized Membrane BPC (3 rulări) și Social Adaptation Chip - Basic ca bonus.
'Mafia' Kinetic Energized Membrane BPC (3 runs) and Social Adaptation Chip - Basic as a bonus.
steps: Varianta rapidă: distrugi Serpentis Repackaging Factory, iei uneltele și pleci.
Quick route: destroy the Serpentis Repackaging Factory, loot the tools and leave.
m.brief:
The Serpentis are not taking us seriously enough, it seems. My spies tell me their leadership thinks your strike was a one-time occurance that they need not concern themselves with. And more importantly, it did little to weaken their grip on the smuggling in the constellation. So we need to take more drastic steps to show them that we mean business. 

With all the hype surrounding the Wiyrkomi's presence here in Algintal, smugglers have to be extra careful. The Serpentis are no idiots, and they've reacted fast. They built a huge repackaging factory in the middle of nowhere, where they ship all their illegal goods to be repacked into something looking a bit less suspicious. I understand they learnt the technique from the Thukkers, who've done the same for years. Be that as it may. 

What I'm asking of you is no small feat. Take out the repackaging factory, and the Serpentis will not only become very aware of our presence here, but their operation will take a severe hit. My informant has given me the coordinates of the repackaging factory, but I have only very limited information about the defenses around the installation. No doubt they're formidable, so taking a few friends along is a good idea. But I'm pretty sure the defense systems are not yet fully operational since the factory only recently opened.

goal: Aduci Strike Force Gear (2 m³).
Bring the Strike Force Gear (2 m³).
reward: 1.000 Federation Navy Lead Charge L și 'Bribe' Explosive Energized Membrane BPC ca bonus în 2 ore.
1,000 Federation Navy Lead Charge L and 'Bribe' Explosive Energized Membrane BPC as a bonus within 2 hours.
tip: Agentul e Angel Cartel: îți trebuie standing cu ei, iar recompensa de standing merge tot la ei.
This agent is Angel Cartel: you need their standing, and the standing reward goes to them.
steps: Iei echipamentul din locația misiunii și îl duci agentului.
Take the gear from the mission location to the agent.
m.brief:
Oh, we got their attention now, ! The Serpentis are seething, and it's all thanks to you. There's only problem: Now that the Serpentis know that we Angels are barging in, they're planning to retaliate. How very idiotic of them! Heh. Well, of course we must counter their counter-threats. 

My most loyal and reliable source within the Serpentis tells me that an elite strike force is arriving from Fountain. I'm already quivering in my boots, as you can see. No, seriously, the fools have made one grave error. The strike force's gear arrived ahead of the team itself. It is now sitting deep inside the Skeleton Comet complex over in Deltole. "Only by exploiting the errors of others can we enlighten the world," my mother always told me, and who am I to defy my mother, eh? We must act quickly. 

Go to the Skeleton Comet complex, locate the Serpentis Command Outpost, and destroy it. Then return with the strike force's gear to me. That should paralyze their whole operation. 

This is an important mission, which will have significant impact on your faction standings.

story: Trex e agent Angel Cartel trimis în Algintal să ia contrabanda din mâinile Serpentis.
Trex is an Angel Cartel agent sent to Algintal to take the smuggling trade away from the Serpentis.

goal: Aduci Wiyrkomi Voucher (1 m³).
Bring the Wiyrkomi Voucher (1 m³).
reward: 100.000 ISK, plus 50.000 ISK bonus în 1 oră.
100,000 ISK, plus a 50,000 ISK bonus within 1 hour.
steps: Voucher-ul îl primești la ultima misiune a lui Aakeo Oshaima.
You get the voucher from Aakeo Oshaima's last mission.
Nu accepta fără voucher în cargo.
Do not accept without the voucher in cargo.
m.brief: As a matter of fact I do have something suited for you, . But first you're going to have to supply me with a voucher from one of the other agents around here. I recommend stopping by the Survey Station, they need some help there as well.

goal: Aduci Alarus Ekire's Insignia (0,1 m³).
Bring Alarus Ekire's Insignia (0.1 m³).
reward: 100.000 ISK, plus 500.000 ISK bonus în 6 ore.
100,000 ISK, plus a 500,000 ISK bonus within 6 hours.
steps: Insigna e în al doilea buzunar din Contested Gallente Azure Canyon.
The insignia is in the second pocket of Contested Gallente Azure Canyon.
O duci agentului.
Take it to the agent.
m.brief:
Veko?? You will address me as sir, peon! I will not have some rug-rat insult me like that in public ...

Now where were we? Ah yes, your mission. Well I have a number of nuisances for you to 'take care of', and the first in line is a Gallentean called Alarus Ekire. He's the commander of the military arm of FON, the cowardly tree-huggers who've been sabotaging our operations in Federation space ever since we made that deal with the Gallente government. With him out of the picture, FON's terrorist groups will become more disorganized and less deadly, until they find a suitable replacement anyway.

You'll probably find Alarus in the Tourist area of Azure Canyon in Colelie. They've apparently made a pact with Serpentis to defend that area of deadspace against our attempts to move our own people in there. So you might have a bit of a fight on your hands, but I'm sure you'll manage.

Bring back something to prove that Alarus is no more, and I'll give you your reward.

goal: Aduci Recruitment Center Data Log (0,1 m³).
Bring the Recruitment Center Data Log (0.1 m³).
reward: 'Distributor' Guidance Disruptor BPC (3 rulări), plus 500.000 ISK bonus în 6 ore.
'Distributor' Guidance Disruptor BPC (3 runs), plus a 500,000 ISK bonus within 6 hours.
steps: Varianta rapidă: distrugi turnul și iei jurnalul.
Quick route: destroy the tower and loot the log.
m.brief:
Your second mission is to investigate the theft of a batch of drills we ordered recently. They were being shipped to our survey station in Colelie when their convoy was ambushed by unknown assailants. We have so far not retrieved any witnesses, and have not found any evidence at the crime scene linking FON or Serpentis to the attack. However gut feeling tells me it must have been FON. Serpentis would have taken the crew and held them for ransom, but we have found no evidence that they are still alive.

I'd like you to get to the bottom of this, . Fly to the FON recruitment center in Fluekele and see what you can find there. Return to me with anything that might implicate their involvement in the attack.

Dismissed.

goal: Aduci 18 Temko Mercenaries (90 m³).
Bring 18 Temko Mercenaries (90 m³).
reward: 'Corporate' Light Electron Blaster I BPC și 1.000 Federation Navy Tungsten Charge S ca bonus.
'Corporate' Light Electron Blaster I BPC and 1,000 Federation Navy Tungsten Charge S as a bonus.
steps: Mercenarii sunt în al patrulea buzunar din Contested Gallente Azure Canyon.
The mercenaries are in the fourth pocket of Contested Gallente Azure Canyon.
Îi duci agentului.
Take them to the agent.
m.brief:
The next job is going to be a bit more difficult than your last two assignments. This time I want you to infiltrate the Azure Canyon complex and find a place called 'The Black Market'. We have reliable information that a regiment of Temko mercenaries are being held in a prison facility there. They were sent on a reconnaissance mission into the complex a few days ago, but never returned.

I advise you to avoid a direct confrontation with the Serpentis forces at the Black Market. Just grab the mercenaries and flee, they are your number one priority in this mission. We are running out of mercenaries already, we can't afford to lose these Temko personnel.

I also recommend that you finish this assignment in a timely manner. My time is precious.

goal: Distrugi navele FON.
Destroy the FON ships.
reward: Ocular Filter - Basic, plus 500.000 ISK bonus în 6 ore.
Ocular Filter - Basic, plus a 500,000 ISK bonus within 6 hours.
tip: Ataci FON: pierzi puțin standing cu Gallente Federation.
You attack FON: you lose a little Gallente Federation standing.
steps: Sunt două camere. Omori navele și te întorci.
There are two rooms. Kill the ships and return.
m.brief: Something urgent just came up. The Survey Station in Colelie was attacked by FON, probably in retaliation for our recent actions against them. Many of our people have been killed, and more importantly we lost billions of ISK worth of equipment. This heinous act must not go unpunished. Our surveillance teams are currently on their tail, and I would like you to take care of them. I'll supply you with a bookmark to their approximate location, you do the rest. And do hurry this time, you can hang around the cafe lounge some other time.

goal: Aduci 10 Zemnar (2 m³).
Bring 10 Zemnar (2 m³).
reward: 1.000 Caldari Navy Antimatter Charge M, plus 600.000 ISK bonus în 4 ore.
1,000 Caldari Navy Antimatter Charge M, plus a 600,000 ISK bonus within 4 hours.
steps: Zemnar e în Pend Insurance Storage Bin, în Fluekele.
The Zemnar is in the Pend Insurance Storage Bin in Fluekele.
Îl duci agentului.
Take it to the agent.
m.brief:
Now I want you to get us some Zemnar. The Survey Station in Colelie suffered heavy casualties, and their antibiotic supplies are stretched to the limit. On top of that there has been a viral outbreak which could cause many deaths if we don't get them the Zemnar they need fast. Now a few surveyors and engineers are expendable, but this threatens the entire outpost and could compromise our operation in Colelie!

You'll find a stock of Zemnar not far from the Pend Insurance station in Fluekele, in their storage bin. They refuse to share it with us, probably as a result of pressure from the various nature lover groups which have been protesting our presence here. So we are going to have to take it by force. Do whatever it takes to get a hold of that Zemnar, and drop it off at our factory in this system. One of my lackeys will transport it to Colelie. Just don't reveal who you're working for, to anyone! Now get moving!

goal: Aduci Eule Vitrauze's DNA (0,1 m³).
Bring Eule Vitrauze's DNA (0.1 m³).
reward: Veko Tallaja's Voucher și Ocular Filter - Standard ca bonus în 4 ore.
Veko Tallaja's Voucher and Ocular Filter - Standard as a bonus within 4 hours.
tip: Voucher-ul îți trebuie la Gara Kort.
You need the voucher for Gara Kort.
steps: Eule e la balizele Central Administration.
Eule is at the Central Administration beacon.
Distrugi nava și iei ADN-ul.
Destroy the ship and loot the DNA.
m.brief:
You've proven to be fairly reliable so far, , so I believe I can trust you for a rather sensitive assignment. We have a traitor in our ranks, or to be more precise in the ranks of the Temko mercenaries we hired. His name is Eule Vitrauze and he's apparently working for Friends of Nature on the side. We believe he's the reason the last Temko operation in the Azure Canyon complex failed.

I would ask the Temko to deal with him themselves, but Gara believes that if we make an outsider do the job and make it seem like we weren't involved in his death then our agent within FON will not be compromised. You'll probably find Eule orbiting a security outpost inside the Central Administration complex. But don't worry, the other Temko ships will not come to his aid, all you have to do is face him one-on-one, and then return to me once his ship has been turned to dust.

Dismissed. This is an important mission, which will have significant impact on your faction standings.

story: Veko conduce operațiunea Wiyrkomi din Algintal și vrea capul liderului FON. Intri doar cu voucher-ul de la Aakeo Oshaima.
Veko runs the Wiyrkomi operation in Algintal and wants the FON leader's head. You get in only with the voucher from Aakeo Oshaima.

goal: Aduci Preaux's Letter (1 m³).
Bring Preaux's Letter (1 m³).
reward: 206.000 ISK, plus bonus de timp.
206,000 ISK, plus a time bonus.
steps: Scrisoarea o primești la ultima misiune a lui Preaux Gallot.
You get the letter from Preaux Gallot's last mission.
O predai agentului.
Hand it in.
m.brief: Do you have something for me? A letter, perhaps?

goal: Aduci Colelian Spider Spruce (4 m³), o plantă rară.
Bring a Colelian Spider Spruce (4 m³), a rare plant.
reward: 28.000 ISK și 'Entrepreneur' Remote Sensor Booster I BPC (3 rulări) ca bonus.
28,000 ISK and 'Entrepreneur' Remote Sensor Booster I BPC (3 runs) as a bonus.
steps: Șase salturi pentru ridicare și livrare.
Six jumps for pickup and delivery.
Pentru BPC ai doar 10 minute. Ia o navă foarte rapidă.
You have only 10 minutes for the BPC. Take a very fast ship.
m.brief:
Nice to meet you. My name is Ystvia Lamuette, and I'm one of the chief coordinators of FON's activities in this constellation. Preaux tells me great things about you; apparently you can be of great help in our struggle. 

I'd like to get a feel for you myself, nonetheless. Show me how fast you can be. There's a rare specimen of plant, a Colelian spider spruce, sitting in the Core Complexion Warehouse at Deltole. Bring it back to me within 15 minutes and I'll reward you handsomely. Then we can talk about what needs to be done for our organization.

goal: Distrugi avanpostul Serpentis.
Destroy the Serpentis outpost.
reward: 75.000 ISK, plus bonus de timp.
75,000 ISK, plus a time bonus.
steps: Un crucișător e de ajuns.
A cruiser is enough.
Distrugi drona-păianjen și avanpostul. Turelele nu sunt obligatorii, dar scad daunele.
Destroy the spider drone and the outpost. The sentries are optional but reduce incoming damage.
m.brief:
Nice work on the spider spruce. 

So here's the situation, then. There's a guy named Alarus Ekire. He's the most militant person within our ranks - a real piece of work. Most of us have disagreed with his methods in the past, but he has an authoritative air about him which rouses admiration in the weak. For this reason he's never short of followers, and has managed to maintain his position within FON. 

It has now been brought to our attention, due in no small part to your diligent work, that Ekire is the weed in our garden, the one that's been causing all this trouble in the past few weeks. We have to get rid of him, but we can't kill him. If the Wiyrkomi spin doctors have the opportunity to make him into a figurehead, we're finished. So we need to try and smoke him out, lure him into revealing himself. 

We need to lay the groundwork first, though, and try to undo some of the damage he's caused. First off, we need to send the clear-cut message that FON do not wish to cast their lot with known cutthroats and murderers. To this end, we need to put our own propaganda machine to work. 

There is a Serpentis outpost in one of the outlying systems. According to our intel, no detachments are stationed there at present. I want you to head out there, destroy the outpost, neutralize any opposition you may find, and report back to me. One of our other operatives will shadow you to the area and record the attack, so we can spin this to our advantage and hopefully countermand any bad publicity. 

Go to it. Good luck.

goal: Cureți o zonă de nave FON și mercenari.
Clear an area of FON ships and mercenaries.
reward: 147.000 ISK, plus bonus de timp.
147,000 ISK, plus a time bonus.
steps: Un crucișător e de ajuns.
A cruiser is enough.
Omoară întâi Mercenary Commanders: lovesc mult mai tare decât restul.
Kill the Mercenary Commanders first: they hit much harder than the rest.
m.brief:
The photographer who recorded your strike has given his footage to the post-production people. We should see something from them soon. 

We've decided there's no choice but to take the Ekire matter into our own hands. According to our intelligence, he has something like four hundred men under his command, conducting his terrorist operations. Some of them are our own FON activists, others are mercenaries - Navy rejects, working for the highest bidder. 

The Deltole system is a key tactical location; many of Ekire's mercs are stationed at an outpost there, and we have solid reports that they're preparing to stage some sort of attack on the Wiyrkomi factory there. This must not be allowed to happen. 

We need you to conduct a pre-emptive strike on the outpost, eliminating any personnel you find in the vicinity. As you're not flying under our flag, there should be nothing linking you to the FON, and indeed there can't be - we would never survive the political backlash. Please know that we don't undertake the killing of people lightly. It's our hope that this is the greatly lesser of two evils. 

Report back to me when the deed is done. I'll be here.

goal: Duci Aortal Purifier, echipament medical.
Carry the Aortal Purifier, a piece of medical equipment.
reward: 'Investor' Tracking Disruptor I BPC (3 rulări) ca bonus.
'Investor' Tracking Disruptor I BPC (3 runs) as a bonus.
steps: Opt salturi pentru ridicare, livrare și întoarcere. Poți preda de la distanță.
Eight jumps for pickup, delivery and return. You can complete remotely.
Pentru BPC ai doar 10 minute.
You have only 10 minutes for the BPC.
m.brief:
We need to move fast. The situation is evolving in unexpected ways. No no, don't sit down. I'll explain this as fast as I can. 

While you were out on your last assignment, Ekire himself was mortally wounded in an assassination attempt by unknown assailants. We suspect Wiyrkomi, of course - they have the most to gain from his death, both politically and pragmatically speaking. Likewise, if he dies we stand to take a massive political blow. 

Ekire is currently at the Egonics Inc. Development Studio at Parchanier V, bleeding severely and fading fast. Due to a rare blood condition he contracted in an Umokkan jungle while serving as a Legion marine a decade back, transfusion via normal means would kill him. For the procedure to be at all possible he needs an aortal purifier, a seldom-used piece of medical equipment which they don't have at that particular station's med bay. 

I need you to head out to Auderne immediately, to the Poteque Pharmaceuticals Biotech Production plant there, and pick up what may be the only aortal purifier available in this whole damn constellation, then bring it out to the doctors in Parchanier. His life - and our success in our campaign here - may very well depend on your speed in this matter. 

Go! Fly swiftly.

goal: Duci 175 Wheat (201 m³).
Carry 175 Wheat (201 m³).
reward: 'Marketeer' Tracking Computer BPC (3 rulări) și standing la Gallente Federation.
'Marketeer' Tracking Computer BPC (3 runs) and Gallente Federation standing.
steps: Ridici grâul și îl predai.
Pick up the wheat and deliver it.
m.brief:
Alarus Ekire is safe and sound, thanks to you. We've uncovered solid evidence of what he's been up to in the sector, and we're making arrangements to have him delivered to the proper authorities safe and sound. 

There's only one loose end that needs tying up, after which we can go back to business as usual, sticking it to the man. You see, I have this large shipment of wheat here that desperately needs to get dumped in the cogs of the Wiyrkomi station in Fluekele… *grins wickedly* 

How about it, friend? 

----
Completed:

The Friends of Nature extend their thanks to you for your help in this whole situation. You've been a tremendous asset to our organization. Thanks to you, we'll be able to continue our struggle to help the natural wonders of Algintal remain just that.

story: Ystvia continuă lupta FON după Preaux Gallot: salvează plante rare și dă afară Serpentis din regiune.
Ystvia carries on the FON fight after Preaux Gallot: saving rare plants and driving the Serpentis out of the region.

goal: Aduci 3 Ship Logs (3 m³) și pornești lanțul The Forgery.
Bring 3 Ship Logs (3 m³) to start The Forgery chain.
reward: 10.000 ISK, plus 10.000 ISK bonus.
10,000 ISK, plus a 10,000 ISK bonus.
tip: La Framed! trebuie să treci de camera cu drone din Skeleton Comet. Distruge FON Operation Station și cele două Vast Drone Hive ca să nu mai reapară inamicii, sau cumpără itemele de pe contracte.
For Framed! you must get past the drone room in Skeleton Comet. Destroy the FON Operation Station and both Vast Drone Hives so enemies stop respawning, or buy the items on contracts.
steps: Ship Logs le primești ca bonus la ultima misiune a lui Iliere Angetyn.
You get the Ship Logs as the bonus of Iliere Angetyn's last mission.
Le predai agentului. Bonusul de timp e de 10 minute.
Hand them in. The time bonus is 10 minutes.
Lanțul continuă cu misiuni de nivel 4 în Contested Gallente Skeleton Comet.
The chain continues with level 4 missions in Contested Gallente Skeleton Comet.
m.brief:
Ah, they're from Angetyn. Excellent! Yes, I can doctor them for him. Not that I haven't done so many times in the past, mind you. But what to do with you? Angetyn only sends me pilots he thinks highly of, so let's see if you're as talented as he thinks.

By the way, I have another mission prepared for you already...

goal: Aduci Isone Flosin's Corpse (1 m³), prietena agentului.
Bring Isone Flosin's Corpse (1 m³), the agent's friend.
reward: Isone Flosin's DNA, 0,55% standing la Gallente Federation și bonus de timp.
Isone Flosin's DNA, 0.55% Gallente Federation standing and a time bonus.
tip: ADN-ul îți trebuie la Aminn Flosin.
You need the DNA for Aminn Flosin.
steps: Iei poarta de lângă agent spre Contested Gallente Roden Shipyard's Outpost.
Take the gate next to the agent into Contested Gallente Roden Shipyard's Outpost.
Site-ul primește doar crucișătoare T1 și de pirați. Inamicii sunt Serpentis și drone rogue.
The site allows only T1 and pirate cruisers. Enemies are Serpentis and rogue drones.
Găsești corpul și îl aduci agentului.
Find the body and bring it to the agent.
m.brief:
! Please help me. My friend, Isone Flosin, has gone missing. We were just cruising around on our shuttles within the inner areas of this complex when we were attacked by rogue drones! I managed to escape, but in my haste I didn't notice that Isone had stopped following me. I need to know what happened to her, and my ship is in no shape to venture back in there. Please, you have to help me. Find Isone and bring her back! 

----
Mission completed:

How horrible! I never thought something like this could happen here. I don't know how I will be able to face her parents, they told us never to venture any further into the complex than the first area but we just couldn't resist. I'm so ashamed ...

Could you at least talk to Isone's father, in the Central Administration complex in Fluekele. Tell him I sent you, Isone's DNA will prove that. Please tell him the whole story, I'm just too traumatized at the moment to meet him myself. Thank you.

goal: Aduci Isone Flosin's DNA (0,1 m³).
Bring Isone Flosin's DNA (0.1 m³).
reward: 350.000 ISK, plus bonus de timp.
350,000 ISK, plus a time bonus.
steps: ADN-ul îl primești la misiunea lui Nilla Elermare.
You get the DNA from Nilla Elermare's mission.
Îl predai agentului.
Hand it in.
m.brief:
Have you seen my daughter, Isone Flosin, by any chance? She went missing some time ago while inside the Roden Shipyard Outpost in Fluekele. If you find her, tell her I'm very displeased and she should come see me immediately.

I heard Nilla Elermare was asking about Isone, too. You may want to start by talking to her.

goal: Îl aduci pe Jark Makon (1 m³), ucigașul.
Bring Jark Makon (1 m³), the killer.
reward: Un BPC storyline aleatoriu (3 rulări) și 1.000 Federation Navy Plutonium Charge S.
A random storyline BPC (3 runs) and 1,000 Federation Navy Plutonium Charge S.
steps: Jark e în Contested Gallente Roden Shipyard's Outpost. Site-ul primește doar crucișătoare T1 și de facțiune.
Jark is in Contested Gallente Roden Shipyard's Outpost. The site allows only T1 and faction cruisers.
Distrugi nava și iei prizonierul.
Destroy the ship and take the prisoner.
m.brief: Isone must be avenged. The Serpentis must be responsible for her death. We've catered to their needs for far too long. I couldn't believe my ears when they told me we were supposed to treat the Serpentis living in the outpost as comrades! But enough of this rambling, back to the mission at hand. I want you to infiltrate the Corelum Drughouse again and look for clues which might lead to whoever is behind her death. I know of one person who might know, he serves as a guard at the Serpentis storage facility inside that deadspace area. His name is Jark something. Good luck.

goal: Duci lucrurile lui Isone (Large Sealed Cargo Containers, 100 m³) la mama ei.
Carry Isone's belongings (Large Sealed Cargo Containers, 100 m³) to her mother.
reward: 2 'Hustler' Heavy Neutron Blaster I și 1.000 Federation Navy Iron Charge M.
2 'Hustler' Heavy Neutron Blaster I and 1,000 Federation Navy Iron Charge M.
steps: Paisprezece salturi dus-întors.
Fourteen jumps there and back.
m.brief:
While I interrogate the prisoner, I would like you to bring Isone's things to her mother on Jel I - Roden Shipyards Warehouse as well as a note from me describing the situation. I am simply too busy to make the trip myself anytime soon, and I know she will manage to find some comfort in receiving Isone's things as a memento of her short life.

Everything you need to transport is in these sealed containers. Take care not to lose any, they might not be very valuable on the market but to me and my wife they are priceless.

goal: Distrugi Serpentis Science Lab.
Destroy the Serpentis Science Lab.
reward: Un implant de atribut +4 aleatoriu, 0,35% standing la Gallente Federation și un implant Hardwiring de 3% ca bonus în 6 ore.
A random +4 attribute implant, 0.35% Gallente Federation standing and a 3% Hardwiring implant as a bonus within 6 hours.
steps: Opt salturi dus-întors. Buzunarul nu are poartă.
Eight jumps there and back. The pocket has no gate.
Varianta rapidă: distrugi laboratorul, la 90 km de punctul de sosire.
Quick route: destroy the lab, 90 km from warp-in.
m.brief:
I've managed to extract the information I needed out of poor Jark. It seems that my Isone was accidentally killed by 'rogue' drone ships guarding the Serpentis drug storage area. Now I cannot really blame a computer for her death, but I can blame it's creators. In fact these drones are not 'rogue' at all, they are just programmed to act like them. An ingenious gallente scientist working for the Serpentis actually managed to reprogram these rogue drones to serve Salvador Sarpati and his wild schemes. The Federation Navy also tends to ignore areas infested with rogue drones, which is beneficial to the Serpentis.

Fortunately Jark knew of a Serpentis science lab in Colelie which is behind all of the drones in the Roden Shipyard complex. I want this science lab destroyed. Whoever resides in there is undoubtedly responsible for Isone's death, and must pay the ultimate price.

story: Aminn e ruda lui Isone Flosin, ucisă de Serpentis la Roden Shipyard's Outpost, și vrea răzbunare.
Aminn is a relative of Isone Flosin, killed by the Serpentis at Roden Shipyard's Outpost, and wants revenge.

goal: Aduci FON-Wiyrkomi Data Chip (0,1 m³), de la o stație la un salt.
Bring the FON-Wiyrkomi Data Chip (0.1 m³) from a station one jump away.
reward: 40.000 ISK, plus bonus de timp.
40,000 ISK, plus a time bonus.
steps: Ridici cipul și îl aduci agentului.
Pick up the chip and bring it to the agent.
m.brief:
I have just the thing you want.

My name's Astroo Opeau, and I'm FON's propaganda honcho. I could have some hoity-toity title, sure, but I like to keep things down-to-earth and formalities just get in the way. 

I have a few things I could use a big strapping capsuleer like you for, if you're interested. Tidbits of information are in constant swirl around this constellation, like electrons in an atom, and we need to cast as many nets as far and wide as possible if we want to stand a chance against the corporate behemoth of Wiyrkomi. 

One of my eyes in the Audaerne system just got a recording of one of Wiyrkomi's brass indulging in some, shall we say, languorous activities in a pleasure resort not far from here. Head over to the Modern Finances Investment Bank in Audaerne and pick up the tape for me, and we'll see what we can do with it.

goal: Duci Wiyrkomi Scandal Holoreel (0,5 m³).
Carry the Wiyrkomi Scandal Holoreel (0.5 m³).
reward: 18.000 ISK, plus bonus de timp.
18,000 ISK, plus a time bonus.
steps: Agentul îți dă înregistrarea. O predai la destinație.
The agent gives you the reel. Deliver it.
m.brief:
have just the thing you want.

The tape you brought back of the Wiyrkomi scumbag proved ideal for our purposes. We've made a holoreel of the "incident," and we need it copied and distributed to key points in the constellation so we can mount a full-scale broadcast offensive against the bastard. 

Take this holoreel over to my distributor in the Fluekele system. We'll see how big a shot the bigshot is after this.

goal: Duci 4 Crates of Silicate Glass (200 m³), la 3 salturi.
Carry 4 Crates of Silicate Glass (200 m³), 3 jumps away.
reward: 'Boss' Remote Sensor Booster I BPC (3 rulări).
'Boss' Remote Sensor Booster I BPC (3 runs).
steps: Agentul îți dă lăzile. Poți preda de la distanță.
The agent gives you the crates. You can complete remotely.
m.brief:
Yes, I have something for you.

Well, our little gambit worked. The bigwig's been driven out of Wiyrkomi and a blow's been struck for the little guy. Thanks so much for your help. 

One last favor, if you will. Some of our guys are founding an environmentalist education facility on Deltole III - Moon 1 - Core Complexion Inc. Warehouse and they need some construction materials brought over. You think you could do this for me? I'll pay you well.

story: Astroo vrea să facă publice dovezile despre legăturile dintre FON și Wiyrkomi.
Astroo wants to make public the evidence about the links between FON and Wiyrkomi.

goal: Aduci Onreun's Crash (0,2 m³), ca test pentru mercenarii locali.
Bring Onreun's Crash (0.2 m³) as a test for the local mercenaries.
reward: 500.000 ISK, plus bonus de timp.
500,000 ISK, plus a time bonus.
steps: Un salt, prin lowsec. O navetă sau o fregată cu instawarp e de ajuns.
One jump, through lowsec. A shuttle or an instawarp frigate is enough.
Mercenarii nu sunt prea buni. De obicei nu te ating.
The mercenaries are not very good. They usually do not catch you.
m.brief:
Ok, I'm here on official business from Federal Intelligence Office. I was sent here to inspect the Central Command station of Wiyrkomi in Algintal, and as a side project keep an eye out on Roden Shipyards, who've been Wiyrkomi's primary allies in Federation space.

Now my first objective is to make sure there isn't any illegal trade going on here. I haven't been able to discover any contraband during my stay here, but I'd like to test something before I fill my first report. I'd like to see how well prepared the Temko mercenaries guarding this installation are concerning illegal goods. So I want somebody inconspicuous to try to infiltrate the compound with drugs inside of his cargo hold. You look like just the person for that assignment.

You'll find the drugs on Decon VI - Moon 10 - Federal Intelligence Office Assembly Plant, simply grab them and bring them to me. Federation customs officials won't touch you, they know it's my crash. Temko don't however, hence the test. If you get attacked by Temko, then flee and come back later, I'll explain everything to them once the test is complete.

goal: Aduci Wiyrkomi Data Chip (0,1 m³).
Bring the Wiyrkomi Data Chip (0.1 m³).
reward: 500.000 ISK și muniție.
500,000 ISK and ammo.
steps: La sosire sunt două porți. Ia-o pe cea cu avertisment, Danger: Keep Out.
At warp-in there are two gates. Take the one with the warning, Danger: Keep Out.
Depozitul se deschide după ce omori dronele. Iei cipul.
The warehouse unlocks once the drones die. Take the chip.
m.brief:
For your second assignment I'd like you to investigate a Wiyrkomi storage facility in Jolia. I stumbled upon some documents revealing it's location while inside the Central Command control tower. They were a bit startled when I informed them of what I had discovered, so I'm thinking something fishy might be afloat there.

I will upload a bookmark into your journal which sends you to a deadspace pocket. Inside you'll find this storage facility. Take a look inside, and tell me what you find. Thanks. 

----

Completed:

So they replaced the sign on the acceleration gate leading to the storage facility with one leading to a drone hive? This will go straight into my report. I'll also take a look at this data chip you found in the storage facility itself, but I'm sure there's nothing of interest inside it. If they knew you were coming and managed to replace the sign on the acceleration gates, they probably had enough time to empty the storage containers as well. But good work anyway.

goal: Aduci Serpentis Data Chip Decoder (0,1 m³).
Bring the Serpentis Data Chip Decoder (0.1 m³).
reward: Un BPC storyline aleatoriu (3 rulări) și muniție.
A random storyline BPC (3 runs) and ammo.
steps: Îl cauți pe Pourpas Aunten în centurile de asteroizi din Jolia. Zboară un crucișător cu două fregate.
Look for Pourpas Aunten in the asteroid belts of Jolia. It flies a cruiser with two frigates.
Îl distrugi și iei decodorul. Se găsește și pe contracte.
Destroy it and loot the decoder. It is also on contracts.
m.brief:
It's now time to turn our eyes towards Roden Shipyards. They have always been a shady corporation, and their alliance with Wiyrkomi certainly raised a few eyebrows. I was specifically told to find out exactly what part they play in all of this.

Yesterday I stumbled upon something that may be of vital importance to my investigation. My ship's sensors picked up an encoded transmission from a Roden Shipyards outpost located in Fluekele. I haven't been able to make much of it yet, but with the proper data decoder I will be able to tell what the contents of this transmission are. So my assignment to you is to find such a decoder and bring it to me. My suggestion is to scour the asteroid belts of Jolia, there is a Serpentis agent there called Pourpas Aunten who is renowned for decoding CONCORD and Federation Navy signals. If there's anyone in the galaxy which has the decoder I need, it's him.

goal: Aduci Maqeri Camcen's DNA (0,1 m³).
Bring Maqeri Camcen's DNA (0.1 m³).
reward: 'Bootleg' Remote Sensor Booster BPC (3 rulări) și un BPC storyline aleatoriu ca bonus în 4 ore și 50 de minute.
'Bootleg' Remote Sensor Booster BPC (3 runs) and a random storyline BPC as a bonus within 4 hours 50 minutes.
steps: Maqeri e în Contested Gallente Roden Shipyard's Outpost. Site-ul primește până la crucișătoare T1. O fregată de asalt merge bine.
Maqeri is in Contested Gallente Roden Shipyard's Outpost. The site allows up to T1 cruisers. An assault frigate works well.
Inamicii îți scad raza de țintire cu damp.
The enemies damp your targeting range.
m.brief:
I've managed to decode the transmission but I can't make much of it. The interesting part though is that it originates from Maqeri Camcen's ship within the Contested Gallente Roden Shipyard Outpost. I checked my database and Maqeri is in fact rumored to be part of the Angel Cartel. What the Cartel would be doing in a Roden Shipyard Outpost in Fluekele is beyond me, unless there are Serpentis there. My best guess is that there are Serpentis operating inside the same deadspace are as Roden Shipyard, and this Maqeri is some sort of envoy from the Cartel.

Anyway I must get to the bottom of this. Meet with this Maqeri fellow and see if you can convince him to have a chat with me in person. If he's hostile and refuses to speak with you then you have my full authority to eliminate him. If you choose the gun rather than your wit, then at least bring evidence of his demise to me.

Dismissed.

goal: Duci raportul final (Reports, 0,1 m³) la Decon VI - Moon 10 - Federal Intelligence Office Assembly Plant.
Carry the final report (Reports, 0.1 m³) to Decon VI - Moon 10 - Federal Intelligence Office Assembly Plant.
reward: Un implant de atribut +3 aleatoriu, 500.000 ISK și 1,9% standing la Gallente Federation.
A random +3 attribute implant, 500,000 ISK and 1.9% Gallente Federation standing.
steps: Șase salturi, dintre care unul prin lowsec. O navetă sau o fregată cu instawarp e de ajuns.
Six jumps, one of them through lowsec. A shuttle or an instawarp frigate is enough.
m.brief:
Now that I've finished my report, I'd like you to transport it to my boss on Decon VI - Moon 10 - Federal Intelligence Office Assembly Plant. The information inside is confidential, so please do not even think about reading the document.

Once the report is safely in the hands of my superiors, then you will have your reward. Good luck.

story: Onreun e inspector federal și cercetează ce face de fapt Wiyrkomi în Algintal.
Onreun is a federal inspector looking into what Wiyrkomi is really doing in Algintal.

goal: Aduci 4.700 Dense Veldspar (470 m³).
Bring 4,700 Dense Veldspar (470 m³).
reward: 500.000 ISK, plus bonus de timp.
500,000 ISK, plus a time bonus.
steps: Îl minezi cu o Venture sau îl cumperi din piață.
Mine it with a Venture or buy it on the market.
Îl predai agentului.
Hand it in.
m.brief: I was sent here by Roden Shipyards to help gather ore for Wiyrkomi's construction workers in the Survey Station. They're hoarding up minerals and ore for the eventual construction of the power plant in Azure Canyon. The only problem is I'm not much of a combat pilot and I didn't expect there to be such an abundance of pirates festering the asteroid belts in Colelie. So I was thinking, maybe you could help me out a little? I'll split the earnings I would have received for doing the same job with you. What do you say, ?

goal: Aduci 2.000 Omber (1.200 m³) și omori Serpentis din câmp.
Bring 2,000 Omber (1,200 m³) and kill the Serpentis in the field.
reward: 'Investor' Tracking Disruptor I BPC (3 rulări) și muniție.
'Investor' Tracking Disruptor I BPC (3 runs) and ammo.
steps: Omorârea Serpentis face parte din obiectiv. Nu ajunge doar minereul.
Killing the Serpentis is part of the objective. The ore alone is not enough.
Minezi sau aduci Omber și îl predai.
Mine or bring the Omber and hand it in.
m.brief:
Your second job is to get me 4 portions of Omber, or 2000 units to be exact. You might find it a bit difficult to find that type or ore around these parts, but you're in luck. I know of a great spot to mine some. You see I was in Fluekele a few days ago scouting for some ore, this is before I decided the job was too dangerous for me, and I managed to stumble upon a small cluttering of asteroids in the middle of nowhere. And lo and behold, there was an asteroid brimming with minerals, which on closer inspection was Omber! Unfortunately as soon as I had discovered this magnificent find, a group of Serpentis who had been following me attacked. I believe they were being led by that scoundrel Ansedon Blat, I could be wrong though. I met him while I was at the Roden Shipyards Outpost in Fluekele, and he must have decided to follow me when I left on my expedition. That backstabber and his goons must pay.

On second thought, I'm not satisfied with just getting the omber. You'll have to kill those Serpentis bastards too, if you find them. Return to me with the omber when you're done.

goal: Duci Reports (0,1 m³) la o stație din lowsec.
Carry the Reports (0.1 m³) to a lowsec station.
reward: 2 'Meditation' Medium Armor Repairer I, 2% standing la Gallente Federation și un implant de atribut +3 ca bonus.
2 'Meditation' Medium Armor Repairer I, 2% Gallente Federation standing and a +3 attribute implant as a bonus.
steps: O navetă sau o fregată cu instawarp e de ajuns.
A shuttle or an instawarp frigate is enough.
m.brief: Ok, my boss is located in our warehouse in Ane. Just drop this report at his desk and he'll wire the payment to my account. I'll give you something in return for your efforts as well. Just some items that I think you might find useful, and frankly I have no need of. Take it or leave it.

story: Schabs organizează mineritul la Survey Station.
Schabs runs the mining operation at the Survey Station.

goal: Aduci Threaded Waypoint Map din Contested Gallente Skeleton Comet, Deltole.
Bring the Threaded Waypoint Map from Contested Gallente Skeleton Comet, Deltole.
reward: 500.000 ISK și un implant Hardwiring +3 aleatoriu ca bonus.
500,000 ISK and a random +3 Hardwiring implant as a bonus.
steps: Îți trebuie un Data Analyzer.
You need a Data Analyzer.
Daunele sunt mari, iar NPC-urile elite au warp scrambler. Merg bine Drake, HAC sau Command Ship.
Damage is heavy and elite NPCs have warp scramblers. A Drake, HAC or Command Ship works well.
m.brief:
I am a professor of archaeology at the University of Caille. Behind this ancient gate beside me you will find one of the most fascinating enigmas in existence. It is a small and seemingly insignificant object, but one that holds massive powers. The origin of this relic is still vague, though most now agree that it was built by the Yan Jung nation. Perhaps you've heard of it? The Yan Jung nation immigrated into our world through the EVE Gate eons ago. From where, we do not know, though the fragments of texts we've managed to translate talk about a mysterious middle kingdom. They settled here in Deltole, though we suspect they also colonized other systems, even in far off places. But what we've uncovered so far is here in the Deltole system, especially on Deltole V and VI, which seem to have been much more inhabitable back then.

So what happened to the Yan Jung nation, you must be wondering? Simply told, we don't know yet. Heck, I'm not even sure what the relic I just described to you was used for. I've been studying it for months and still its purpose eludes me. It has some sort of a repelling force that's almost impenetrable. It also has regeneration mechanics and perpetual power source, meaning it's as good as eternal. What the Yan Jung built it for, or used it for, is a complete mystery.

Unfortunately, the Serpentis pirates have taken an interest in Yan Jung relics too. They've sent out dozens of treasure hunters and scavengers. They don't tolerate others to interfere with their efforts, which explains why I'm hiding out here instead of being at the relic studying it. The Serpentis periodically send expeditions here and are always scouting the place. Their methods are crude, but they've got much more manpower and resources than I can ever dream of having. I've heard rumors that they've uncovered an important piece of the biggest riddle surrounding the Yan Jung nation. Over at Deltole X, close to the stargate leading to Colelie, is the entrance point to a Yan Jung site that is possibly the largest Yan Jung ruins in space still in existence. I can only imagine what riches might await there. The only problem is that a passkey is needed to activate the gate. And from what I've heard the Serpentis are now in possession of one of the key elements in constructing one.

You look like an energetic pilot. I'm interested in hiring you for a bit of work. The Serpentis relic hunters are operating from a base within the Skeleton Comet site here in Deltole. I haven't been there myself, but somewhere within it you'll find a Serpentis Survey Site, which is the right place. Therein the Serpentis store all the data and items they've found throughout the whole constellation. What I want you to search for is a map of some sort. I'm sorry for being so vague, but that's all the info I have. I'm sure you'll know what I want as soon as you see it. There's only one problem. The Serpentis are a paranoid lot, and they've encrypted all their data and storage containers. I hope you possess some hacking skills, or know someone that does, for that is what is required to get to the information I need. Get that map from the Serpentis and bring it to me and I will reward you handsomely. I feel dirty having to resort to petty theft, but when you're up against scumbags such as the Serpentis the only way to play a fair game is to follow their rules.

goal: Aduci Yan Jung Micro Processor din Yan Jung Ruins.
Bring the Yan Jung Micro Processor from Yan Jung Ruins.
reward: 800.000 ISK și un BPC storyline aleatoriu (3 rulări, ME 15, TE 6) ca bonus.
800,000 ISK and a random storyline BPC (3 runs, ME 15, TE 6) as a bonus.
steps: Iei poarta de lângă agent.
Take the gate next to the agent.
Procesorul cade de la Force Repeller, care apare rar.
The processor drops from the Force Repeller, which spawns rarely.
m.brief:
The map you got me is only one piece in the puzzle of getting into the hidden relic site. You remember what I told you about that strange device that lies behind this gate beside me? It is of Yan Jung origin and I believe it can give us another vital puzzle piece. In order for me to construct a usable passkey to enter the relic site I need to understand better how the Yan Jung nation approached technology. The force repeller has a micro processor, which would give me just those insights. I am a hopeless fighter, so I don't stand a chance against the Serpentis ruffians in there. I need someone of your capabilities to get the micro processor for me.

So what you need to do is enter the Yan Jung ruins through the gate beside me. Take out the Serpentis scouts and proceed to tackle the force repeller. You can't get close to it while it's still active, so you need to shoot it from a distance. Once it blows up get the micro processor quickly before the regeneration nano-bots kick in and rebuild the repeller. Oh, and one more thing. The Serpentis periodically send expeditions to the ruins. I hope you don't run into them, but if you do make sure you have plenty of firepower on your side.

goal: Aduci Binary Transpositional Code.
Bring the Binary Transpositional Code.
reward: Passkey spre Yan Jung Relic Site și skillbook-ul Yan Jung Technology ca bonus.
A passkey to the Yan Jung Relic Site and the Yan Jung Technology skillbook as a bonus.
steps: Codul cade de la NPC-urile Crook Protector din centurile din Algintal. Apar rar.
The code drops from Crook Protector NPCs in the Algintal belts. They spawn rarely.
O fregată sau o fregată de asalt e de ajuns.
A frigate or assault frigate is enough.
m.brief:
The Yan Jung were more clever than I gave them credit for, it seems. The micro processor is highly advanced and my analytical methods are limited in cracking its secrets. However, what little information I've managed to glean from the processor gives me hope that we can still solve this mystery. The encryption methods employed by the Yan Jung nation are in many ways similar to those used by a new strand of rogue drones that a colleague of mine have told me exist in this very constellation. My guess is that the rogue drones happened upon some lost Yan Jung artifact here in Algintal and in assimilating it learned some new tricks.

But however it happened is beside the point. What really matters is that the local pirates that frequent the asteroid belts here in Algintal have been harassing this new breed of drones out of fear it will grow to become too powerful for them to handle. And as pirates usually do, they loot those they destroy. This colleague of mine has been doing a research on this new rogue drone breed and he tells me that the drones have developed a sophisticated binary code to interact with the Yan Jung technology they assimilated. My theory is that if we get this binary code we can use it to unravel the mysteries of the micro processor in my possession. In doing so we should have no problem in constructing a useable passkey. And the belt pirates, having hunted the new drones so excessively, are certain to possess this binary code.

In essence, I want you to go into the asteroid belts and hunt down belt pirates. From what I've heard the Serpentis are employing tough marauders to hunt the rogue drones, so your best bet is to focus on them. Return to me once you have the binary code and I will construct a passkey that you can use.

story: Sebast caută drumul spre relicvele Yan Jung din Algintal. Lanțul se termină cu cheia spre site-ul de relicve și un skillbook.
Sebast is seeking the way to the Yan Jung relics in Algintal. The chain ends with the key to the relic site and a skillbook.

goal: Aduci Binary Transpositional Code (1 m³).
Bring the Binary Transpositional Code (1 m³).
reward: Un implant Hardwiring de 3% aleatoriu și un aliaj aleatoriu ca bonus.
A random 3% Hardwiring implant and a random alloy as a bonus.
steps: Codul cade de la pirați aleatorii din centuri. Îl găsești și pe contracte.
The code drops from random belt rats. You can also find it on contracts.
Îl predai agentului.
Hand it in.

goal: Aduci Drone Mind Embryo (1 m³) din Aether Drone Hive.
Bring the Drone Mind Embryo (1 m³) from the Aether Drone Hive.
reward: Zainou 'Deadeye' Trajectory Analysis TA-703 și un aliaj aleatoriu ca bonus.
Zainou 'Deadeye' Trajectory Analysis TA-703 and a random alloy as a bonus.
steps: Complexul e în același sistem. E mai greu decât o misiune L4 obișnuită.
The complex is in the same system. It is harder than a normal L4 mission.
Ultimul boss repară peste 500 DPS. Ia DPS mare sau prieteni.
The final boss repairs over 500 DPS. Bring big DPS or friends.
Atenție la alți jucători care fură itemul și ți-l vând înapoi.
Watch for other players who steal the item and ransom it back.
m.brief:
Terminal impairment detected...System shutdown imminent...Priority shift engaged: Procreation mode activated.

Warning: fatal error...Insufficient number of embryos...Request embryo...Insert answer here: YES/NO?

story: O minte de dronă avariată din Secret Drone Hive îți cere ajutorul în cod binar.
A damaged drone mind in the Secret Drone Hive asks for your help in binary.

goal: Duci Warning Message (1 m³) la Thrasher-ul lui Amakkit din Parchanier.
Carry the Warning Message (1 m³) to Amakkit's Thrasher in Parchanier.
reward: 50.000 ISK, plus 50.000 ISK bonus.
50,000 ISK, plus a 50,000 ISK bonus.
steps: Ridici mesajul și îl predai la navă. Bonusul cere sub 10 minute.
Pick up the message and deliver it to the ship. The bonus needs under 10 minutes.
m.brief: Give Drusk the message from Krester Rupptofs.

goal: Duci FON Banner (1 m³) la Thrasher-ul lui Amakkit din Parchanier.
Carry the FON Banner (1 m³) to Amakkit's Thrasher in Parchanier.
reward: 1.000 Federation Navy Thorium Charge L și 'Bootleg' Remote Sensor Booster BPC (3 rulări) ca bonus în 1 oră și 30 de minute.
1,000 Federation Navy Thorium Charge L and 'Bootleg' Remote Sensor Booster BPC (3 runs) as a bonus within 1 hour 30 minutes.
steps: FON Banner cade din Friends of Nature Operation Station, în a doua cameră din Skeleton Comet.
The FON Banner drops from the Friends of Nature Operation Station in the second room of Skeleton Comet.
Îl predai la navă.
Deliver it to the ship.
m.brief:
You probably know already that we've been subtly manipulating FON and Serpentis into working together against Wiyrkomi. While this is not without risk we feel it's the best chance of driving the Caldari megalomaniacs out of Algintal so we can get back to some serious smuggling.

But things are now rapidly progressing out of control and we have to get more directly involved to get things under control again. There's this Serpentis agent by the name of Elere Febre that we linked up with a FON contact. Febre is the main liaison between the two sides and has worked wonders in the short time she's been involved. But according to this message you brought me her cover is blown. Wiyrkomi is on to her and is probably planning to take her out as we speak. Or worse, take her into custody and interrogate her. We cannot let that happen as she could then reveal the Thukkers involvement.

Time is of the essence here, so the first thing we need to do is distract the Wiyrkomi until we come up with a real plan. I don't have time to assemble squad of my own so some improvisation is the order of the day. You're the only one here, so I guess I must rely on you. We must instigate a fake attack on the Wiyrkomi by FON. To do that we need an authentic FON banner. I know that FON has an operation station inside the Skeletal Comet complex over in Deltole. It's overlooking the huge rogue drone hive in there. What do you say about raiding the place and steal me a FON banner? Return with it here and we're half way home in throwing Wiyrkomi off the scent.

story: Drusk trimite mesaje de la bordul unui Thrasher din Parchanier.
Drusk sends messages from aboard a Thrasher in Parchanier.

goal: Aduci Maschteri Markan's Insignia.
Bring Maschteri Markan's Insignia.
reward: Un modul Federation Navy, 7,5% standing la Gallente Federation, 21% la Combine Harvest și un implant Hardwiring de 3% ca bonus.
A Federation Navy module, 7.5% Gallente Federation standing, 21% Combine Harvest standing and a 3% Hardwiring implant as a bonus.
steps: Maschteri e în semnătura Temko Surveillance Outpost, la Colelie VI - Moon 3. Trebuie scanată.
Maschteri is in the Temko Surveillance Outpost signature at Colelie VI - Moon 3. It must be scanned down.
Reapare doar o dată la 5–6 ore. Dacă insigna e pe contracte, e mai simplu s-o cumperi.
It respawns only every 5–6 hours. If the insignia is on contracts, buying it is simpler.
Are 80% rezistență cinetică și doar 50% termică. Trage termic.
It has 80% kinetic resist and only 50% thermal. Shoot thermal.
m.brief:
You don't know what FON stands for?! Friends of Nature of course! We ... errr they stand for everything that's good about the Federation. Originating from a group battling to save rare animal species from extinction, it has grown somewhat after space travel became more common. Now it also fights for the preservation of the natural phenomena which decorate our night sky.

Now you said you were looking for some work. As a matter of fact there is something that you could do for me which would really make my day. Temko are evil corporate peons who care nothing for our heritage, the Azure Canyon. They work for a no-good money-grubbing Caldari corporation which intends to destroy our natural reserves for its own gain. It so happens that one of Temko's commanders, Maschteri Markan, had the audacity to try and blackmail us when we sabotaged one of Wiyrkomi's construction sites, where they were building a survey station. He recorded the event and threatened to release it to The Scope and the Federation authorities if we wouldn't give in to his demands.

Find these records and bring them to me, or somehow convince him to hand them over himself, and I will reward you generously.

I suggest you refrain from accepting this mission if you have no idea how hard finding Maschteri is. Otherwise you might be in for a rude awakening.

----
Mission completed:
I didn't tell you to kill him! I'm ready to die for my beliefs, but I won't take part in cold-blooded murder! I guess I owe you your reward, but this is the last time I'll do business with you, . You're a bad, bad man.

goal: Duci 400 Recon Speeders (800 m³).
Carry 400 Recon Speeders (800 m³).
reward: 'Natura' Warp Core Stabilizer I BPC (3 rulări, ME 20, TE 8), plus 41.000 ISK bonus.
'Natura' Warp Core Stabilizer I BPC (3 runs, ME 20, TE 8), plus a 41,000 ISK bonus.
steps: O fregată de explorare cu expandere ajunge și e rapidă.
An exploration frigate with expanders is enough and fast.
Poți preda de la distanță, dar următoarea misiune o iei de la agent.
You can complete remotely, but you get the next mission from the agent.
m.brief:
Something just came up that's right up your alley.

Hi there, stranger. I'm Croir Arghe, and I'm in charge of what we like to affectionately call FON's guerilla wing. Not for anyone, what I have. No sirree. 

We've received some information recently that gives us reason to believe Wiyrkomi are up to some very clandestine things in this sector. In light of that, we're planning to mount a large offensive against a Wiyrkomi mercenary outpost in the Colelie system. Now, this is not something that's technically sanctioned by the top tiers of FON's command structure, but a certain portion of us feel that this must be done anyway. If you have a hauler handy and are willing to help with the logistics of this endeavor, I can pay you very well. Just keep quiet about it, OK? 

First off, I need some recon speeders brought to Deltole. There's quite a large amount of them, so you'll need a good deal of cargo space. Are you up to it?

goal: Duci 25 Crates of Rocket Fuel (1.000 m³).
Carry 25 Crates of Rocket Fuel (1,000 m³).
reward: 'Executive' Remote Sensor Dampener BPC (3 rulări, ME 20, TE 8), plus 74.000 ISK bonus.
'Executive' Remote Sensor Dampener BPC (3 runs, ME 20, TE 8), plus a 74,000 ISK bonus.
steps: Patru salturi în total, de la o stație la alta.
Four jumps in total, from one station to another.
m.brief:
Here is a mission suited for someone of your caliber.

Preparations for the attack are going well, but a slight problem has presented itself. The squadron we have stationed in Fluekele has run out of rocket fuel for their ground-based missile systems. This doesn't bode well for the offensive, so if you could head over to Audaerne, grab the supplies we have there and bring them over to Fluekele, we would much appreciate it.

goal: Duci 600 Custom-built Guidance System (1.200 m³).
Carry 600 Custom-built Guidance Systems (1,200 m³).
reward: 'Love' Medium Remote Armor Repairer BPC (3 rulări, ME 20, TE 8), 1,4% standing la Gallente Federation și 129.000 ISK bonus.
'Love' Medium Remote Armor Repairer BPC (3 runs, ME 20, TE 8), 1.4% Gallente Federation standing and a 129,000 ISK bonus.
steps: Șase salturi în total. Un Magnate cu expandere și rig-uri de cargo sau un industrial.
Six jumps in total. A Magnate with expanders and cargo rigs, or an industrial.
m.brief:
Something just came up that's right up your alley.

We are almost ready for the offensive. Only one thing is missing. 

The squadron spearheading the attack is going to be mounting custom-built guidance systems, ones which will give them an unsurpassed ability to track ground-based targets on a flyby. We've had top engineers working on these systems for a while now, and they were finally completed yesterday. 

Go get the finished batch from Barmalie and bring it to Deltole, and we will be ready for our strike.

story: Croir aprovizionează protestele FON cu tot ce le trebuie.
Croir keeps the FON protests supplied with everything they need.

goal: Aduci 20 Blue Pill (4 m³).
Bring 20 Blue Pills (4 m³).
reward: Eifyr and Co. 'Alchemist' Neurotoxin Recovery NR-1003.
Eifyr and Co. 'Alchemist' Neurotoxin Recovery NR-1003.
steps: Site-ul are restricții de mărime a navei și două camere.
The site has ship size restrictions and two rooms.
Când distrugi un depozit, pastilele intră direct în cargo.
When you destroy a warehouse, the pills go straight into your cargo.
m.brief:
Ah, ! It is good to see there are freelancers who still maintain some loyalty to the Federation. It pleases me greatly that capsuleers like yourself still prove willing to help us out at need. Anyway, if you are looking for something to do, I know a little job that might just mix profit with pleasure.

The Serpentis are setting up a little shop in this area where they are training their fighters, intending to bring them into the tournament. Now, we aren't afraid of a little competition, but these fighters aren't all-natural, if you know what I mean. We're going to need them kidnapped and brought back here. Chances are you're going to find the substance the Serps have been feeding their fighters as well, and I know some people who are very interested to see it recovered. Purely for research, of course. I wouldn't dream of touching the stuff myself.... 

OK, OK, so maybe years ago when I was younger I might have tried some, but everyone experiments a little. No harm in that. Right? Just don't let me find out that you've kept a little for yourself. I need ... I mean, I want it all. To give to our researchers, of course. Ahem. Yes. 

So, well, before you go ... listen, I would appreciate it if you could keep this matter to yourself. I'm sure you'll agree that not everybody needs to know about this, hm?

goal: Distrugi navele și fortăreața Serpentis.
Destroy the Serpentis ships and stronghold.
reward: Federation Navy Magnetic Field Stabilizer.
Federation Navy Magnetic Field Stabilizer.
steps: Două camere. În a doua apare un ultim val cu declanșator necunoscut.
Two rooms. In the second, a final wave appears with an unknown trigger.
m.brief:
Thanks for meeting me in person, . We have a problem: My superiors have transcripts of our earlier communication and know about the drugs you brought back. It's okay, though, they've given me a chance to get rid of the stuff. 

I need you to head out to Q-UA3C. The Serps have had a small shipping checkpoint there for a while, one which our investigative reporters have been monitoring for a big exposé on the way Serpentis supply chains work. Since my bosses want this little "mistake" of mine rectified quietly in order to prevent a scandal, they want the drugs taken there and the outpost destroyed. And that's what will happen. 

Between you and me, though, I can't stand the idea of letting such a valuable commodity go to waste. So what I want you to do is head out there and kill everything you see, but leave the drug disposal to me. I'll convince my superiors and anyone else who asks that the drugs were destroyed at the outpost, and everyone will be happy ? at least, assuming that you can keep this a secret. And that is what you will do, I trust. This is an important mission, which will have significant impact on your faction standings.

story: Dars luptă cu traficul de droguri Serpentis din nullsec.
Dars fights the Serpentis drug trade in nullsec.

goal: Aduci Veko Tallaja's Voucher.
Bring Veko Tallaja's Voucher.
reward: 100.000 ISK, plus 50.000 ISK bonus în 1 oră.
100,000 ISK, plus a 50,000 ISK bonus within 1 hour.
steps: Voucher-ul îl primești la finalul lanțului lui Veko Tallaja.
You get the voucher at the end of Veko Tallaja's chain.
Îl predai agentului.
Hand it in.
m.brief: Before I let you work for me you're going to have to supply me with a voucher from Veko Tallaja, located in Central Command in Fluekele.

goal: Distrugi depozitele din complexul FON.
Destroy the storage facilities in the FON complex.
reward: 1 mil. ISK, plus 500.000 ISK bonus în 4 ore.
1M ISK, plus a 500,000 ISK bonus within 4 hours.
tip: Pierzi standing cu Gallente Federation: pentru ei FON nu sunt teroriști.
You lose Gallente Federation standing: to them FON are not terrorists.
steps: Varianta rapidă: distrugi structura și misiunea e gata.
Quick route: destroy the structure and the mission completes.
m.brief:
Since you've been approved by Veko Tallaja, I guess you're suited for a few missions vital to our plans here in Algintal. To get straight to the point, we are currently on a campaign to rid the deadspace areas we purchased from Federate sources of pirates and violent protesters, namely the Friends of Nature organization which has been causing us much grief since we came to Algintal. To complete our objectives we have been forced to hire mercenaries which are permitted entrance into Federation space, considering that the government steadfastly refuses to allow any Caldari State military presence in their sovereign space. Which is understandable considering the current political climate.

Wiyrkomi sacrificed much to get this deal, and we definitely are not backing out with our tails behind our legs. Our CEO has publicly announced that we are firmly against any Caldari State incursions into Federation space, incurring the wrath of the State Chief Executive Panel which has fined us for rediculous reasons simply out of spite. And on top of that our lease on the deadspace pockets within Federation space could be annulled at any time if the Senate gives in to the protesters.

So now that you're briefed of the situation, it's time to get started. Your first target is an old abandoned Federation Navy ammunitions storage in Jolia.
