We have confirmed reports that the military arm of FON uses the facilities located there to store their weapons of mass destruction. Take it out and their terrorist operation in Jolia will be crippled. Over and out.

goal: Distrugi convoiul Serpentis.
Destroy the Serpentis convoy.
reward: 'Corporate' Light Electron Blaster I BPC (3 rulări, ME 20, TE 8) și 1.000 Federation Navy Tungsten Charge L ca bonus.
'Corporate' Light Electron Blaster I BPC (3 runs, ME 20, TE 8) and 1,000 Federation Navy Tungsten Charge L as a bonus.
steps: Varianta rapidă: distrugi structura Stationary Iteron V.
Quick route: destroy the Stationary Iteron V structure.
m.brief:
As I said earlier, it's time for us turn our attention to the Serpentis. The Serpentis problem should in fact be easier to deal with than our war with the Gallente environmentalists, but at the same time they are the deadlier foe. The Serpentis are not at war with us due to some fanatical idealogy, instead they are simply here to protect their financial interests. I'm quite certain that as soon as they see this 'war' becoming unprofitable in the long run, they will retreat from their positions in our territory.

So to start off we need to make them know we mean business. And to do that I want you to take out one of their drug convoys. I had the Temko mercenaries under my command conduct a massive surveillance operation, which eventually revealed one of the Serpentis's drug convoy routes. I'll supply you with a bookmark that should lead you to one such convoy. Destroy it and report back to me. And remember, the cargo should not be brought back here, I want nothing to do with their contraband.

goal: Aduci Elere Febre's Data Log.
Bring Elere Febre's Data Log.
reward: 2 'Protest' Large Armor Repairer I și 'Executive' Remote Sensor Dampener BPC ca bonus în 6 ore.
2 'Protest' Large Armor Repairer I and 'Executive' Remote Sensor Dampener BPC as a bonus within 6 hours.
steps: Mergi la a șasea lună a planetei Fluekele IV.
Go to the sixth moon of Fluekele IV.
Distrugi modulul de locuit al lui Elere și iei jurnalul. Restul poți ignora.
Destroy Elere's habitation module and loot the log. You can ignore the rest.
m.brief:
Your next assignment is a pretty important one. Elere Febre is a Serpentis agent working in Fluekele, which we believe is their contact with Friends of Nature, as we've detected FON agents visiting her habitation module multiple times in the past week alone. FON are desperate to not let news of this alliance between them and Serpentis leak to the public. I'm not even sure if the majority of FON's members know of their dealings with pirates. Public opinion in favor of FON will undoubtedly plummet once people believe there is a connection between them and violent criminals.

Now killing her should be simple. The difficult part is retrieving evidence of her involvement with FON. I'm counting on her leaving some sort of evidence in her habitation module, which is located at Fluekele IV's sixth moon. Find the habitation module and destroy it, search the wreckage for anything that survived which may implicate FON's relationship with Serpentis. Return to me with your findings. Hopefully we'll be able to kill two flies in one swing with the completion of this mission.

goal: Aduci Serpentis Transaction Log.
Bring the Serpentis Transaction Log.
reward: Cybernetic Subprocessor - Standard și 1.000 Caldari Navy Lead Charge L ca bonus în 7 ore.
Cybernetic Subprocessor - Standard and 1,000 Caldari Navy Lead Charge L as a bonus within 7 hours.
steps: Jurnalul e în Contested Gallente Azure Canyon.
The log is in Contested Gallente Azure Canyon.
Îl duci agentului.
Take it to the agent.
m.brief:
The Serpentis have so far refused to meet any of our demands. I expected as much, a few convoys and agents are expendable in their eyes. But it's time to turn up the heat. This time I would like you to gather the best pilots you can muster and launch an offensive directly into the Azure Canyon of Colelie. Head straight towards the Black Market pocket and destroy the Serpentis Stronghold. If you can, try to recover something that will allow us to blackmail them, such as computer logs, prisoners, anything.

I suspect that Salvador Sarpati will think twice about going up against Wiyrkomi after suffering the loss of such a costly installation. If all goes as planned, the Serpentis will retreat from the Azure Canyon, giving us full access to the ion clouds.

goal: Distrugi Asteroid Outpost al FON.
Destroy the FON Asteroid Outpost.
reward: Memory Augmentation - Standard și 'Monopoly' Magnetic Field Stabilizer BPC ca bonus.
Memory Augmentation - Standard and 'Monopoly' Magnetic Field Stabilizer BPC as a bonus.
steps: Sunt multe turele și drone-păianjen. Dronele au web de 90%, așa că omoară-le întâi.
There are many turrets and spider drones. The drones have 90% webs, so kill them first.
Distrugi avanpostul.
Destroy the outpost.
m.brief:
As your final assignment for me, , I want you obliterate the FON headquarters, located in Deltole. As you probably know, Friends of Nature mainly consists of civilians which are protected by Federation law. They claim to be a peaceful organization fighting for 'the environment', but in fact a large portion of its members are nothing but terrorist scum who are willing to sacrifice human life to protect a heap of rocks and gas clouds. I've come to realize that no matter how hard we hit them, they will always come back for more. So the only course of action I see is to exterminate the lot of them.

Unfortunately, the Federation will not look kindly upon us killing its civilians, despite them being affiliated with Friends of Nature. They don't have the same view of FON as we do. So it is vital that you do not reveal who you are working for to anyone. If you do, I'll make certain you won't live to see another day.

story: Gara conduce războiul Wiyrkomi împotriva FON, pe care îi numește teroriști. Intri cu voucher-ul lui Veko Tallaja.
Gara runs the Wiyrkomi war against FON, calling them terrorists. You get in with Veko Tallaja's voucher.

goal: Aduci 2 Reports (0,2 m³).
Bring 2 Reports (0.2 m³).
reward: Eifyr and Co. 'Alchemist' Neurotoxin Control NC-903.
Eifyr and Co. 'Alchemist' Neurotoxin Control NC-903.
steps: Site-ul are restricții de mărime a navei și două camere.
The site has ship size restrictions and two rooms.
Serpentis Tournament Host lasă rapoartele. Le primești oricum în cargo când misiunea e gata.
The Serpentis Tournament Host drops the reports. You also get them in cargo when the mission completes.
m.brief: You seem eager and willing to work for me. I have this little problem you could help me out with. Yesterday I was tricked into telling my supervisors I would take care of a situation in the area, not fully knowing all the details. Next time I´ll be more careful and not be baited. Anyway, I looked into it and scout reports indicated a large Serpentis operation in the ppg-xc system. It appears they're setting up their own tournament to compete with the Legends Trial. Some of our advertisers have a real problem with this, so they need the operation brought to a halt. Naturally, I'd do it myself, but I figure since you are such an eager puppy you would just love to do it for me, wouldn't you?

goal: Aduci 5 Harlots (5 m³).
Bring 5 Harlots (5 m³).
reward: Federation Navy Large Armor Repairer.
Federation Navy Large Armor Repairer.
steps: Două camere cu mai multe valuri.
Two rooms with several waves.
Ultimul inamic lasă cele 5 Harlots, iar misiunea e gata.
The last enemy drops the 5 Harlots and the mission completes.
m.brief: Those blasted Serps just keep bouncing back. They seem determined to profit from the proceedings in some way. After we took out their tournament site, they appear to have immediately put their backup plan into action, namely to put up a brothel for tournament visitors in need of some after-hours entertainment. Their hiring practices leave a lot to be desired. They've abducted some of the finest exotic dancers this system has to offer. My immediate superior, bless his heart, has a particular affinity for one of these dancers, a girl who goes by the name of Layla. I need you to head out to the brothel, blow the living you-know-what out of it and bring the girl back. The Scope will be in your debt, friend. This is an important mission, which will have significant impact on your faction standings.

story: Marvernois investighează afacerile Serpentis din nullsec.
Marvernois investigates Serpentis business in nullsec.

goal: Duci Ovon Flac's Container (10 m³).
Carry Ovon Flac's Container (10 m³).
reward: 15 mil. ISK, plus 10 mil. ISK bonus în 3 ore.
15M ISK, plus a 10M ISK bonus within 3 hours.
steps: Ridici containerul și îl predai.
Pick up the container and deliver it.
m.brief:
Hey there, . I have a task I want you to complete. If you do it right, I might have a small reward for you. 

The next Legends Trial battle starts at midnight tonight, and as head of security around here, my job is to make sure it goes as smoothly as possible. However, there is a small problem. The documents detailing the fighters and their ships were scheduled to be delivered to me from 9GYL-O V - Moon 13 - Intaki Space Police Assembly Plant this morning. However, the courier assigned to the task has obviously failed us, and as such I need you to step up and fill his place. Go get the documents and bring them to me. Do it quickly and I will have a little something extra waiting for you. 

Fly safe.

goal: Aduci 3 Ovon Flac's Documents (0,3 m³).
Bring 3 Ovon Flac's Documents (0.3 m³).
reward: Eifyr and Co. 'Alchemist' Neurotoxin Control NC-903, plus 10 mil. ISK bonus în 3 ore.
Eifyr and Co. 'Alchemist' Neurotoxin Control NC-903, plus a 10M ISK bonus within 3 hours.
steps: Semnătura cu același nume e în PPG-XC, în nullsec.
The signature of the same name is in PPG-XC, nullsec.
Turnurile Serpentis Stasis te încetinesc cu web.
The Serpentis Stasis Towers web you.
Varianta rapidă: omori hoții Serpentis și iei documentele.
Quick route: kill the Serpentis thieves and loot the documents.
m.brief:
The container you delivered to me was completely empty! Those damned Serpentis must have snatched the documents as you were loading the container aboard your ship. 

I'm putting the blame for this mess squarely on your back. You need to solve this, ! If my superiors find out the documents have been lost, we can expect some heads to roll ... your head, to be precise. Find the documents and bring them to me straight away. They cannot have gotten very far; I'm actually pretty sure they're in this very system. 

This is an important mission, which will have significant impact on your faction standings.

story: Curierul lui Ovon a dispărut cu un container important.
Ovon's courier went missing with an important container.

goal: Aduci 5 Hydrogen Batteries (5 m³) din XG-D1L și le duci în PPG-XC.
Get 5 Hydrogen Batteries (5 m³) in XG-D1L and take them to PPG-XC.
reward: Federation Navy Heavy Ion Blaster, plus 8,8 mil. ISK bonus.
Federation Navy Heavy Ion Blaster, plus an 8.8M ISK bonus.
steps: XG-D1L e la 13 salturi, iar PPG-XC la încă 2. Totul e nullsec.
XG-D1L is 13 jumps away, PPG-XC another 2. It is all nullsec.
Prima cameră are foarte mult web și damp. Îți trebuie MJD sau tank solid.
The first room has a lot of webs and damps. You need an MJD or a solid tank.
Bateriile cad după ultima navă de luptă din camera 2.
The batteries drop after the last battleship in room 2.
m.brief: Good day. Looking for a job, are you? I have just the thing for a strapping capsuleer such as yourself. We're helping with putting on the Legends Trial, that great and massive confrontation. We've hit a snag, though; we had a shipment of supplies that were supposed to get here this morning, but the convoy ran into some technical difficulties and it appears they won't get here in time. We've had wind of a Serpentis outpost in the vicinity, though, so we're thinking we might just outsource and play them at their own game. How about it? You up for a little hit-snatch-and-run?

goal: Distrugi țintele Serpentis din XG-D1L.
Destroy the Serpentis targets in XG-D1L.
reward: Social Adaptation Chip - Improved și skill-ul Gas Cloud Harvesting ca bonus în 3 ore.
Social Adaptation Chip - Improved and the Gas Cloud Harvesting skill as a bonus within 3 hours.
steps: Două camere. Poarta din primul buzunar se poate deschide înainte să moară tot.
Two rooms. The first pocket gate may unlock before everything is dead.
Misiune importantă pentru standing.
An important mission for standing.
m.brief: Great job on the supplies. We seem to be good to go, now that most of the logistical details are taken care of. This will be greatest tournament ever. And I'm sure the Serpentis don't mind us borrowing some of their things. I have another mission for you. Just another small supply run, one for which I'll reward you handsomely, to show our appreciation for... hold on. Give me a second, here. I have something coming in over the wire. ... Oh, lord. Oh, sweet sister of mercy. Looks like we made the Serpentis mighty mad. In retaliation for our little loan of goods, they've gone all-out and attacked a Gallente station in XG-D1L Navy squadrons are already on the way, but it's going to take them some time to get there. What we need now is someone to repel the first wave of attack, buy some time for the reinforcements to get there. What do you say, pilot? In the mood to be a hero today?

story: Valedt vrea să slăbească prezența Serpentis din XG-D1L, în nullsec.
Valedt wants to weaken the Serpentis presence in XG-D1L, nullsec.

m.t: Rogue Crop - Trimming the Edges (1 of 4)
goal: Aduci 4 Aether Hive Link (8 m³).
Bring 4 Aether Hive Links (8 m³).
reward: 1.000 Federation Navy Uranium Charge L, plus 2 mil. ISK bonus în 2 ore.
1,000 Federation Navy Uranium Charge L, plus a 2M ISK bonus within 2 hours.
steps: Legăturile cad de la Drone Perimeter Guards, în a doua cameră din Contested Gallente Skeleton Comet.
The links drop from Drone Perimeter Guards in the second room of Contested Gallente Skeleton Comet.
Le predai agentului.
Hand them in.
m.brief:
"Algintal is one of the primary smuggling routes between the Federation and Republic space and Deltole is the main hub for smugglers in the constellation. The Serpentis have taken over a local complex, a natural beauty spot called the Skeleton Comet, and made it their own. Us Thukkers do our best to keep up and fortunately we're in good enough standing with most of the Serpentis to be allowed in their haven for some RR

But a week or two ago the Serpentis asked us to pay them back some of their hospitality. It seems parts of the complex are crawling with rogue drones. And not just any rogue drones, but pretty lethal ones. I understand their presence there contributed greatly to the Gallenteans evacuating the Skeleton Comet in the first place. And now it seems the rogue drones are stirring once more and the Serpentis are edgy what they might do. My superiors asked me to look into the matter and I'm interested in hiring you to do some reconnaissance for me in the complex.

What I want you to do is enter the complex and locate the rogue drone hive. Kill a few of their perimeter guards and return to me with whatever they drop. Until we know more about what makes these drones such a threat we should tread carefully, so don't try to act the hero and take on the whole hive in one go. Just pick out a few outer guards and we'll take it one step at a time from there."

m.t: Rogue Crop - Neither Safe nor Sorry (2 of 4)
goal: Aduci 2 Neural Bio Link (4 m³).
Bring 2 Neural Bio Links (4 m³).
reward: 'Mafia' Kinetic Energized Membrane BPC (3 rulări) și Inherent Implants 'Yeti' Ice Harvesting IH-1003 ca bonus.
'Mafia' Kinetic Energized Membrane BPC (3 runs) and Inherent Implants 'Yeti' Ice Harvesting IH-1003 as a bonus.
steps: Legăturile cad de la Drone Workers, în aceeași cameră din Skeleton Comet.
The links drop from Drone Workers in the same Skeleton Comet room.
Le predai agentului.
Hand them in.
m.brief:
"This Aether Hive Link you returned with is a puzzle. It looks as if these drones are capable of more intimate communications than otherwise believed, but there are also hints that even more advanced hive mind links exist. I'm not a technician, so I can't go into all that much details, this information is just something relayed to me from our techies at the Thukker Mix. They say that they suspect that a truly symbiotic drone hive might be evolving. They sound exited about it, but they are safe in their labs, so what do they know? It's us that have to deal with these drones face to face that have to worry.

In any case, we must verify whether this is true or not. I need you to go back into the complex and now I need stuff from drones closer to the hive. There are some drone workers orbiting close to the hive that seem like ideal targets. Take a few of them out and, again, return with whatever they drop. I will then forward it to our techies and see what the situation is. Just be extra careful when you take the workers out, you never know what might be protecting them. Maybe nothing, maybe something heavy."

m.t: Rogue Crop - Root of the Problem (3 of 4)
goal: Duci Drone Observation Data (0,1 m³) din Deltole la Illinfrik VIII - Moon 1 - Trust Partners Trading Post.
Carry the Drone Observation Data (0.1 m³) from Deltole to Illinfrik VIII - Moon 1 - Trust Partners Trading Post.
reward: 100.000 ISK și Ocular Filter - Basic ca bonus.
100,000 ISK and Ocular Filter - Basic as a bonus.
steps: Bonusul cere sub 45 de minute.
The bonus needs under 45 minutes.
m.brief:
"The techies have taken a quick look at the links you brought me and they're telling me it's something they've never seen before and are totally baffled by. I'm not sure what to make of their comments, is this radical new design a threat or not? I must get a definite answer before deciding how to proceed.

My observations and the data that you and others have collected for me, as well as information on these links, needs to be looked at by more talented techies. Take this data over to the Illinfrik system, to the Trust Partners station there. They will analyze this data and give me feedback I can work from."

goal: Aduci Cognitive Hive Mind (0,1 m³).
Bring the Cognitive Hive Mind (0.1 m³).
reward: 'Pickpocket' EM Energized Membrane BPC (3 rulări, ME 20, TE 8) și Memory Augmentation - Standard ca bonus în 3 ore.
'Pickpocket' EM Energized Membrane BPC (3 runs, ME 20, TE 8) and Memory Augmentation - Standard as a bonus within 3 hours.
steps: Dysfunctional Raid Drone lasă un cip care arată destinația dronei: Parchanier VI - Moon 5.
The Dysfunctional Raid Drone drops a chip pointing to the drone's destination: Parchanier VI - Moon 5.
Mergi acolo, omori dronele și iei mintea stupului.
Go there, kill the drones and take the hive mind.
m.brief:
"I've received a preliminary report from Illifik. It seems a new strand of rogue drones evolved in that hive over in the Skeleton Comet complex. At first, this new strand was incorporated into the existing hive and used to augment it. These strange links you got me are a case in point. But here's the interesting thing. It seems the queen in the drone hive in the Skeleton Comet eventually turned against these new rogue drones and chased them away.

The techies in Illifik managed to extract imbedded commands in the hive links you brought them that showed that the queen has ordered her drone army to destroy all these evolved rogue drones. Obviously she fears they might pose a threat to her authority. I don't know if her drone army is already on the prowl, but I do know where one group of these evolved rogue drones is located at. I've been ordered to retrieve a functional hive mind from these new drones for further analyzes of their capabilities. Getting in a cross-fire between two opposing rogue drone factions seems kinda dangerous to me, thus I'm asking you if you're up to the job. I have no idea what you should expect in this drone hive location, be on the lookout for the drone army sent by the queen in the Skeleton Comet. This is an important mission, which will have significant impact on your faction standings."

story: Un nou tip de drone rogue a evoluat în stupul din Skeleton Comet. Wrtuk, un Thukker, vrea să afle cât de periculos e.
A new strain of rogue drones has evolved in the Skeleton Comet hive. Wrtuk, a Thukker, wants to know how dangerous it is.

goal: Aduci agentului 20 Azure Cytoserocin (200 m³) și primești un blueprint de booster.
Bring the agent 20 Azure Cytoserocin (200 m³) and get a booster blueprint.
reward: Standard Sooth Sayer Booster BPC (10 rulări, ME 5, TE 2) și standing la Minmatar Republic.
Standard Sooth Sayer Booster BPC (10 runs, ME 5, TE 2) and Minmatar Republic standing.
tip: Aceeași misiune există la Riluko Hik, Uiswin Aurtur și Zwod Aden. O poți face o dată la fiecare.
The same mission exists at Riluko Hik, Uiswin Aurtur and Zwod Aden. You can do it once with each.
steps: Cumperi gazul din piață sau îl minezi chiar tu în zonă, cu o Venture sau o Prospect și probe Core.
Buy the gas on the market or harvest it yourself nearby with a Venture or Prospect and Core probes.
Agentul e în nullsec, așa că pentru transport e bun un Blockade Runner sau o Prospect.
The agent is in nullsec, so a Blockade Runner or a Prospect is a good choice for hauling.
Predai gazul din fereastra misiunii.
Hand in the gas from the mission window.

goal: Aduci agentului 20 Azure Cytoserocin (200 m³) și primești un blueprint de booster.
Bring the agent 20 Azure Cytoserocin (200 m³) and get a booster blueprint.
reward: Standard Sooth Sayer Booster BPC (10 rulări, ME 5, TE 2) și standing la Minmatar Republic.
Standard Sooth Sayer Booster BPC (10 runs, ME 5, TE 2) and Minmatar Republic standing.
tip: Aceeași misiune există la Riluko Hik, Uiswin Aurtur și Zwod Aden. O poți face o dată la fiecare.
The same mission exists at Riluko Hik, Uiswin Aurtur and Zwod Aden. You can do it once with each.
steps: Cumperi gazul din piață sau îl minezi chiar tu în zonă, cu o Venture sau o Prospect și probe Core.
Buy the gas on the market or harvest it yourself nearby with a Venture or Prospect and Core probes.
Agentul e în nullsec, așa că pentru transport e bun un Blockade Runner sau o Prospect.
The agent is in nullsec, so a Blockade Runner or a Prospect is a good choice for hauling.

Standard Sooth Sayer Booster BPC (10 runs, ME 5, TE 2) and Minmatar Republic standing.

The same mission exists at Riluko Hik, Uiswin Aurtur and Zwod Aden. You can do it once with each.
steps: Cumperi gazul din piață sau îl minezi chiar tu în zonă, cu o Venture sau o Prospect și probe Core.

The agent is in nullsec, so a Blockade Runner or a Prospect is a good choice for hauling.

goal: Aduci 4 Sleeper Manuscripts (4 m³).
Bring 4 Sleeper Manuscripts (4 m³).
reward: ISK.
ISK.
tip: Îți trebuie un Relic Analyzer. Treci de poarta depozitului, apoi intri pe poarta site-ului de relicve. Misiunea se poate repeta și nu dă standing.
You need a Relic Analyzer. Pass the depot gate, then take the relic site gate. The mission can be repeated and gives no standing.
steps: Itemele le găsești spărgând containerele din Contested Minmatar Military Depot sau le cumperi din piață.
You find the items by hacking the containers in Contested Minmatar Military Depot or buy them on the market.
Le predai agentului.
Hand them in.
m.brief:
A clan sister of mine owns a quaint little curiosities shop back in Pator. She sells all kind of weird and wonderful items from around the known EVE universe. When she heard I was coming here to Ani, she asked me to have a look around for items for her shop. Of course, I'm happy to oblige.

I expected to pick up a few Nefantar artifacts at most, but something else has caught my eye. While digging through an old spa here in Lanngisi, I came upon a most fascinating old manuscript, written in a language I'm unfamiliar with. I sent it to my clan sister and it thrilled her. She wants me to search for more. I haven't found any more here in Lanngisi, but I've heard from reliable sources that more can be found over in an old ruin in Inder. So I'm looking for pilots such as you to help me out.

Bring me some manuscripts and I'll pay you 15 000 ISK. Of course, you have to have some basic knowledge of archeology before you can make head or tail of what you find.

Bring 1 Sleeper Split Cables.
reward: ISK.
ISK.

m.brief:
Are you proficient codebreaker? If you are I have need for your talents. The Sisters of EVE are conducting some very secretive research here in Ani and my master sent me out here to find out what it is. I'm already engaged in breaking into the Sister's mainframe, but it's proving to be troublesome. My master is getting restless and wants to start see some result. So I figured I could buy myself some time by sending him some interesting tidbits from around the constellation, preferably ones that have something to do with the Sisters.

I know that the Angels are actively gathering information themselves, so perhaps they're sitting on something of value to me and my master. I'll pay you a bit of money if you collect some tidbits for me. The Angels operate a listening outpost in a complex over in Traun. Head over there and snoop around. If you have the skills for it, that is.

goal: Aduci 2 Angel Spatial Analyzer.
Bring 2 Angel Spatial Analyzer.
reward: ISK.
ISK.
tip: Misiunea se poate repeta, dar nu dă standing de facțiune.
The mission can be repeated, but gives no faction standing.

You find the items by hacking the containers in Contested Minmatar Army Complex or buy them on the market.

goal: Duci 1.000 Antibiotics (200 m³).
Carry 1,000 Antibiotics (200 m³).
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Ridici medicamentele și le predai la destinație.
Pick up the medicine and deliver it.
m.brief: Hello there, friend. I have come to this wicked place in order to help out the surviors of the conflict that has been going on recently. Drug barons, murderers, hoaxers and other scum infest this constellation, and they show no mercy when dealing with the defenseless locals. We need to reach out and lend our aid to those in need of it. I need you to deliver these antibiotics to . Some kind of epidemic seems to be spreading out there and hopefully this should be enough to cure the infected ones.

goal: Duci 5 Dairy Products (2,5 m³).
Carry 5 Dairy Products (2.5 m³).
reward: Un BPC storyline (3 rulări) și standing la Servant Sisters of EVE.
A storyline BPC (3 runs) and Servant Sisters of EVE standing.
tip: Agentul e Servant Sisters of EVE: standingul merge la ei, nu la Minmatar Republic.
This agent is Servant Sisters of EVE: the standing goes to them, not to the Minmatar Republic.
steps: Ridici marfa și o predai.
Pick up the goods and deliver them.
m.brief:
Those antibiotics you delivered were useless, the epidemic has spread across the entire planet and I don't think there's anything we can do to help those people any more. The doctors there have become infected themselves and nobody has any idea what the sickness is or what it's made of.

However, my friend, I do have other jobs for you. The refugee camp at  is running low on supplies. I want you to deliver these dairy products to the officials there for them to give to the needy. Please complete this as quickly as possible, people's lives are at stake.

story: Beris lucrează pentru Sisters of EVE și ajută victimele unei epidemii.
Beris works for the Sisters of EVE helping the victims of an epidemic.

goal: Aduci 150 Oxygen (57 m³).
Bring 150 Oxygen (57 m³).
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Îl cumperi din piață și îl predai.
Buy it on the market and hand it in.
m.brief:
I own and operate a portable arena of cyboerians, cybernetically augmented gladiators who fight each other for show, demonstrating a wide range of Matari martial arts. I was having problems generating revenue in my old home, so I relocated to Nakugard.

Shortly after I got here, though, a problem reared its head. Obviously I'd underestimated the extend of influence wielded by the criminal element in this area. Within weeks, most of my fighters were strung out on various illicit drugs, and I've since had to close up shop. Can't have a show if you don't have performers. And to make matters worse, my contract with the Leisure Group is still in full effect; if I'm nit generating my revenue they're not going to be happy, and we most definitely do not want the Leisure Group unhappy.

There are a few things I need to be able to get mu arena up and running again. Among these is oxygen; I can't very well run the place if no one can breath, you understand, if you can go out and find me 150 units of oxygen, I'd be much obliged.

goal: O aduci pe Grace Tarsis (1 m³).
Bring Grace Tarsis (1 m³).
reward: ISK și standing la Minmatar Republic.
ISK and Minmatar Republic standing.
steps: Site-ul primește până la battleship.
The site allows up to battleships.
Omori gărzile Angel Cartel și o iei pe Grace.
Kill the Angel Cartel guards and take Grace.
m.brief:
I have three fighters on hand right now, but I need more to be able to run my show. I just received word, that one of my best, Grace Tarsis, is being held by a group of Cartel thugs in a deadspace location here in Nakugard, on account of some unsettled debts. If you can find her and bring her back to me in one piece, I'll be a step closer to re-opening my arena and evading the Leisure Group's wrath.

They're keeping her in a brothel in their lair. one that's not really that heavily guarded. If you kill the guards and blow up the brothel, you should be able to get her out and bring her back. If you can do that you will have my heartfelt thanks.

story: Kraimir organizează lupte de gladiatori în The Glass Edge.
Kraimir runs gladiator fights at The Glass Edge.

La Forward Point sunt trei porți, Alpha, Beta și Gamma, la circa 110 km. Care duce la corp se schimbă de fiecare dată.
At Forward Point there are three gates, Alpha, Beta and Gamma, about 110 km away. Which one leads to the corpse changes every time.
Iei corpul și îl duci agentului.
Take the corpse to the agent.

story: Ekdit face recensământul Urban Management și caută civili dispăruți.
Ekdit runs the Urban Management census and searches for missing civilians.

m.t: Furthering the Cause - Keeping Tabs (1 of 3)
goal: Duci 450 Electronic Parts (450 m³).
Carry 450 Electronic Parts (450 m³).
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Curier simplu.
A simple courier.
m.brief:
A few words of introduction are probably in order. I'm Mattheu Rochet an investment banker and sometimes independent trader. I made my fortune a while back trading robotics after the great capsuleer influx two years ago. Since then, I've been constantly seeking ways to further the cause of the Matari, a proud people with a tragic history for which proper reparations have not been made.

I recently decided to make the Ani constellation my stomping grounds. The situation here is an intriguing one: the simmering conflict between the Amatarr and the old Republic is more evident here than in most other places I've been to, and there is much good work that can be done. In fact, I have a job for you if you feel like lending a hand.

Some associates of mine have set up shop in the Barkrik system's Joint Harvesting Food Packaging stations. They are going to install some equipment so they can keep tabs on some of the shadier elements in there. I need you to bring them a shipment of electronic parts, which they can use to assemble their covert surveillance gear. Do this quickly and efficiently and i'll have another job for you.

m.t: Furthering the Cause - State of Readiness (2 of 3)
goal: Duci 180 Small Arms (360 m³) de la Lanngisi III - Moon 2 la Nakugard V - Moon 12 - Krusal Tribe Bureau.
Carry 180 Small Arms (360 m³) from Lanngisi III - Moon 2 to Nakugard V - Moon 12 - Krusal Tribe Bureau.
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Ridici armele și le predai.
Pick up the arms and deliver them.
m.brief:
According to my sources, there are some interesting times ahead in the Nakugard system. A group of unscrupulous individuals is planning to illegally move in Matari slaves under the guise of contract workers. Some of my contacts in Nakugard are working towards fixing this problem their own way but I want my people standing by in case worst comes to worst.

I have a shipment of small arms comming into the Sisters of EVE Bureau in Lanngisi. The Sisters themself have nothing to do with it of course, but they trust me enough to look the other way in this case. I need the weapons delivered to the Krusal Tribe bureau at Nakugard V, where my people will pick them up and put them to good use, if need be, will you do this for me.

goal: Duci 650 Confiscated Vitoc (325 m³) de la Barkrik II - Moon 10 la Lanngisi III - Moon 2 - Sisters of EVE Bureau.
Carry 650 Confiscated Vitoc (325 m³) from Barkrik II - Moon 10 to Lanngisi III - Moon 2 - Sisters of EVE Bureau.
reward: ISK și standing de facțiune.
ISK and faction standing.
tip: Agentul e Gallente: standingul cerut și cel primit sunt cu Gallente Federation.
This agent is Gallente: the standing needed and gained is with the Gallente Federation.
steps: Ridici marfa și o predai.
Pick up the cargo and deliver it.
m.brief:
I've just received word from one of my Nakugard associates that the group I mentioned earlier, the ones who are bringing in the slaves, have stashed away a sizeable portion of Vitoc in one of the Joint Harvesting stations in Barkrik presumably to keep better control of their "contracted labor." Fortunately some of the station personnel in there are on my payroll, so I've managed to have the whole load of it "confiscated."

If you head over there and bring the Vitoc back to the Sisters of EVE Bureau in Lanngisi, we will be one step closer to resoundingly sending out the message. You don't try to bring Minmatar slaves into this constellation, right under everybody's nose.

story: Mattheu ajută Sisters of EVE să țină sub control traficul de Vitoc.
Mattheu helps the Sisters of EVE keep the Vitoc trade under control.

m.t: Caldari Incursion - Rogue Brigand Attack (1 of 3)
goal: Aduci 8 Punk ID Slice.
Bring 8 Punk ID Slices.
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Cad de la fregatele elite din site-urile COSMOS Minmatar.
They drop from elite frigates in the Minmatar COSMOS sites.
Le predai agentului.
Hand them in.

m.t: Caldari Incursion - The missing Logs (2 of 3)
goal: Aduci 5 Recruitment Center Data Log.
Bring 5 Recruitment Center Data Logs.
reward: ISK și muniție de facțiune.
ISK and faction ammo.
steps: Cad de la pirații din centurile din Ani, dar rar.
They drop from belt rats in Ani, but rarely.
De obicei e mai simplu să le cumperi de pe contracte.
Buying them on contracts is usually simpler.
m.brief:
Since you did so well in your previous assignment, here's another mission for you. Each of our scouts conducting reconnaissance missions keeps a digital recording of what transpires during their expedition, stored in a secret compartment within some cargo crates they're carrying on board. A few of the teams we recently sent out went missing, and we're hoping the recordings survived and are being kept by whoever attacked them (if that's in fact what happened).

I'd like you to scour the asteroid belts in the Ani constellation in search of these logs. Assuming pirates are at the root of this problem, they might still have the cargo crates on board that hold the recordings, likely quite unknown to them, of course. We've lost dozens of ships, but all I ask for you to receover five of their logs. I don't care where you find them; I just need that evidence brought to me ASAP so I have something to bring back to my superiors when they launch a formal investigation.

m.t: Caldari Incursion - The Thukker Tribe Envoy (3 of 3)
goal: Aduci Vanir Makono's DNA.
Bring Vanir Makono's DNA.
reward: ISK, muniție de facțiune și standing la Caldari State.
ISK, faction ammo and Caldari State standing.
tip: Agentul e Caldari: îți trebuie standing cu Caldari State.
This agent is Caldari: you need Caldari State standing.
steps: Ținta e în Contested Minmatar Military Depot.
The target is in Contested Minmatar Military Depot.
Distrugi nava și iei ADN-ul.
Destroy the ship and loot the DNA.
m.brief:
Since you've been so successful at kill missions, I'll give you one final assignment that involves exactly that. There is a Thukker Tribe envoy to the Angel Cartel, Vanir Makono, who's been stirring up the Cartel against us; according to our intelligence, he's currently located within the Minmatar Military Depot in Inder. I don't know what his motives are, but they're probably related to the fact the Thukker Tribe hate our guts. Heh. He's been a thorn in our side for long enough. The Gist attacks on our assets have increased tenfold since he started spreading those rumors about us.

I already sent two of my best pilots out to kill him, but I haven't heard from them since. I suggest you prepare yourself well before you attempt to infiltrate the Military Depot; it's completely overrun by Gistum thugs. You'll probably find Vanir in the headquarters of the deadspace complex. Good luck.

story: Mitsu e Caldari și urmărește bandele Angel Cartel care atacă în Ani.
Mitsu is Caldari and tracks the Angel Cartel gangs raiding Ani.

m.t: The Time of Science - Tools of the Trade (1 of 3)
goal: Duci 1 Research Tools (1 m³).
Carry 1 Research Tools (1 m³).
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Ridici uneltele și le predai.
Pick up the tools and deliver them.
m.brief:
I work for the Sanctuary, one of the universe's foremost research institutions. We've recently managed to unearth what we believe could be facts paving the way towards greater understanding of the EVE Gate and how it operates; why it is the way it is. For us to put this information to practical use, however, we require more research data. You seem like the competent type. If you can do a bit of leg work for me, I'll make sure you're rewarded - and you'll be able to rest knowing you did your part in moving the scientific knowledge of today that little bit further forward.

First off, we're getting in a new batch of recently discovered material from a moon in the New Eden system, but our maintenance budget has been running low and many of our tools are in a sad state of disrepair. I have a batch of repair equipment here; if you could see fit to running this over to the SOE Bureau in Lanngisi, I would be much obliged - and so would my staff.

m.t: The Time of Science - A Spot of Relief (2 of 3)
goal: Duci 1.500 Water (375 m³).
Carry 1,500 Water (375 m³).
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Ridici apa și o predai.
Pick up the water and deliver it.
m.brief:
I've just received word that our station in Lanngisi is about to receive an influx of escaped Matari slaves who have made their way from the depths of Amarr space after their colony was attacked and destroyed. I'm already pulling all the strings I can, but there's one fairly basic thing I seem to have forgotten. There's quite a number of them, and the station will need an extra supply of water.

If you can head down to our Bureau in Traun and pick up water for the newly freed, I will reward you handsomely. I am also likely to have more work for you.

m.t: The Time of Science - Shelter (3 of 3)
goal: Duci 5 Crates of Construction Blocks (350 m³).
Carry 5 Crates of Construction Blocks (350 m³).
reward: ISK și standing la Servant Sisters of EVE.
ISK and Servant Sisters of EVE standing.
steps: Ridici lăzile și le predai.
Pick up the crates and deliver them.
m.brief:
The Matari refugees are safe and sound now, thanks in no small part to your efforts. The next step for us is to build them some decent living facilities in Lanngisi. To this end we will require building materials.

We've placed a large order for construction blocks at the Joint Harvesting plant in Barkrik. We quite like the idea of their materials helping to build housing for the free people their nation so callously and brutally mistreated. Do this for me, and I will see to it that you are handsomely rewarded.

story: Nina ajută cercetătorii Sisters of EVE din Rich Man's Run.
Nina supports the Sisters of EVE researchers at Rich Man's Run.

m.t: The Ani Build-Up - Extra Medical Supplies (1 of 3)
goal: Duci 5.000 Zemnar (1.000 m³).
Carry 5,000 Zemnar (1,000 m³).
reward: 200.000 ISK, plus 50.000 ISK bonus.
200,000 ISK, plus a 50,000 ISK bonus.
steps: La acceptare plătești garanția de 500.000 ISK.
You pay a 500,000 ISK collateral when you accept.
O fregată de explorare cu expandere sau un industrial T1.
An exploration frigate with expanders or a T1 industrial.
m.brief:
Oh, it's worth quite a bit, I'm sure you'll be satisfied with your end of the deal. But although I'm sure you're itching to get into combat, I'd like to put you to a small test first... to see if you're really sincere about helping us out. There's the minor task that needs to be done, which involves ferrying a load of medical supplies to this system. You see, Nakugard has been hit by strange viral infections of late which have devastated a few outlying settlements there and put a scare into the local populace. Not only that but it's really having a negative effect on our efforts with bringing more Krusual Tribe civilians here, a system with a viral outbreak is not exactly the first place on your list when you're thinking of relocating your family somewhere.

The Vherokior Tribe were kind enough to give us access to their Zemnar supplies on Teonusude VII - Moon 1 - Vherokior Tribe Treasury. Zemnar has proven to be an effective antidote against the latest outbreak, and we desperately need a large supply of the drug to prevent any more deaths and more bad publicity. I would like you to pay a visit to the Vherokior station in Teonusude and pick up the shipment and bring it to me. I'll see to it that it's distributed to all the affected settlements in Nakugard.

m.t: The Ani Build-Up - Carrot on a Stick (2 of 3)
goal: Aduci Ancient Nefantar Sculpture (5 m³).
Bring the Ancient Nefantar Sculpture (5 m³).
reward: Un BPC storyline aleatoriu (3 rulări).
A random storyline BPC (3 runs).
steps: Sculptura e în Nefantar Ruins, în Barkrik.
The sculpture is in the Nefantar Ruins, Barkrik.
Fregatele elite te încetinesc și te blochează.
The elite frigates web and point you.
m.brief:
As your second assignment, I need you to fetch a valuable Nefanter artifact from one of the Nefanter ruins trough Ani. Most people consider the Nefanter ruins a lost cause when it comes to treasure hunting, as they were all looted for decades after the Rebellion, and are now either used as a pirate forces or guarded by local militia intent on saving 'valuable relics of the past' from looters. I would like to reverse this myth by proving to the people of the Republic that Ani is in fact still full of surprises, including treasures from the past. All I require is some evidence of this to present to the media, in other words our propaganda machine.

To be more specific, I'd like some kind of Nefanter relic that will raise eyebrows. They were vey keen on creating portraits and sculptures of their leaders, which were unfortunately mostly destroyed by the freedom fighters during the Rebellion, and I'm certain one of them would interest all sorts of people. The Krusal Tribe are renowned treasure hunters, so finding these nefanter objects here would undoubtedly increase their interest in Ani.

Now if you're completely clueless as to where to start looking, I'll suggest one promising spot. There are some Nefanter ruins in Barkrik which have been claimed by the Maru Rebels as one of bases. Maru is a criminal organization that is not to be taken lightly, most of it's members are wanted by the law and can be killed on sight. And other than being prepared for a fight, I suggest you bring someone along that has experience as an archaeologist, you might need someone like that to dig up the artifact for you. Good luck.

m.t: The Ani Build-Up - Strike em Where it Hurts (3 of 3)
goal: Aduci Lagaster Malotoff's Tag.
Bring Lagaster Malotoff's Tag.
reward: Un BPC storyline aleatoriu, 1.000 Republic Fleet Phased Plasma S și standing la Minmatar Republic.
A random storyline BPC, 1,000 Republic Fleet Phased Plasma S and Minmatar Republic standing.
steps: Lagaster e în Overrun Headquarters din Contested Minmatar Military Depot.
Lagaster is in the Overrun Headquarters of Contested Minmatar Military Depot.
Distrugi nava și iei insigna.
Destroy the ship and loot the tag.
m.brief:
The last mission I have for you is the most difficult. The heavy pirate presence in Ani has a very negative effect on our mission, as I told you before. And the Angel Cartel are at the heart of it. Their operations in Ani must be stopped, at all costs.

As the saying goes, cut the head off the snake and you kill the snake. I'm not sure if this holds true with the Cartel, but it's worth a try. Their leader within Inder is Lagaster Malotoff, by killing him we hope to paralyze their forces for some time at least, and give the local populace a morale boost. This is the final task I have in store for you, once you have accomplished it my mission in Ani should be complete.

story: Penda pregătește apărarea din Ani împotriva Angel Cartel și a piraților Maru.
Penda prepares the Ani defenses against the Angel Cartel and the Maru pirates.

goal: Duci Blood Sample (0,1 m³).
Carry a Blood Sample (0.1 m³).
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Curier simplu.
A simple courier.
m.brief:
They're hiding something, I'm sure of it! Lately, rumors have been spreading that there is a deadly virus on the loose, and that nobody knows how to cure it. If we don't do something about this fast, this might grow into being a threat bigger than we can imagine, millions could be killed! I need you to help me get to the bottom of this, I'm sure my superiors know more than I do, but are not revealing any information.

This virus has spread to the facilities of . Luckily, they were able to contain the virus and the infected ones are now being held in quarantine. I want you to go there and pick up an infected blood sample. I'm going to analyze it and see if I can find a cure for this thing.

m.t: Hidden Truths - Unfolding a Mystery (2 of 3)
goal: Duci 4 Analyzed Blood Sample (0,4 m³).
Carry 4 Analyzed Blood Samples (0.4 m³).
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Curier simplu.
A simple courier.
m.brief:
That sample you delivered was essential, thank you. I have discovered the identity of this virus. It's an age-old sickness dubbed the Alobe Virus. Last time it surfaced, dozens of planetary societies became extinct and over 20 billion people were killed. If we don't do something about this now, history might repeat itself. You must help me spread the word on this, if we contact doctors and scientists around the constellation, then we might be able to raise awareness and help reduce the spreading of the Virus. Take these samples to  and give it to the scientists there. They will get the word out and help us prevent an epidemic.

Make haste, . Lives are at stake here.

m.t: Hidden Truths - Extremely Unfortunate Incident (3 of 3)
goal: Aduci 3 Refugees (0,3 m³).
Bring 3 Refugees (0.3 m³).
reward: Un BPC storyline, ISK și mult standing la corporație și facțiune.
A storyline BPC, ISK and a lot of corporation and faction standing.
steps: Agentul nu te întreabă de unde îi ai. Îi poți cumpăra din piață.
The agent does not care where you got them. You can buy them on the market.
Dacă îi iei singur, cad din Deserted Nefantar Bunkers, în a doua cameră (Overrun Supply Bunker) din Contested Minmatar Guerilla Base, Tvink.
If you get them yourself, they drop from the Deserted Nefantar Bunkers in the second room (Overrun Supply Bunker) of Contested Minmatar Guerilla Base, Tvink.
m.brief: We seem to have the worst of luck, . Not only do we have the life-threatning virus on our hands, now the Angel Cartel is making trouble as well. The cartel has kidnapped helpless refugees from a nearby camp and is demanding that we pay ransom. If we don't pay up, they're threatning to kill the refugees. Our policy has never been to negotiate with terrorists. I want you to go to the contested Guerilla Base in Tvink and retrieve as many refugees as you can. Please hurry, people's lifes are at stake!

story: Remy descoperă ce s-a întâmplat cu refugiații Nefantar din Tvink.
Remy uncovers what happened to the Nefantar refugees in Tvink.

goal: Îți croiești drum până la câmpul de gheață.
Fight your way to the Ice Field.
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: În primele trei buzunare omori apărătorii ca să se deschidă poarta.
In the first three pockets, kill the defenders to unlock the gate.
Misiunea e gata când intri în al patrulea buzunar. Acolo nu trebuie să lupți.
The mission completes when you enter the fourth pocket. You do not need to fight there.
m.brief:
Your first assignment is to conduct a reconnaissance mission near an ice field in Inder. We have reason to believe a Serpentis drug baron has set up shop there, hoarding drugs and other contraband goods in the deadspace surrounding the ice field, safe from our surveillance monitors. We have also been led to believe that this particular Serpentis pirate has been smuggling arms to the Angel Cartel criminal organization, which is a serious enough crime in itself.

I want you to examine the area and report your findings back to me. If our information is correct, then I will have no choice but to launch a full scale assault into the ice field and the surrounding asteroid belt to exterminate this Serpentis pest for good. I will await your findings here in the Dream Port. Farewell.

m.t: Operation Rattlesnake - Filling the Ranks (2 of 3)
goal: Duci 130 Marines (260 m³).
Carry 130 Marines (260 m³).
reward: Un implant Hardwiring.
A Hardwiring implant.
steps: Curier simplu.
A simple courier.
m.brief:
Now that you've proven yourself I'll fill you in on my secret assignment here in Ani. I was sent here by the Republic Fleet to prepare for a major assault that they've planned against the Angel Cartel strongholds in the constellation. The elimination of the Serpentis in the ice field was solely made to weaken the Cartel's position, as the Serpentis there were directly supplying them with arms and other equipment.

Your second task is to transport a regiment of our finest ground troops to the Sisters of EVE Bureau in Inder from the Brutor stronghold in Ivar. They will play a major role in our assault against the Cartel positions, so I need them here ASAP. I'll fill you in on your last and most important mission after you've completed this simple task.

m.t: Operation Rattlesnake - The Scanner Tower (3 of 3)
goal: Aduci Angel Cartel Scanner Data (0,1 m³).
Bring the Angel Cartel Scanner Data (0.1 m³).
reward: Un BPC storyline (3 rulări) și standing de facțiune.
A storyline BPC (3 runs) and faction standing.
steps: Datele cad din Scanner Tower, în Overrun Headquarters din Contested Minmatar Military Depot.
The data drops from the Scanner Tower in the Overrun Headquarters of Contested Minmatar Military Depot.
Site-ul primește până la crucișătoare T1.
The site allows up to T1 cruisers.
m.brief:
Now we're entering the final stages of our preparations for the military offensive. But there is one last mission I'd like to offer you that is critical to our objective. The Military Depot in Inder is currently under Angel Cartel control. Allthough the meager fleet guarding their positions there are no match for a full scale assault by the Republic armada, they have a huge advantage due to the terrain. The acceleration gate leading in to the complex is not fit for large vessels and if we take the longer route of manually flying through the deadspace area we will undoubtedly run into countless of their booby traps, potentially causing us heavy casualties.

But there is something that could turn the table in our favor, . Our agents have already infiltrated the pirate forces inside the Military Depot, and have reported a glaring weakness. They use a large scanner tower to detect any incoming ships from light years away, giving them extra time to prepare their defenses for any incoming assault. Ifthis scanner tower is destroyed, they will loose one of their biggest advantages.

The scanner tower is located inside the Military Depot complex. Once you have destroyed it, bring me something from the wreckage as proof. I won't doubt your sincerity, , but I'm afraid my superiors are a little more skeptical and would require some sort of evidence before they launch the strike.

story: Sinogor conduce Operation Rattlesnake împotriva Serpentis și Angel Cartel.
Sinogor runs Operation Rattlesnake against the Serpentis and the Angel Cartel.

goal: Duci Encoded RSS Brief (0,1 m³).
Carry the Encoded RSS Brief (0.1 m³).
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Curier simplu.
A simple courier.
m.brief:
As you may be aware, the Ani constellation is beset by smugglers as well as dealers in all sorts of illicit goods. Most of the merchandise that comes through here goes to the criminal organizations, who've had this place in their clutches for far too long.

Our plan is to change that, but it's going to take a while. Every day, literally tons of arms, drugs, and even slaves are smuggled through the Nakugard ingress, whence they are taken to various parts of the constellation to be sold. Space is a big place, and hard to police, but we do what we can as we always have ― and any help from capsuleers such as yourself is much appreciated.

Yesterday, I received an encrypted message from one of my deep cover agents. It appears that one Atek Vandano, a notorious fixer loosely affiliated with the Angel Cartel's Gist division, has been establishing contacts in Ani. We're not sure what he's up to, but Command believes this is something that needs to be nipped in the bud if we're to be able to maintain any semblance of control over this place down the line.

But first thing's first. I need you to take a copy of the brief down to some associates of mine at the Sisters of EVE Bureau in Inder. We need to make sure all our operatives in the region are informed of what's going on so we can begin formulating a counter-plan if necessary. Report back to me when you're done and we'll take it from there.

goal: Aduci Nanom Basskel's Ship Logs.
Bring Nanom Basskel's Ship Logs.
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Jurnalele cad de la fregata elite a lui Nanom Basskel, în prima cameră din Contested Minmatar Military Depot, Inder.
The logs drop from Nanom Basskel's elite frigate in the first room of Contested Minmatar Military Depot, Inder.
m.brief:
Well, we've found out what Atek Vandano's up to, and it's not pretty. Hold on to your seat ― if you're anything like me, this is gonna piss you off something awful.

The good Mr. Vandano, it seems, is not working for the Gist on this particular occasion. Our agents have uncovered data that indicates he's helping to bring in slave labor from Amarrian colonies to the Joint Harvesting stations in this system. We think they might be here as part of the Insorum scare; our information shows that the influx of slaves to Amarrian facilities within Republic space has increased manifold in the past weeks. The holders are protecting their "investments" by bringing them to our turf under the guise of contract laborers. Vandano thinks he can do this right under our noses. We're not going to let him.

Obviously, to avoid an incident with the Amarrian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, we'll have to go about this in some fairly unconventional ways, and we'll have to use operatives not officially affiliated with us. You know where I'm going with this, right?

Vandano has an associate, a lady by the name of Nanom Basskel. We have reason to believe she's one of the major architects behind this plan, and according to our intelligence she's in possession of documents detailing where they're keeping the slaves before final transport to the Joint Harvesting plants in system. She can usually be found at the contested military depot in Inder. Go out there, "remove" Miss Basskel, and bring me these documents.

goal: Distrugi Slave Containment Facility.
Destroy the Slave Containment Facility.
reward: ISK și standing de facțiune.
ISK and faction standing.
steps: Omori cele cinci fregate.
Kill the five frigates.
Distrugi structura Slave Containment Facility și te întorci.
Destroy the Slave Containment Facility structure and return.
m.brief: Thanks in no small part to the documents you brought, we now have the location of the temporary facilities in this system where Vandano and his cohorts intend to keep the slaves while their forged documents are being submitted to the Republic. According to our reports, they will then be brought to the Joint Harvesting Plantation in Barkrik. If you head out there now and destroy this outpost, our other team should be in a prime position to intercept the slave convoy when it comes in.

story: Them luptă cu traficul de sclavi al Angel Cartel din Inder.
Them fights the Angel Cartel slave trade in Inder.

Remember you can be attacked in lowsec.
