Bukar is hunting for the Transputer Orb, an artifact stolen by the Angel Cartel.

goal: Aduci Kutill's Data Chip.
Bring Kutill's Data Chip.
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Cipul e în același complex cu agentul.
The chip is in the same complex as the agent.
m.brief:
If you look over near the ruins of the old Pleasure Gardens, you'll see that no-good thief Rozor Mothrus. He appeared here at the Carnival a few months ago, claiming to be 'just another passerby'. What a rotten lie that was. From the moment I saw him I knew there was something out of place ...

Anyway, we spent some time in the Carnival pub, and I happened to get caught up in a conversation with him about this and that. I was fairly intoxicated at the time, so I can't remember much of it, but somehow he managed to drag out of me the location of my hideout in Barkrik. It's a nice little spot inside an area of space which we call 'deadspace', near an asteroid belt filled with low-life miners and rogue mechanical drones, not exactly a family resort if you know what I mean. But for someone like me avoiding those pests is not much of a problem, and it's the perfect hiding place when you have a run in with the law.

Now if allowing him to discover my favorite hiding place isn't enough, it so happens that I stashed my latest invention, a very valuable hacker-program, in a storage container right there! It's my only copy, and very very illegal here in Minmatar space. If Rozor gets his grubby hands on it, I'm ruined!

Now you might be thinking, why don't I just run over there and pick up the data chip? Well, the problem is Rozor has apparently hired some Maru mercs to do the dirty work for him. The last time I tried to enter the asteroid belt leading to the storage bin, I noticed some of them hiding by the miner's quarters. I escaped without them noticing me, and after some info-digging I found out they had been hired by Rozor.

I want you to fly out there and see if the Maru have miraculously not found the data chip I had hidden in the storage bin. If you find it, bring it to me for a sizable reward.

m.t: Kutill's Warez - Hack The Station Mainframe! (2 of 3)
goal: Duci Kutill's Data Chip la stație.
Carry Kutill's Data Chip to the station.
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Curier simplu.
A simple courier.
m.brief:
Since you passed the test with flying colors, it's time for you to complete the assignment. Deliver this data chip to the (Faction) station in (System). My contact there will use it to upload my program into it's computer mainframe. That's all you need to know. Do this fast and I'll throw you a bone.

Just whatever you do don't get caught. Remember, this program is very illegal. If the customs officials find it in your cargo hold, there'll be hell to pay, and it may compromise this operation. But since their scanners haven't been able to detect it yet, you don't have to worry too much.

goal: Îl omori pe Rozor Mothrus.
Kill Rozor Mothrus.
reward: Un BPC storyline (3 rulări) și standing de facțiune.
A storyline BPC (3 runs) and faction standing.
tip: Dacă îl omori pe Rozor Mothrus, nu mai poți lua misiuni de la el. Fă întâi lanțul lui Rozor.
If you kill Rozor Mothrus, you can no longer take missions from Rozor. Do Rozor's chain first.
steps: Rozor e în același complex cu agentul.
Rozor is in the same complex as the agent.
Distrugi nava și te întorci.
Destroy the ship and return.
m.brief:
There's just one last thing I need done before we're through, MeatWar. Ever since you retrieved that data chip for me, Rozor Mothrus has been extremely 'excited'. I'm afraid he might strike at any moment, if he learns what I'm up to. But I can't take him and his buddies by myself.

You'll probably find Machul and 3 Brutor mercenaries orbiting Rozor's ship. When you do, take them out, and bring me Machul's head from the wreckage if you can. I'll use it to tease Rozor ... right before I put an end to his miserable existence.

story: Dagras e un hacker din The Carnival care vrea să intre în mainframe-ul stației.
Dagras is a hacker at The Carnival who wants into the station mainframe.

m.t: Purging Ani - The Amarrian Plantation (1 of 3)
goal: Aduci Rekker's Keycard (0,1 m³).
Bring Rekker's Keycard (0.1 m³).
reward: Un BPC storyline (3 rulări).
A storyline BPC (3 runs).
steps: Intri în Jakela Plantation - Rekker's Security Station cu un Hacker ID Slice.
Enter Jakela Plantation - Rekker's Security Station with a Hacker ID Slice.
Cardul cade de la Rekker Malkun.
The keycard drops from Rekker Malkun.
m.brief:
I settled here in Nakugard many years ago, lured to this place by tales of riches and glory spread by the Republic Parliament who've been desperate to populate Ani with loyal supporters of the Republic. But I've never felt at home here, and ever since I discovered I was sharing space with minions of the Amarr Empire I've felt betrayed and depressed. These people are responsible for some of the most terrible crimes in human history! And they're living under the protection of those that have sworn to protect us, the Republic government! I couldn't believe it at first ...

Apparently Karin Midular made a deal with Joint Harvesting a few years back to allow them to build a few stations and plantations in Ani. I don't care how much ISK they had to pay to get this deal through, or the fact they pretended to apologize for the Empire's crimes before the Rebellion. An Amarrian is an Amarrian, they'll never change, and as long as their people are located within Minmatar space I will not be at peace. And fortunately there are more within the Krusual Tribe who think the same way.

There is a growing movement within the Krusual settlements in Ani which aims at uprooting the Amarr presence in this constellation. We already have a large fleet of ships ready to strike at any moment. Our first target is a 'secret' plantation within Hjoramold, called the Jakela Plantation. We managed to discover it by using system scanners, and we've even heard rumors from there that they are using slaves to work the fields!

Our only problem is that our agents haven't found a way through their second acceleration gate. It's being guarded by an Amarrian called Rekker, and a few of his henchmen. They aren't much of a problem for our forces, but we're afraid that if we send in an entire battalion he'll simply flee at the first sight of us and take his keycard with him.

What I want you to do, Pilot, is take a small fleet of ships and launch a surprise attack against Rekker. Loot his keycard and bring it back to me, that way we'll be able to access the acceleration gate leading deeper into the plantation grounds. You'll have to do this fast, before they change the gate's security system when they figure out Rekker has been killed.

Once you're back here with the keycard I'll supply you with your reward.

m.t: Purging Ani - Arming the Marines (2 of 3)
goal: Duci 500 Small Arms (1.000 m³) în lowsec.
Carry 500 Small Arms (1,000 m³) into lowsec.
reward: Un BPC storyline (3 rulări).
A storyline BPC (3 runs).
steps: Dacă pierzi marfa, o poți cumpăra din nou din piață și termini misiunea.
If you lose the cargo, you can buy it again on the market and still finish.
m.brief:
Since you managed to accomplish my first task with aplomb, I've decided you're worthy of another highly important mission for our cause. There are a large number of civilians in Ani who have offered to join our ranks during our campaign to rid the constellation of Amarr, but we don't have the weapons to spare to arm them. One of my contacts within the Republic Security forces has promised us a large shipment of small arms which we'll use to equip our new troops with. The only catch is that this shipment is currently located in Floseswin, which is a pretty dangerous area. Which makes this job perfect for someone like you, .

Get the shipment of small arms here in one piece and I'll give you a generous reward.

goal: Aduci Kyan Magdesh's DNA (0,1 m³).
Bring Kyan Magdesh's DNA (0.1 m³).
reward: Un BPC storyline (3 rulări) și standing de facțiune.
A storyline BPC (3 runs) and faction standing.
steps: Kyan e în Barkrik I - Asteroid Belt 1.
Kyan is in Barkrik I - Asteroid Belt 1.
Dacă alții îl omoară înainte, aștepți să reapară sau cumperi ADN-ul de pe contracte.
If others kill Kyan first, wait for the respawn or buy the DNA on contracts.
m.brief:
If you're still willing I have one final mission that I think you're suited for. The Joint Harvesting corporation has become aware of our presence and we believe they are preparing for a counter-attack against our forces. Finding a Mordu's mercenary in Ani confirmed our suspicions, we're certain these Mordu's goons were hired by Joint Harvesting to sabotage our operation.

Not only that, but they apparently sent a Magdesh after us. The Magdesh are a powerful family within the Mordu's Legion, highly respected bounty hunters. One of their members, Kyan, is currently hauled up in Barkrik I - Asteroid Belt 1. He's been spotted on numerous occasions snooping around near our outposts there, but never long enough for our guards to catch him. I would like you to take care of this pest, before he manages to do us any harm. Just be warned, he operates a Caldari battleship and is not to be taken lightly. You might need help on this one, . Good luck.

story: Dalkar vrea Ani curățat de plantațiile Amarr și de oamenii lor.
Dalkar wants Ani purged of the Amarr plantations and their people.

m.t: Requiem For A Peace - Sacrament (1 of 3)
goal: Duci 600 Infected Refugees (600 m³).
Carry 600 Infected Refugees (600 m³).
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Îți trebuie 600 m³ liberi.
You need 600 m³ free.
m.brief:
Welcome to this humble refugee camp operated by us, the Sisters of EVE. I am Fynnir Torsont, please call me Fynnir. We're swamped here at the camp and I'm on the lookout for volunteers of gentle spirit to lend aid.

Even if no one will admit it, there is a war raging here in Traun. Every day numerous skirmishes take place all over the system. I have no idea which side is winning, if any. If there are any sides, that is. No one seems to know who exactly is fighting whom. There are Republic forces here, Minmatar freedom fighters, Angel Cartel pirates, Thukker tribe nomads, Amarrians, you name it. We Sisters of EVE try to stay impartial in this chaos, it is often hard and always thankless. But someone needs to care for the weak, and I don't see the empires volunteering anything.

Every war, no matter the scale, always has its share of atrocities and this one is no different. I can't even start describing them, its too long and too sad a tale. Yet one requires mentioning. Recently a group of refugees arrived here in the camp. They are workers from an independent asteroid colony in a distant part of the system. When they arrived some of them showed symptoms of some unidentified illness and thus they were quarantined. Now, all of them are sick, many dying, or are already dead.

We don't have the resources here in the camp to determine what is causing this illness, but I have my suspicions. I don't think any of the factions slugging it out here are beneath chemical warfare and I fear that may be the case here. But investigating those suspicions must wait for another time. What matters now is getting the infected refugees to our station in the Lanngisi system, where they can be properly treated. Or at least receive their last rites in some peace and quiet. Time is of the essence here, their condition is grim and grows worse by the hour. If you're willing to take the task of ferrying some of them over to the Lanngisi system I will reward you well, but you can earn much more if you get them all there safely in just 40 minutes. Oh, and don't worry, they will be properly quarantined on the journey too.

m.t: Requiem For A Peace - Sepulture (2 of 3)
goal: Distrugi laboratorul infectat și aduci Formula for Septicemic Agent (0,1 m³).
Destroy the infected lab and bring the Formula for Septicemic Agent (0.1 m³).
reward: Un implant +2 Limited - Beta aleatoriu.
A random +2 Limited - Beta implant.
steps: Inamicii sunt la 20–25 km și nu atacă singuri. Unii trag rachete Nova explozive.
The enemies are 20–25 km away and do not aggro on their own. Some fire explosive Nova missiles.
Formula cade din Colony Laboratory Area, care are mult tank. Dronele ajută.
The formula drops from the Colony Laboratory Area, which is tanky. Drones help.
m.brief:
I've been doing some investigation while you were away and I've managed to dig up some promising leads. It's amazing really the amount of information one can get here in the camp. Here you can find people from all the warring factions all mingled together. It can get hairy at times. But some are more talkative than others and if you know what you're looking for you can get some valuable insights around here.

Anyway, from the clues I've pieced together it seems that my suspicion was indeed correct. A very dangerous man-made viral agent was indeed involved in the tragic demise of the colonists. But they've got no one but themselves to blame. It seems they were not telling the truth when they pleaded their ignorance about the whole thing. I already suspected as much from earlier rumors, but it was confirmed when I was contacted by a fellow Sister in our station in Lanngisi. Turns out one of the colonists spilled his beans on his deathbed and confessed.

The colonists were hired to manufacture the deadly agent. By whom I do not yet know. I can understand why the colonists agreed; the constant warfare in the system has not treated its inhabitants well. It was probably a matter of either accepting this deal or abandoning their homes for them. Yet though I can understand their actions, I can not condone them. Viral agents are an abomination and one so potent and this one obviously is could utterly destroy whole eco-systems.

We need to determine exactly what this viral agent is and whether it has gotten into the wrong hands. If you're up to it, I would be ecstatic if you could head over to the asteroid colony and snoop around. You should be able to locate the lab quite easily; it's probably not part of the main colony. Blowing it to pieces is a good first step in eradicating this evil viral agent from the world. If you could also get your hands on the agent formula, that would be even better. For that kind of information I would be willing to give you a solid implant as a reward.

m.t: Requiem For A Peace - The Redemption (3 of 3)
goal: Aduci Sample of Septicemic Agent (0,5 m³).
Bring a Sample of Septicemic Agent (0.5 m³).
reward: Un BPC storyline (3 rulări) și standing la Servant Sisters of EVE.
A storyline BPC (3 runs) and Servant Sisters of EVE standing.
steps: Proba cade aleatoriu de la Cybertron Patrol, Sentry sau Watchman, în Overrun Security Corridor din Contested Minmatar Army Complex.
The sample drops randomly from Cybertron Patrols, Sentries or Watchmen in the Overrun Security Corridor of Contested Minmatar Army Complex.
Când ataci un tip, vin toți de același tip, dar nu și ceilalți Cybertron.
Attacking one subtype pulls all of that subtype, but not the other Cybertrons.
m.brief:
Your work has been of immense value to us, . Not to mention the service you're doing the world. Not that it will thank you, mind you. It's something us Sisters get used to. Anyway, our scientists are already pouring over the formula you brought us. I hope they will be able to come up with an antidote soon so the threat can be neutralized.

I'm still trying to get to the bottom of who hired the doomed colonists to manufacture the viral agent. There are many candidates, but I'm especially interested in one group. They call themselves the Cybertrons. Pretty lame name if you ask me. They hang out at the local contested complex, though I think they're only loosely connected to the cartel. Might be some Amarr lord is behind this mysterious group, but I can't be sure.

I need some proof that the Cybertrons are behind this. Then I can approach the appropriate authorities with my knowledge and hope they do something about it. Or deal with them the Sister's way. Let's not get into that. The Cybertrons are pretty tough, so I'll understand if you decline to take them on. But if you're willing, I'll give you a rare BPC as a reward. Start taking these Cybertron guys down until one of them drops something I can use against them.

story: Fynnir, de la Sisters of EVE, încearcă să oprească o boală creată în laboratoarele Angel Cartel.
Fynnir, of the Sisters of EVE, tries to stop a disease created in Angel Cartel labs.

goal: Aduci 4 Angel Drug Addict Tag (0,4 m³).
Bring 4 Angel Drug Addict Tags (0.4 m³).
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Cad de la Angel Drug Addict în primul și al treilea buzunar din Contested Minmatar Guerilla Base.
They drop from Angel Drug Addicts in the first and third pockets of Contested Minmatar Guerilla Base.
m.brief:
Why have you come here? You don't actually believe that you're good enough to receive my training? Well, perhaps. I'll give you one chance, if you don't screw it up, then maybe there is hope for your misguided soul.

Set your destination for the solar system of Tvink. There is an old Guerilla outpost there, and currently it is being fought over by several different factions. I want you to go there and kill as many Angel Cartel Officers as you can. Bring their dogtags back to me as proof of you actions.

goal: Distrugi drona ST58 și aduci ST58 Memory Chip (0,1 m³).
Destroy the ST58 drone and bring the ST58 Memory Chip (0.1 m³).
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Un battlecruiser e recomandat.
A battlecruiser is recommended.
Poarta se deschide doar după ce omori tot. Bonusul e de 2 ore.
The gate opens only after you kill everything. The bonus is 2 hours.

story: Godun stă în The Asylum și are nevoie de un om de încredere.
Godun lives in The Asylum and needs someone reliable.

goal: Aduci 25 Oxygen (5 m³).
Bring 25 Oxygen (5 m³).
reward: 110.000 ISK, plus 110.000 ISK bonus.
110,000 ISK, plus a 110,000 ISK bonus.
steps: Îl cumperi din piață și îl predai.
Buy it on the market and hand it in.
m.brief:
Perhaps you have heard about what goes on here? If you have, then take some friendly advice and keep it a secret; it's for your own good. If you haven't heard about what we do here, then I suppose you're no threat to us. Anyway, I suppose you're here for work. Well, that´s good  ― working is what we do. This operation flourished before the Republic started meddling in our business. Of course, they have no idea we work for Thukker ... and if they did we would be in big trouble. 
Now, on to your first task. To maintain the integrity and security of our laboratories, we have a constant need for antibiotics. Find me some, and I will give you another task.

goal: Duci Drug Delivery Package (10 m³).
Carry the Drug Delivery Package (10 m³).
reward: 74.000 ISK, plus 65.000 ISK bonus.
74,000 ISK, plus a 65,000 ISK bonus.
steps: Trei salturi prin highsec, limită de 30 de minute.
Three highsec jumps, 30-minute limit.
m.brief:
I have a large order that needs filling. Perhaps you'd be up to the task of delivering it for me? The customer is waiting at Tvink. His payment has already been taken care of, so you needn't worry about that. Deliver this package and report back to me for your next assignment. 

Declining a mission from a particular agent more than once every 4 hours may result in a loss of standing with that agent, except in the case of special missions that clearly state otherwise in their description.

goal: Aduci 4 Minmatar Republic Narcotic Officer's Tag (0,4 m³).
Bring 4 Minmatar Republic Narcotic Officer's Tags (0.4 m³).
reward: 196.000 ISK, plus 170.000 ISK bonus.
196,000 ISK, plus a 170,000 ISK bonus.
steps: Le găsești în Contested Minmatar Guerilla Base. Site-ul primește până la battleship.
You find them in Contested Minmatar Guerilla Base. The site allows up to battleships.
m.brief:
Those cursed Republic agents are constantly trying to discover where our operations are based. They have officers all over the constellation searching for illicit substances. Can you believe they think we´re in the agriculture business? Hah, that's a good one! 

We need to show these cops that we aren't afraid of them. I want you to be the one to carry out that task, Maydie Chieves. Go to the contested guerilla base and kill as many of their officers as you can. Bring five of theirs tags back to me as proof.

Declining a mission from a particular agent more than once every 4 hours may result in a loss of standing with that agent, except in the case of special missions that clearly state otherwise in their description.

m.t: Thukker Agency - A Dirty Cop (4 of 4)
goal: Duci 2 Prostitute (2 m³) la un polițist corupt.
Carry 2 Prostitutes (2 m³) to a dirty cop.
reward: 500MN Digital Booster Microwarpdrive BPC (3 rulări), 42.000 ISK și standing la Thukker Tribe.
500MN Digital Booster Microwarpdrive BPC (3 runs), 42,000 ISK and Thukker Tribe standing.
tip: Agentul e Thukker Tribe: îți trebuie standing cu ei.
This agent is Thukker Tribe: you need their standing.
steps: Două salturi prin highsec, limită de 20 de minute.
Two highsec jumps, 20-minute limit.
m.brief:
Finally, business is back on track. Well, doing better than before you arrived, at least. Your assistance has helped us a great deal, my friend. I have one more task for you, though, before I give you your reward. 

We have a friend in the Minmatar police ― some would call him a "dirty cop," but I, like many others, prefer to think of him as a patron of free trade. Heh. Anyway, he´s been having some trouble with women lately and we like helping out our friends, so I want you to take these to Hjoramold III - Joint Harvesting Plantation and leave them there. I'm certain they´ll bring a smile to his face, if you know what I mean ... and I think you do.

story: Hinrich conduce o agenție Thukker cu afaceri cam murdare.
Hinrich runs a Thukker agency with some rather dirty business.

goal: Aduci 8 Hacker ID Slice (0,8 m³).
Bring 8 Hacker ID Slices (0.8 m³).
reward: ISK.
ISK.
tip: Mai păstrează un Hacker ID Slice: îți trebuie la Dalkar Kersos.
Keep a spare Hacker ID Slice: Dalkar Kersos needs one.
steps: Cad de la fregatele elite din site-urile COSMOS ale constelației.
They drop from elite frigates in the constellation's COSMOS sites.
m.brief:
Welcome to the frontline. You may not see it, but it's here all the same. I was sent out here three months ago to take care of a 'minor pirate problem', as I was told. It was only supposed to take a month, but I'm still here and I don't think I'll be going home any time soon. See that station, or what's left of it, over there? That station was supposed to be our headquarters. It was sabotaged a month ago, someone infiltrated the station and planted one big bomb in its bowels. I was one of the lucky few out on a patrol that day, or my body would by floating around here along with the rest.

I'm telling you, it's a total mess around here at the moment. Poor Murchor over there is trying to install some order, but he's in way over his head. Me? I'm just trying to stay alive in all this chaos. A lot of soldiers have fled and I can't blame them. But I'm not a deserter. All I can do is try to do my job and hope it will get easier. Like the Republic actually acting up on its promise to send reinforcement out here.

There are pirates all around here, and something much more. But I'm mainly concerned with the pirates; they're my top priority. And I want to make them your top priority too. I'll pay you good money to bring me some Hacker ID Slices. These hacker scums have been causing us all sorts of trouble, lurking in the shadows all the time. It wouldn't surprise me if they are behind the sabotage of the station. You can find them in the contested military complex in this system, and elsewhere too.

goal: Duci Sealed case of GI Paradise Missiles (250 m³).
Carry a Sealed case of GI Paradise Missiles (250 m³).
reward: 1.000 de muniție Republic Fleet M.
1,000 Republic Fleet M ammo.
steps: Curier simplu.
A simple courier.
m.brief:
I'm finally starting to see some progress around here. No thanks to the Republic though. It's mainly down to independent pilots such as yourself that the system isn't being totally overrun by pirates. And to the rebels. Yeah, I know they're whacky and delusional, but at least they're actively fighting all those opposing the Republic here in Ani. I can't count the number of times they've saved my ass in the last few weeks.

Though I can't agree with their agenda, I can approve of their methods. But let me get to the point. In the chaos we have here whole shiploads of army goods are being misplaced, mishandled or simply stolen every day. I got my hands on some pretty neat GI Paradise Cruise Missiles the other day, don't ask how. These GI versions are the blast.

I've befriended some of the more sane rebels and I want to pay them back for all the help they've given me. I have a crate of the missiles sitting in a hangar on a station in Hek. I'm not stupid enough to have them in my own cargo hold in case old Merchor over there gets nosy all of a sudden. There's a rebel guy waiting on the Sister of EVE station here in Traun waiting for the delivery. All I need is someone capable to get the missiles to him. Interested? I can offer you some pretty rare Republic ammo as a reward.

goal: Aduci Broken ComLink Scanner (2 m³).
Bring the Broken ComLink Scanner (2 m³).
reward: 'Inception' Target Painter BPC (3 rulări, ME 6, TE 6) și standing de facțiune.
'Inception' Target Painter BPC (3 runs, ME 6, TE 6) and faction standing.
steps: Scanerul e în Contested Minmatar Army Complex.
The scanner is in Contested Minmatar Army Complex.
m.brief:
I've been ordered to support our troops in the contested complex here in Traun. We're trying to wrench control for it from the Angel cartel. It's not going all that well, so I've been expecting this for some time. I don't like jumping into a situation totally unprepared, so I've been gathering what information about what is really going on there. The general Republic communication lines don't yield all that much useful information, but through the contacts I'm building with the rebels I actually found out some pretty important thing.

It seems the Angels in the complex, or one of the groups associated with them, have managed to tap into the Republic communication links. No wonder nothing has been going for our troops, all they're movements are known beforehand. Beats me how they did it, but it needs to be dealt with. I'm trying to get the brass to act upon this, but they just point at each other. I know it's hopeless for me to talk directly to our guys in the complex, it will only be intercepted.

But you're not part of the Republic's line of communications so you can act freely. I know the Angels are using a scanner housed in an old Nefantar tactical depot in the complex. I don't know if it's the only one they're operating, but let's start by hitting that one and see what happens. At least it will make me feel a little bit better when I move in there myself sometimes in the near future. Get me a piece of the scanner array. You may have to hit several of the scanners before a useful specimen comes up. Do this for me and I got this rare BPC to give you.

story: Krak duce un război din umbră cu Angel Cartel în constelație.
Krak wages a shadow war with the Angel Cartel in the constellation.

goal: Duci 4 Strange Construction Block (16 m³).
Carry 4 Strange Construction Blocks (16 m³).
reward: 219.000 ISK, plus 169.000 ISK bonus.
219,000 ISK, plus a 169,000 ISK bonus.
steps: Două salturi prin highsec.
Two highsec jumps.
m.brief:
I heard you were interested in working for Thukker Mix, perhaps I can be of assistance on that matter.

I have a shipment arriving in Hjoramold IX - Moon 14 - Joint Harvesting Refinery in just a few minutes. The person who usually picks up my wares got himself killed last week and I'm looking for a replacement. Let's see if you can do this quickly and without screwing anything up. Bring the wares back to me after you have picked them up.

goal: Duci 25 Strange Construction Block (100 m³).
Carry 25 Strange Construction Blocks (100 m³).
reward: 34.000 ISK, plus 41.000 ISK bonus.
34,000 ISK, plus a 41,000 ISK bonus.
steps: Două salturi prin highsec.
Two highsec jumps.
m.brief:
Remember, Maydie Chieves, nobody is ever to know that you work for me, or for Thukker that is. If the Republic knew about our little operation here, or found out that we deal in... questionable wares, they would most certainly close us down.

I recieved a small order of "construction blocks" from one of our regular clients. Take this to his quarters  at Hjoramold IX - Moon 14 - Joint Harvesting Refinery. The stuff is already paid for, you're just the delivery boy. Be quick about it, and don't mess up.

goal: Aduci Red Hammer's Personal Effects.
Bring Red Hammer's Personal Effects.
reward: 10MN Analog Booster Afterburner BPC și 908.000 ISK.
10MN Analog Booster Afterburner BPC and 908,000 ISK.
tip: Agentul e Thukker Tribe: îți trebuie standing cu ei.
This agent is Thukker Tribe: you need their standing.
steps: Ținta e în Contested Minmatar Guerilla Base.
The target is in Contested Minmatar Guerilla Base.
m.brief:
Sometimes, the work we do is dirty. It's not every day that we can just sit back and watch the money roll in. There is a man who goes by the nickname "Red Hammer". I don't know why or what his real identity is, but that's irrelevant. About a week ago he placed a large order, stuff worth about 500 million ISK. Based on his reputation, we delivered the items and he told us he would get the money within a day or two... but he never did. We sent a team after him but he managed to slip away, into the depths of the contested Guerilla Base here in Tvink. I want you to go there and kill the bastard. Bring me back something of his as proof of your actions. I will reward you well if you complete this.

Declining a mission from a particular agent more than once every 4 hours may result in a loss of standing with that agent, except in the case of special missions that clearly state otherwise in their description.

story: Misnik, un Thukker, are de mutat niște blocuri ciudate și o socoteală de încheiat.
Misnik, a Thukker, has some strange blocks to move and a score to settle.

m.t: Scandal In Barkrik - Deliver The Ambassador (1 of 4)
goal: Îl duci pe ST Ambassador Hugo Farin (3 m³).
Carry ST Ambassador Hugo Farin (3 m³).
reward: Muniție de facțiune.
Faction ammo.
steps: Curier simplu.
A simple courier.
m.brief:
I am an agent working for the Republic Parliament, and I was sent to Barkrik to investigate rumors of an incredible breach of Minmatar law by the Amarrian corporation Joint Harvesting. This corporation was given rights to this patch of space a few years ago, after some of their key members were the first major Amarrian figures to officially expressed 'regret' for the crimes committed by the Empire, and so far we have had little trouble with them, other than the strong opposition from hard-liners within the government.

But certain rumors are afloat within the inner circles of the Republic, and beyond, that Joint Harvesting actually employs slaves on at least one of their plantations within Barkrik. This rumor has never been proven, and therefore we have not yet taken action. Powerful 'elements' within the Minmatar government have been pressing for the military to directly intervene and make a political scene out of this mess. This is exactly what Karin Midular does not need. If this rumor turns out to be true, her agenda of peace between the Republic and the Empire will go up in smoke, and all our hard work for the past years will be for nothing. The skirmishes you see today between our forces will be nothing compared to what follows if war is officially declared, and I'm sure the hard liners within the Republic will be pressing hard for that to happen as soon as this gets out.

Now you're probably asking yourself, where do you come into all of this? Well, I was sent to Barkrik on a mission, which unfortunately I can't complete due to a breakdown in my ship's engine. I'd like you to complete my objectives for me, as I don't have much time. I'll pay you for it, of course.

Your first job is to escort the Republic ambassador, Hugo Farin, from Barkrik II - Moon 10 - Joint Harvesting Food Packaging to his office in Orduin V - Moon 7 - Republic Parliament Bureau. He was visiting the Joint Harvesting chief of staff in Barkrik, as well as taking a good look at their plantations here. I was assigned to transport him back home, but obviously I can't complete my assignment on time.

m.t: Scandal In Barkrik - Retrieve The Inspector (2 of 4)
goal: O recuperezi pe inspectoarea Layna Whizon (2 m³).
Recover inspector Layna Whizon (2 m³).
reward: Muniție de facțiune.
Faction ammo.
steps: Ia o fregată cu MWD. Briefingul zice că MWD nu merge, dar e informație veche: merge.
Take a frigate with an MWD. The briefing says MWDs do not work, but that is outdated: they do.
Treci prin mai multe buzunare, cu sute de km până la fiecare poartă.
Go through several pockets, with hundreds of km to each gate.
Nu ataca nimic. Niciun NPC nu te atacă, nici la container. O iei pe Layna din ultimul buzunar.
Do not attack anything. No NPC aggroes, not even at the container. Take Layna from the last pocket.
m.brief: Your second job is to bring one of our inspectors, Layna Whizon, to me. She is one of two plantation inspectors that we haven't retrieved yet after our ambassador's visit to Barkrik. I warn you, the trip will be a long one, the Amarrians there had the crazy idea of placing the beacon leading into the deadspace pockets very far away from the acceleration gates linking the rooms. I suggest you take a fast ship on this trip, and I'm also afraid your micro-Warpdrive will be inoperable due to the effects of deadspace.

m.t: Scandal In Barkrik - Deliver The Inspector (3 of 4)
goal: O duci pe Layna Whizon (2 m³) la destinație.
Carry Layna Whizon (2 m³) to the destination.
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Curier simplu.
A simple courier.
m.brief: Now that I've gotten Layna's report, it's time for her to return to our bureau in Orduin. Please take her there, Pilot. After this is done, please prepare yourself well for the final assignment.

m.t: Scandal In Barkrik - The Final Inspection (4 of 4)
goal: Aduci Bono Zakan Corpse din Maekor's Plantation.
Bring the Bono Zakan Corpse from Maekor's Plantation.
reward: Un BPC storyline (3 rulări), standing de facțiune și încă un BPC ca bonus.
A storyline BPC (3 runs), faction standing and another BPC as a bonus.
steps: Corpul e în Maekor's Plantation.
The corpse is in Maekor's Plantation.
Unele nave sunt Amarr: dacă le ataci, pierzi standing cu Amarr Empire.
Some ships are Amarr: attacking them costs Amarr Empire standing.
m.brief:
After we came to Barkrik on our mission for Republic Parliament, we stumbled upon some local rumors of a hidden Amarr slave plantation within the system. We tried investigating it for some time, but to no avail. However, one of our top secret agents, Bono Zakan, went missing during the investigation. The last we heard from him was a transmission from a remote area of Barkrik where he called for help. We couldn't trace it unfortunately, but I firmly believe he found something he wasn't supposed to.

I don't know if Bono's alive or dead, but I want him or his body returned to me for proper burial. I also want you to investigate the claims of this hidden plantation while you're at it, perhaps the two are linked. To search for the plantation, I suggest you use scan probes within Barkrik. With luck the Amarrians will have placed some sort of cosmic signature near the entrance to lead their own convoys to the area. You could also fly to every moon within the system and hope to stumble upon it's entrance, if you have no way of acquiring a scan probes. Good luck.

story: Un scandal în Barkrik: un ambasador, un inspector dispărut și un cadavru într-o plantație Amarr.
A scandal in Barkrik: an ambassador, a missing inspector and a body on an Amarr plantation.

m.t: Breaking Tradition - The Shaman’s Abode Part 1 (1 of 3)
goal: Cureți locuința șamanului.
Clear the shaman's abode.
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Două buzunare. Poarta spre al doilea se deschide doar după ce mor toți din primul.
Two pockets. The gate to the second opens only once everything in the first is dead.
m.brief: I have a job for you, . I became quite concerned today when we lost contact with our commanders in one of the Holy Grounds within Hjoramold, which my people have sworn to protect. I do not have enough pilots on hand to deal with this matter. Investigate the site and report your findings to me. If you find any hostiles there, such as rampaging rogue drones or pirates, then eliminate them at once. Do this and take the blessings of the Kulutor with you.

m.t: Breaking Tradition - The Shaman’s Abode Part 2 (2 of 3)
goal: Duci 1 Reports (0,1 m³).
Carry 1 Reports (0.1 m³).
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Nouă salturi, toate prin highsec.
Nine jumps, all highsec.
m.brief: While I scrounge for information on the Maru here in Hjoramold, I would like you to fetch a top-secret report for me that I ordered from our headquarters in Abudban.

goal: Aduci Sispur's Security Camera Logs (0,1 m³).
Bring Sispur's Security Camera Logs (0.1 m³).
reward: 100MN Analog Booster Afterburner BPC (3 rulări) și un implant de atribut +3.
100MN Analog Booster Afterburner BPC (3 runs) and a +3 attribute implant.
steps: Intri în Sispur's Estate cu Sispur Estate Keycard.
Enter Sispur's Estate with the Sispur Estate Keycard.
Cardul cade de la Famon Gurch, în The Carnival din Barkrik.
The keycard drops from Famon Gurch at The Carnival in Barkrik.
m.brief:
Apparently Ketta Tommin, a Maru Rebel commander, has been seen visiting Sispur's Estate in Hjormaold several times in the past few weeks. As far as I can see, there are two clues that point directly to her as far as the Maru attack is concerned: First of all, it's well known that Ketta organizes most Maru operations in Hjoramold, which would make her the most likely candidate for being the architect of their terrorist attack; secondly, Ketta was spotted on numerous occasions in the pilgrim camp within the Hjormaold holy site shortly before the attack, which strikes me as odd since she is not exactly known for being the religious type.

I have a feeling that Ketta's trip to Sispur has something to do with your encounter with the Maru. Sispur is one of the staunchest opponents of my campaign to modernize the Brutor, and he therefore has a motive for instigating this attack against us. The Maru themselves have no reason to attack us, so I suspect they've done so only at Sispur's bidding.

I want you to bring me Sispur's security camera logs; there's a good chance they'd prove Sispur's involvement with Ketta's agents in Hjoramold. Once I have the digital recordings of his security cameras, I will hopefully be able to prove that Ketta was working for Sispur, and thus cause him considerable embarrassment.

Your first problem is getting into Sispur's estate. You need a keycard to access the acceleration gate leading further into his estate, and this keycard is not easy to acquire. I suggest you pay a visit to Famon Gurch, a sleazy dog of a merchant who resides in the Carnival in Barkrik. He has often been seen in Sispur's company, and I would be surprised if he didn't have a keycard into the estate.

This is an important mission, which will have significant impact on your faction standings.

story: Nabur rupe tradiția: investighează un șaman și o trădare din Sispur's Estate.
Nabur breaks with tradition, investigating a shaman and a betrayal at Sispur's Estate.

goal: Aduci Portable Power Generator.
Bring a Portable Power Generator.
reward: Un BPC storyline (3 rulări).
A storyline BPC (3 runs).
steps: Omori gărzile din locația misiunii și iei generatorul.
Kill the guards at the mission location and take the generator.

m.t: Utopian Signs - Antenna In the Sky (2 of 3)
goal: Duci o încărcătură de 200 m³.
Carry a 200 m³ load.
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Curier simplu.
A simple courier.

m.t: Utopian Signs - Navy Issue Amplifier (3 of 3)
goal: Aduci Navy Issue Amplifier.
Bring the Navy Issue Amplifier.
reward: Un BPC storyline (3 rulări) și standing la Minmatar Republic.
A storyline BPC (3 runs) and Minmatar Republic standing.
steps: Itemul e în Contested Minmatar Army Complex.
The item is in Contested Minmatar Army Complex.

story: Ramakell urmărește semnale ciudate din Culture Recess.
Ramakell tracks strange signals from the Culture Recess.

m.t: Corpse Dealer - The Bodypart Trade Part (1 of 3)
goal: Duci 10 Frozen Livers (100 m³).
Carry 10 Frozen Livers (100 m³).
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Curier simplu.
A simple courier.
m.brief:
If that's the case. I got something I think you're suited for. People here avoid me like the plague, and I can't fathom why, I just make my living like the next guy... I got a family to feed, ya know.

Anyway, to get straight to business, I deal in body parts. Now don't get al pale and shocked on me, eh? I am not one of those crazy Blood Raider flesh-eaters, ya know. All I do is acuire body parts of the deceased and sell them to the highest bidder, usually to the medical divisions within some of the major corporations of the Republic. You know, for research or cheap transplants to needy patients.

Anyway, i need some frozen livers i recently purchased to be transferred to the Eifyr and Co. research center in Eram. I'll provide you with a bookmark and everything: all you need to de is drop of the goods in your hangar there and my associates will pick it up.

m.t: Corpse Dealer - Bring Back the Corpse Part (2 of 3)
goal: Recuperezi cadavrele turiștilor Gallente din epava navei lor.
Recover the Gallente tourists' corpses from their ship's wreck.
reward: 'Inception' Target Painter BPC (3 rulări, ME 15, TE 6), plus 450.000 ISK bonus.
'Inception' Target Painter BPC (3 runs, ME 15, TE 6), plus a 450,000 ISK bonus.
steps: Omori navele care păzesc epava.
Kill the ships guarding the wreck.
Iei cadavrele și te întorci în The Carnival.
Take the corpses and return to The Carnival.
m.brief:
I don't know if you're up for risking that ship of yours, but if you are then I got just the job for ya. This morning I was contacted by a distraught Gallente traveler. Apparently he came here with a group of colleagues from Quafe Company while on vacation. They decided to pay Barkrik a visit along their route. Yesterday they had planned to visit some ancient ruins near one of the outlying settlements within this system ... bad idea. Fortunately for my Gallente friend, he was sick that day, so he decided to stay behind on the station while his companions went on their "sightseeing" trip.

Well, it didn't end to good for them. The ancient ruins are located inside a deadspace pocket frequented by the Gist. Of course, the local who suggested they visit the ruins didn't tell them that, and I hazard a guess he was in league with those scoundrels as well. Anyway, to cut the story short, these tourists where massacred by sentry guns as soon as they appeared near the ruins.

Now here's where you come in. The Gallente who contacted me wants his colleagues' remains to take back with him to their family when he returns home. He was asking some mercenaries to brave the ruins and retrieve the bodies, and I overheard their conversation. I offered to get the job done for a very low price. Of course, any organs left intact after their deaths will mysteriously disappear before I let the Gallente have them, but that's a detail I left out of our conversation. Ha, ha.

You'll find the wreckage of the craft carrying the Gallente tourists near the ancient ruins. there are a couple Angel sentry guns that will attack you on sight. I suggest ignoring them: if you retaliate it will only cause more Gist to arrive at the scene. The ships guarding the wreckage will have to be taken care of, though. But like most Gist they will probably to arrogant to call for backup, at least until it's to late.

If you feel you're up for this task, then let me know. I'll pay well for these corpses.

m.t: Corpse Dealer - Kutill’s Hacker Program Part (3 of 3)
goal: Aduci Kutill's Data Chip (0,1 m³), de la Dagras Kutill.
Bring Kutill's Data Chip (0.1 m³) from Dagras Kutill.
reward: Ocular Filter - Basic și 'Delineative' Warp Scrambler BPC (3 rulări) ca bonus.
Ocular Filter - Basic and 'Delineative' Warp Scrambler BPC (3 runs) as a bonus.
tip: Dacă îl omori pe Dagras, nu mai poți lua misiuni de la Dagras Kutill. Fă întâi lanțul lui Dagras.
If you kill Dagras, you can no longer take missions from Dagras Kutill. Do Dagras's chain first.
steps: Îl omori pe Dagras Kutill și iei cipul.
Kill Dagras Kutill and loot the chip.
Crucișătoarele din jur devin ostile când îl ataci pe Dagras.
The cruisers around turn hostile when you attack Dagras.
m.brief:
There's just one last thing that I need. I was contacted a few months ago by one of the elders within the Brutor Tribe about a rogue Sebiestor agent operating from The Carnival in Barkrik. Altough I may be Sebiestor myself, I bear no love for those I used to call family. The suspected rogue agent is none other then Dagras Kutil, a filthy wench who deals in drugs and other illegal wares.

I've spoken to her on numerous occasions, and in one of our conversations I stumbled upon some pretty interesting info. She claims to have discovered a way to hack into the Brutor Tribe's stations database, giving her enormous power over any Brutor station. Apparently she uses some kind of program that is stored on database chips she keeps hidden in one of her compounds.

When I tried to ask her more questions about this program, she became extremely agitated and started accusing me of being a traitor to the Sebiestors. A few weeks later, I was almost killed by a gang of Maru thugs, and  I'm sure she was behind it. She has been after my neck ever since, so I've has to call in a group of Brutor mercenaries to keep me safe. Without them, I'd probably be dead now.

Sine she doesn't know you yet, . I'm sure you will have an easier time acquiring this data chip than me, If you do, I'll pay a hefty price for it.

story: Rozor face comerț cu părți de corp în The Carnival și e rivalul lui Dagras Kutill.
Rozor trades in body parts at The Carnival and is Dagras Kutill's rival.

goal: Duci 1 Tri-Vitoc (0,5 m³).
Carry 1 Tri-Vitoc (0.5 m³).
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Curier simplu.
A simple courier.
m.brief:
Did you bring me that Tri-Vitoc I need? No? You're not the guy Tarkur sent out to me? Damn! Where is that guy? I'm starting to think he was waylaid by CONCORD on the way. Friggin' cops! I need that Tri-Vitoc!

Man, what am I gonna do now? Hey! Maybe you're willing to help. Could you scoot over to Eystur for me? My pal Tarkur works in the cargo hangar on a Security Service station there. Lousy job, excellent location. Gets him close to all kinds of good stuff. Got me hooked on that Tri-vitoc a while ago, brilliant stuff, highly recommend it... Oh yeah. Now where was i?

Oh, yes, you. Go to Eystur, bring Tri-Vitoc from Tarkur. Bring it to me. It sounds so simple a monkey could do it. So, stop this monkey business and get going! Har, har! Sometimes I kill myself... Mm. Vitoc yeah.

goal: Aduci 3 Sniper ID Slice.
Bring 3 Sniper ID Slices.
reward: ISK și muniție de facțiune.
ISK and faction ammo.
steps: Cad de la crucișătoarele din site-urile COSMOS Minmatar.
They drop from cruisers in the Minmatar COSMOS sites.
m.brief:
Good job on the Tri-Vitoc delivery. Ooh, yeah. I feel like a new man. Heck, with the potency of this stuff, I probably am! My DNA's probably all screwed up.

You're a pilot after my own heart, direct and brutal. So perhaps we can work together, what do you say? If you're interested in bringing a bit of mayhem to this uptight world, then follow my lead. I've been out hunting pirates in this constellation, there sure are a lot of them around here these days. Why do I hunt pirates, an inquiring pilot such as yourself might ask? Because they don't belong here, that's why. This is my home sweet home, and these pirates can go play their little bandit plays somewhere else. This is my territory. Are you with me? I now you're with me - if you weren't you'd be dead.

No, that's just a little joke I make. Don't be alarmed. Heh. Man. this is some good Vitoc.

Uhm... oh, yeah, so some of the pirates around here, particularly those in the contested complexes, are sporting those new ID slices. I've become quite the avid collector of them, and I'm willing to reward you well if you bring me a few. The tag's I'm looking for are dropped by tough cruiser pirates, so take care. Ah, what am I saying, it's those pirates that should take care. Yoy're  the menace! Har, har, I'm joking again of course. You know I am.

goal: Distrugi nava coloniei și pe liderul ei, apoi aduci Forged Waypoint Logs (0,1 m³).
Destroy the colony ship and its leader, then bring the Forged Waypoint Logs (0.1 m³).
reward: 500MN Digital Booster Rockets BPC (3 rulări, ME 15, TE 6) și standing la Minmatar Republic.
500MN Digital Booster Rockets BPC (3 runs, ME 15, TE 6) and Minmatar Republic standing.
steps: Omori nava coloniei și liderul, iei jurnalele și te întorci.
Kill the colony ship and the leader, loot the logs and return.
m.brief:
Well done on that tag-collecting business. These Sniper ID slices now hold a place of honor in my collection. The blood spatter on one of them, man, that was pure genius! Makes it so deliciously eerie! I feel like we're really bonding here, uh... whats your... oh, yeah Schebag Korten. No, wait, that's me. Ehh, , right? This might be the beginning of something beautiful, I tell you.

I have such a good feeling about you I'm even willing to let you in on one of my schemes: A while ago, I came into the possession of some forged documents from the Amarr Empire. I have a bit of skill in forgery myself, so I altered them a bit to make them look like imperial orders instructing the bearer to head to a certain location here in Ani for coloniation purposes. These Armarrians are always looking to expand, so it's easy to bait a group of wannabe colonists into thinking they have in their hands official permission to settle here. As if the Empire had any say in who settles here and who not? Bah, the fools!

Needless to say the location here in Ani is in the middle of nowhere; just some old rogue drone hive long since cleaned out. I've already taken out several settlers in the past myself, but with you and me getting on so well, I thought I'd give you e shot at it.

It's nasty business, I can tell you, killing innocent Amarr civilians in cold blood when thy're only looking for a place to call home. But I know you have the stomach for it. After all, how innocent can they be, with the blood of my ancestors on their hands? Kill them all, and good riddance to them is what I say. Spit in their eye as they die, mother, father, child and all. Show me you got the guts and I'll reward you with a rare BPC.

Oh, one more thing. Bring the forged documents back to me. This little trap is too sweet not to spring a few more times before they get suspicious.

story: Schebach conduce anarhiștii din Insurgent Encampment.
Schebach leads the anarchists at the Insurgent Encampment.

m.t: In the Name of Science - Runes (1 of 4)
goal: Aduci 2 Runic Tablet (0,2 m³).
Bring 2 Runic Tablets (0.2 m³).
reward: 1.000 Republic Fleet Nuclear M.
1,000 Republic Fleet Nuclear M.
steps: Tăblițele cad din Gisti Repair Station, în primul coridor din Contested Minmatar Army Complex.
The tablets drop from the Gisti Repair Station in the first corridor of Contested Minmatar Army Complex.
m.brief:
Look at that ugly structure over there. They call it the Culture Recess and its solemn decay fits my mood perfectly these days. Once I was a proud member of the Sister's research efforts. I had my own lab and staff and every day I woke up with joy in my heart for what wonders I would discover. But the Sisters are a bickering lot, don't let the outer facade of calm and serenity fool you. Behind closed doors you can find fierce rivalry and constant jostling for a higher place in the pecking order. I was adept in playing their games of backstabbing and politics, bur not adept enough. One day I found myself out of a job.

I was offered a lowly assistant's position on an insignificant little project. I refused to take it and have been a renegade sister since. But I still hope to regain my former stature within the Sisterhood. If I'm to have any hope of ousting my rivals I must make a crashing entrance, showcasing something magnificent. So here, in the shadow of this ruined monument of past follies I aim to rebuild my career. I will make a discovery so grand, so momentous, that the Sisters will be forced to accept me back in on my own terms.

I'm finding it hard to do this alone. Material things have never interested me, so I haven't squandered my life savings on something trivial like most. Now I can put my money and my belongings to good use. I'm interested in hiring pilots with the skills and talents to aid me in my task.

If you're interested. I want to hire you for a small job that is too dangerous for a mere scientist such as myself. Over in the Traun system you can find the ruins of an old Nefantar fortress. The Angel Cartel currently holds it and has launched an effort to restore it. Just before I left the Sisters one of our informants within the cartel reported that the repair drones in the old fortress discovered a stash of ancient tablets with strange indecipherable markings on them. The Angels haven't bothered with the tablets beyond storing those the drones return with in their repair stations.

Now here's the interesting part. A few year ago I was working on a project that compelled me to dig trough the ancient history of the Nefantar tribe, from times long before the Amarrians ever arrived in Minmatar space. While traveling in Hjoramold, the tribe's ancestral home, I came upon several tablets with runic inscription, filled with very thought provoking information. I can't go into details here, but it is the key to my work.

I suspect that the tablets that the Angels discovered in Traun might be more of these runic tablets. If so then those tablets could give me a breakthrough in my research efforts. I need someone well versed in the art of war to retrieve those tablets in Traun for me. I will reward you well if you're willing to take this on.

m.t: In the Name of Science - Stakes (2 of 4)
goal: Duci Patrenn's Stash (300 m³) în lowsec.
Carry Patrenn's Stash (300 m³) into lowsec.
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Destinația e în lowsec. Zboară atent.
The destination is in lowsec. Fly carefully.
m.brief:
My research is going well. My decision to hire independent pilots has paid of really well. But i fear it also has backfired somewhat by putting too much heat on me. The Sisters have become aware of my whereabouts and what I'm trying to achieve. While I doubt it, one of my rivals could decide to dent my efforts by sending some thugs here to rough me up and destroy my work. The physical risk does not concern me all that much, but if I loose my work I have nothing.

I always like to be on the safe side, so I've made backup copies of my research. I need to get them to a safe place. First, I considered placing them in a depository box in a bank, but me hiring such a box is too easy to track down. Maybe I'm being paranoid, but you never know. So instead I've opted to hire a low-key storage room in a remote system to stash my backup copies in.

Obviously, I can't go there myself, I might be followed. but they would never bother with someone such as you, so you're an ideal candidate for the job. Take my stash to the Ragnarg system and by the time you return I'm sure i will have something more interesting , less paranoid, for you to do.

m.t: In the Name of Science - Taint (3 of 4)
goal: Omori pirații și aduci 2 Broken Science Equipment (2 m³).
Kill the pirates and bring 2 Broken Science Equipment (2 m³).
reward: Un BPC storyline (3 rulări) ca bonus.
A storyline BPC (3 runs) as a bonus.
steps: După poartă sunt două grupuri: 3 crucișătoare chiar la sosire și al doilea la circa 40 km.
Past the gate are two groups: 3 cruisers right at warp-in and a second group about 40 km away.
Grupurile nu se ajută între ele.
The groups do not help each other.
m.brief:
I'm ready to take my research to the next level. but to do so I must get my hands on some decent science instruments. Without a big corp behind me, the manufacturers of these items won't even speak to me. I've been scouring the second hand market, but not found anything of value. My work will soon stall of I don't get this stuff.

I received an interesting tidbit from a former colleague of mine, one of the few still talking to me. it seems one of the secret research labs the Sisters are running in Lanngisi just had a serious accident and was abandoned. I don't know the extent of the accident, but do know that some lethal substances leaked out. I'm sure the place is already crawling with scavengers, but if we move quickly we might get something good.

It's funny, only a few weeks ago I would be shattered by these news, but now I hardly feel anything. All I care about is how I can exploit this disaster to my own advantage. I guess I just have learnt that to succeed in this harsh world, one must be extra tough. My sheltered life has never exposed me to this world until now, but I feel I'm coping well.

Enough about that. If you're willing to go over to the contaminated research lab and see if you can find any science instruments, I'm sure I can find something suitable to reward you with upon your return. It doesn't mater if the items are broken, just get me a few and I'm sure I can make something out of them. If the facility itself doesn't yield anything you might have to take out some of the scavengers there and see if they cough something interesting up. Just make sure to blow up everything you see there to make sure you get all the salvageable items.

m.t: In the Name of Science - Portal (4 of 4)
goal: Aduci 3 Mysterious Portal Parts (3 m³).
Bring 3 Mysterious Portal Parts (3 m³).
reward: Standing la Sisters of EVE și un BPC storyline (3 rulări) ca bonus.
Sisters of EVE standing and a storyline BPC (3 runs) as a bonus.
steps: Piesele cad din Damaged Portal, în Overrun Security Corridor din Contested Minmatar Army Complex.
The parts drop from the Damaged Portal in the Overrun Security Corridor of Contested Minmatar Army Complex.
E un singur portal în cameră, deci aștepți să reapară.
There is only one portal in the room, so you wait for it to respawn.
m.brief:
Thanks to you my research is back on track. I feel like I'm getting close to something big. You remember those tablets you got me awhile ago? I've managed to get some sense out of them and the information I've gleaned points to one place in particular that might hold the key to this whole thing. Unfortunately that place is not exactly accessible. It lies deeper in the same complex that you found the tablets in, in the Traun system. This place I'm talking about is an ancient portal of some sorts. Sadly, it has long since ceased to function. I'm also beginning to suspect that it wasn't build by the Nefantars themself, but some other, more elusive, civilization. I'm not sure exactly where it lies, but it is an immense structure, so it can;t be all that hard to locate.

I need pieces of the damaged portal. If you can get them for me I would be eternally grateful. just to show you how serious I am, I'm offering you a very rare BPC as a reward when you return with a few pieces of the damaged portal. Needless to say you can expect trouble there, so be prepared.

story: Sifor e savant la Sisters of EVE și studiază rune și un portal misterios.
Sifor is a Sisters of EVE scientist studying runes and a mysterious portal.

goal: Duci Clone SOE Officer (1 m³).
Carry the Clone SOE Officer (1 m³).
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Curier simplu.
A simple courier.
m.brief: Add mission briefing here and remove comment markers

goal: Aduci 2 Angel Cartel Computer Hardware.
Bring 2 Angel Cartel Computer Hardware.
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Cad din Angel Hardware Storage, în Overrun Supply Bunker din Contested Minmatar Guerilla Base.
They drop from the Angel Hardware Storage in the Overrun Supply Bunker of Contested Minmatar Guerilla Base.

goal: Aduci 4 Refugees.
Bring 4 Refugees.
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Îi găsești în Contested Minmatar Guerilla Base sau îi cumperi din piață.
Find them in Contested Minmatar Guerilla Base or buy them on the market.

goal: Duci 3 Reports (0,3 m³).
Carry 3 Reports (0.3 m³).
reward: Un BPC storyline (3 rulări) și standing de facțiune.
A storyline BPC (3 runs) and faction standing.
tip: Agentul e Caldari: îți trebuie standing cu Caldari State.
This agent is Caldari: you need Caldari State standing.
steps: Curier simplu.
A simple courier.

story: Suky, agent Caldari în The Asylum, are de livrat o clonă și de recuperat hardware de la Angel Cartel.
Suky, a Caldari agent at The Asylum, has a clone to deliver and hardware to recover from the Angel Cartel.

m.t: Attack of the Killer Drones - ST 58 (1 of 3)
goal: Distrugi ST58 și aduci ST58 Memory Chip (0,1 m³).
Destroy ST58 and bring the ST58 Memory Chip (0.1 m³).
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Un battlecruiser e recomandat.
A battlecruiser is recommended.
Poarta se deschide doar după ce omori tot. Bonusul e de 2 ore.
The gate opens only after you kill everything. The bonus is 2 hours.

m.t: Attack of the Killer Drones - ST 59 (2 of 3)
goal: Duci ST 59 Memory Chip (0,1 m³).
Carry the ST 59 Memory Chip (0.1 m³).
reward: 1.000 Republic Fleet Nuclear M și Social Adaptation Chip - Basic ca bonus.
1,000 Republic Fleet Nuclear M and Social Adaptation Chip - Basic as a bonus.
steps: Locul de ridicare e în lowsec. Bonusul e de 4 ore.
The pickup is in lowsec. The bonus is 4 hours.
m.brief: Model ST 59 has somehow ended up in Evati, many jumps from here. It was destroyed by militia forces in the system, and its remains transferred to the Republic Justice Department station there. I made a deal with them to allow me to access the memory chip to investigate the cause of the malfunction, but I couldn't find a convoy heading to Hjoramold in time. Could you fetch it for me ASAP? I have to return it in a couple of weeks, so the faster you get it here, the better.

goal: Aduci ST 60 Memory Chip (0,1 m³).
Bring the ST 60 Memory Chip (0.1 m³).
reward: Un BPC storyline (3 rulări) și standing de facțiune.
A storyline BPC (3 runs) and faction standing.
steps: Cipul e în ST 60 Hideout. Bonusul e de 2 ore.
The chip is in the ST 60 Hideout. The bonus is 2 hours.
m.brief:
The last drone memory chip I need you to fetch is ST 60's. The '60 is my finest drone of the ST series, a prototype, and certainly a force to be reckoned with. I think you might have to find some friends to help you take it on ― yes, it's really that tough, if I do say so myself.

It's currently orbiting a rogue drone installation near Hjoramold XII Moon I, located deep within what we call "Glittermore," the xenon gas cloud of Hjoramold XII. It's a very hostile part of space, but a magnificent sight nonetheless and one frequented by tourists. Good luck finding those drones, .

story: Drone ucigașe numerotate, ST 58, 59 și 60, terorizează zona din jurul Lord Bastion.
Numbered killer drones, ST 58, 59 and 60, terrorize the area around Lord Bastion.

goal: Aduci Arms Cache (2 m³) pentru rezistență.
Bring the Arms Cache (2 m³) for the resistance.
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Misiunea e în lowsec (0,3).
The mission is in lowsec (0.3).
Iei depozitul de arme și îl duci agentului.
Take the arms cache to the agent.
m.brief:
There are millions of minmatars living in the Joas constellation which are not ethnically Nefantar, and many of them are still loyal to the Republic. Even some of the Nefantar living in the area are sympathetic to our cause. Hence there is a strong resistance movement there, which in fact started long before the Rebellion. The strength of the resistance has varied greatly through the years, but the Audesder incident has refueled unrest in the region. And this may be a key factor in our campaign to hold Audesder.

What I'd like you to do is transfer a large arms cache to my contact in . This contact of mine is an agent of the Joas resistance, he will see to it that the arms cache gets to the right hands. Try to avoid any contact with the Ammatar or their allies, if they find out what you're up to then you'll have one hell of a fight on your hands. Good luck.

goal: Aduci 9 Finger Bone.
Bring 9 Finger Bones.
reward: Medium Degenerative Concussion Bomb I BPC (3 rulări, ME 6, TE 6).
Medium Degenerative Concussion Bomb I BPC (3 runs, ME 6, TE 6).
steps: Oasele cad de la pirații din centurile constelației COSMOS din Ani.
The bones drop from belt rats in the Ani COSMOS constellation.
m.brief:
Come close, child. I am blind and my cerebro-audial sensors are weak. Still, even so I can sense your inner strength and passion. They match my own. That is good. Very good.

The Ani constellation is a place in turmoil. I can see it as a frantic swirl in my mind's eye. This place has become the playground of many great powers, some visible to eye and some not. Lives are being taken and lives are being thrown away. Right and wrong hold little sway here: anger and hate are the driving forces. This flood of emotions pouring into this melting pot make it hard for me to perceive the currents of the future. I need to under take my most potent divinations to pierce this veil of uncertainty and proclaim the great prophecy I feel building within me.

I need your help . That is your name, correct? , the asteroid belts here, as everywhere, are infested with pirates and murderers, curse all, worthless dogs who prey on fear and passivity. I need you to bring me a few finger bones collected from pirates around the constellation. Yes, finger bones: I need nine for my divination to hold true.

goal: Duci Prophecy Virus (0,1 m³) la Dudedra IV - Krusal Tribe Bureau.
Carry the Prophecy Virus (0.1 m³) to Dudedra IV - Krusal Tribe Bureau.
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Destinația e în lowsec.
The destination is in lowsec.
m.brief:
My incantation is complete and my prophecy freed. Now I need to get it out to the people. But I'm not a popular man in the Republic. The tribal elders see me as a threat to their precious stability. Yet all I do is tell the truth as I see it. As I see it.

Lethargy has settled upon our government and the Armarrians are exploiting it to their own advantage. I have seen a dusty road filled with blood-covered slaves. Minmatar slaves. Yes, the Empire dreams of conquering us once again: already they have woven a web of deceit and treachery around our mighty Republic. The elders are being deceived and the public lulled. Only my prophecies can make them realize the peril we are all in. A peril that is all too real and all too close. The Empire is building its strength and its hunger is rising.

My words and my works have been banned from Republic space. But my message must be heard or all is lost. So I have to ask another favor from you . I have a friend not far from here who has access to a public network. If I can get the prophecy to him, he can spread it throughout the Republic. Masking my prophecy as a virus is not something i relish, but it must be done. What I need you to do is smuggle the prophecy virus to my friend. I'm much to well known a figure to republic authorities to have a chance of doing this myself.

goal: Duci 10 Freed Pet Slaves (10 m³) de la Traun X - Moon 6 la Lanngisi III - Moon 2 - Sisters of EVE Bureau.
Carry 10 Freed Pet Slaves (10 m³) from Traun X - Moon 6 to Lanngisi III - Moon 2 - Sisters of EVE Bureau.
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Ridici foștii sclavi și îi predai.
Pick up the freed slaves and deliver them.
m.brief:
My head is still aching from my last divination. I don't think I will be ready for one for some time now. These old bones of mine are getting tired. I must rest soon. But before I do you must swear to me you'll take care of an ugly business that came to my attention just now.

It seemed an Amarr Holder exiled from the Empire has taken up a residence here in Ani. This particular Holder is notorious for his disgusting depravities. He hold slaves like they were his pets, forcing them to participate in his cruel games. Fortunately, several of these poor slaves managed to escape the evil clutches of their master. They are now in my care, but are in need of more then I am capable of giving them.

Please help these unfortunate souls by transporting them over to the Servant Sisters of EVE station in Lanngisi, where they can be properly cared for. Meanwhile, I will have my disciples locate this crazed Holder so he can be dealt with before he hurts anyone else.

m.t: Blind Seer - Tit for Tat (4 of 4)
goal: Aduci Sadry Damoklet's Head.
Bring Sadry Damoklet's Head.
reward: Neural Boost - Standard și Large Degenerative Concussion Bomb I BPC ca bonus în 3 ore.
Neural Boost - Standard and Large Degenerative Concussion Bomb I BPC as a bonus within 3 hours.
steps: Capul cade de la Unmarked Bestower, în Overrun Security Corridor din Contested Minmatar Army Complex.
The head drops from the Unmarked Bestower in the Overrun Security Corridor of Contested Minmatar Army Complex.
Site-ul primește până la battlecruiser.
The site allows up to battlecruisers.
m.brief:
How good of you to visit me again, . I've been awaiting your return for some time now. I managed to track down the depraved Amarr Holder of whom I spoke at our last meeting. He's in the Traun system, visiting a station controlled by some lackeys from the Angel Cartel. I do not know what his business is there, and really I don't care. Whatever it is it will die with him. He has fitted out an old Bestower as a pleasure ship, so look for a Bestower docked at an Angel station. You should find it in the contested complex in the Trau  system.

By the way, I was contacted by the Sisters in Lanngisi just before you arrived and they informed me that one of the slaves you brought them is a distant relative of mine. Even though my concern extends to all Minmatars, this makes the matter personal. As such, I'm offering a rare blueprint copy to be given to you once you take care of this Amarrian quickly and efficiently. Bring me his head when you're done. then I can go and rest with my mind at peace.

reward: Memory Augmentation - Improved și Cybernetic Subprocessor - Basic ca bonus.
Memory Augmentation - Improved and Cybernetic Subprocessor - Basic as a bonus.

This agent is Thukker Tribe and needs 9.5 standing with them.
steps: Insignele cad de la ofițerii Imperial Navy sau le cumperi din piață.
The insignia drop from Imperial Navy officers or you buy them on the market.
Le predai în UNJ-GX.
Hand them in at UNJ-GX.
m.brief:
We have a policy here within the Thukker Tribe that our more prominent members use certain implants to boost their mental ability, since it's important that our people in key positions perform at a level above what's considered normal for a human being. It's a competitive world we live in, and sometimes one has to take risks to achieve one's goals, even if it means meddling with the brain.

You may not be a full-fledged member of Thukker Mix, but you've created such a name for yourself that we feel obliged to treat you as one of our own. And considering your record, we feel that our policy pertains to you as well. So I've been authorized to give you this implant in exchange for one simple task. Bring me a few insignias and the reward is yours.

goal: O salvezi pe Sidura Meisana (0,1 m³).
Rescue Sidura Meisana (0.1 m³).
reward: Gas Cloud Harvester I, plus 5,5 mil. ISK bonus în 3 ore.
Gas Cloud Harvester I, plus a 5.5M ISK bonus within 3 hours.
steps: Site-ul are restricții de mărime a navei.
The site has ship size restrictions.
Poarta din prima cameră se deschide doar după ce omori tot. Întăririle vin la intervale.
The first room gate opens only after you kill everything. Reinforcements arrive over time.
În a doua cameră îl omori pe Jakora Mopen. Sidura intră singură în cargo și misiunea e gata.
In the second room kill Jakora Mopen. Sidura goes straight into your cargo and the mission completes.
m.brief: I've been contacted by one of the mining harvesters working in the vicinity. It's a private matter, and the poor man is desperate for assistance. His niece, a good-looking but rather quiet woman, lives with him and takes care of their living quarters, but when he got home a few days back, she was gone. After much searching, he discovered that she had been kidnapped by the Angel Cartel, in an operation led by the pirate captain Rubin Sozar. We need you to go find the girl. Her uncle is beside himself with worry and is willing to give up all his savings for her safe retrieval, along with the destruction of the man who put him through all this grief. It is imperative that you get his niece back to us before going after Rubin Sozar, because if anything goes wrong with the rescue we will need him alive to barter for her return. Needless to say, her uncle's savings will not go to you unless the young woman is back where she belongs, safe and sound.

goal: Îl omori pe Rubin Sozar.
Kill Rubin Sozar.
reward: Republic Fleet EM Armor Hardener, standing la Minmatar Republic și 10,5 mil. ISK bonus în 3 ore.
Republic Fleet EM Armor Hardener, Minmatar Republic standing and a 10.5M ISK bonus within 3 hours.
steps: Sunt trei camere cu multe valuri. Unele apar când te apropii de poartă sau după ce omori anumite nave.
There are three rooms with many waves. Some spawn when you near the gate or after you kill certain ships.
Ajungi la Rubin în ultima cameră și îl distrugi.
Reach Rubin in the last room and destroy the ship.
m.brief: I'm very glad you returned the young woman to her proper place. Under normal circumstances that would be the end of it and we'd all live happily ever after, if perhaps a little poorer in her uncle's case. As it turns out, these are anything but normal circumstances. His niece wasn't kidnapped by a pirate captain; she eloped with him. Rubin Sozar had promised her that once he had finished some business nearby, they would start a new life together and that she would be treated like a princess. It's all a lie, of course - these people are no more capable of civilized behavior or affection than some wild animal would be. You have to find that pirate and kill him, or he will simply trick the poor, deluded girl into eloping again. Her uncle assures me that she was treated horribly at the hands of these pirates, so badly, in fact, that he has been forced to lock her up in a section of his quarters and refuse to let anyone speak to her. He says she will remain there until she comes to her senses.

story: Akelf vrea înapoi o rudă răpită de Angel Cartel și pe cel vinovat mort.
Akelf wants back a relative kidnapped by the Angel Cartel, and the one responsible dead.

goal: Distrugi convoiul de contrabandă.
Destroy the smuggler convoy.
reward: Gas Cloud Harvester I.
Gas Cloud Harvester I.
steps: Site-ul are restricții de mărime a navei.
The site has ship size restrictions.
Transporturile lasă câte 10 droguri aleatorii, de exemplu Nerve Sticks.
The transports drop 10 random drugs each, such as Nerve Sticks.
m.brief: You've heard, I hope, of the Angel Cartel drug smuggling into Minmatar space. No one will ever know how many lives have been destroyed by this ugly scourge, but while we cannot help those poor souls who have already fallen prey to booster abuse, I'm not going to sit by and let the drugs continue spreading to new victims. I am aware that not everyone around here shares my sentiments. My superiors feel that it's useless to strike at the dealers and the couriers, that the only way to uproot this problem is to stop it at its source. They say that to do otherwise is a waste of time and money. And they're right, I'm sure. Of course they're right. So what I am absolutely not going to do is send out a single rogue pilot and tell him to cut off a supply convoy carrying drugs to Minmatar children. Let's be crystal clear on that. I am certainly not asking you to help me out on a secret task to rid us of one clandestine shipment, just one, even if nobody would notice its disappearance anyway. We understand one another, I trust.

goal: Distrugi fabrica de boostere Angel Cartel.
Destroy the Angel Cartel booster factory.
reward: Republic Fleet Dual 425mm Autocannon. Misiune importantă pentru standing.
Republic Fleet Dual 425mm Autocannon. An important mission for standing.
tip: Comandantul Domination lasă Domination Crystal Tag și muniție Arch Angel.
The Domination commander drops a Domination Crystal Tag and Arch Angel ammo.
steps: Poarta se deschide doar după ce omori tot din prima cameră.
The gate opens only after you kill everything in the first room.
În a doua cameră distrugi Manufacturing Facility (un Angel Battlestation). Când tragi în ea vine un Domination.
In the second room destroy the Manufacturing Facility (an Angel Battlestation). Shooting it brings in a Domination.
Misiunea e gata când cade structura.
The mission completes when the structure dies.
m.brief: Welcome back, and congratulations on your task. Not that I had anything to do with it in any way whatsoever, but I'm very happy with your efforts. Which I know nothing about. But good job nonetheless. Whatever you did. While you were away, we received orders that I've been praying for. We've located the booster manufacturing facility itself, and it's time to strike at the source. There are some that claim this recent attack by an unnamed pilot on a smuggling convoy was badly timed, and that we now have only a few days before the Cartel decides to move its operation to a new secret location. But then, I don't recall those same people giving any good reason why we should allow even one parcel of drugs to pass into the hands of our citizens. Nevertheless, fingers have been pointed, and people are quite annoyed at having to rush in. While I don't have the slightest doubts that I made the right decision in sending you to destroy that convoy - NOT sending you to destroy that convoy, I should say, because of course I had nothing to do with it - it may nonetheless be a wise decision on our part to get there first and destroy that manufacturing facility all by ourselves. It will give us a little added glory, just in case someone decides to get clever about that convoy business.

story: Androver vrea oprit traficul de droguri Angel Cartel spre spațiul Minmatar.
Androver wants the Angel Cartel drug trade into Minmatar space stopped.

A storyline BPC (3 runs).
