The mission completes only after all enemies are dead.

story: Damos, agent Amarr, negociază un acord cu Angel Cartel și îți cere favoruri murdare.
Damos, an Amarr agent, is brokering a deal with the Angel Cartel and asks you for dirty favors.

goal: Distrugi buncărul inamic și aduci informatorul (2 m³).
Destroy the enemy bunker and bring back the informant (2 m³).
reward: Gas Cloud Harvester I.
Gas Cloud Harvester I.
tip: Misiunea se termină aici. Partea a doua nu mai apare.
The mission ends here. The second part no longer appears.
steps: Locația e în Z-A8FS (-0,5), nullsec.
The location is in Z-A8FS (-0.5), nullsec.
Site-ul are restricții de mărime a navei. Structurile sunt Thukker, deci pierzi puțin standing cu ei.
The site has ship size restrictions. The structures are Thukker, so you lose a little standing with them.
Distrugi buncărul, iei informatorul și te întorci.
Destroy the bunker, take the informant and return.
m.brief:
Okelle Alash has not yet broken under questioning. However, now that his fleet failed to save him, we have reason to believe that his brother Martokar is going to try it. This is the big break we were hoping for. Martokar is the very man we've been after, a brutal criminal who arrived here on the run, having been implicated in kidnappings, slave trade and the murder of CONCORD officers. He hasn't been here long and has already established himself a big player in the booster smuggling business. We need this man taken down.

Martokar is amassing an attack fleet at the moment, and one of the people he tried to recruit has been spotted by our agents in a nearby establishment, ranting about the lousy offer he got. This man is the only chance we'll get at discovering Martokar's precise location, so we need you to retrieve him right away. If we screw this up, Martokar may strike at any time while we're completely unprepared, and good people will die. Obviously, Martokar is going to want to silence this poor fellow before he can reveal anything, so we need to get there first.

However, we mustn't let Martokar think that we've got sensitive information on him, since that'll only make him change his plans and will ruin any advantage we had. We therefore need you to lay waste to the entire location, making it look like our informant perished in the process. Once you've destroyed the place and anyone snooping around, bring the guy back to us.

m.t: The Audesder War Effort, The Voucher (1 of 8)
goal: Aduci Ison's Voucher (1 m³).
Bring Ison's Voucher (1 m³).

1.3M ISK, plus a 1.33M ISK bonus.

You get it from Aville Ancare, Daemire Adamia, Esordik Mitt or Wirdar Erazako for 5 training certificates.

goal: Cureți zona cu Caldari Broadcasting Unit.
Clear the area around the Caldari Broadcasting Unit.
reward: Caldari P.A. Keycard Replica, plus 600.000 ISK bonus.
Caldari P.A. Keycard Replica, plus a 600,000 ISK bonus.

Keep the keycard: it opens the gate in the next mission.

Three rooms with Ammatar and Caldari.
Misiunea e gata când moare ultimul inamic.
The mission completes when the last enemy dies.
m.brief: You're going to start with something easy, . The Caldari Navy's propaganda machine has been spreading lies and misinformation amongst our army for some time now. For weeks we've been trying to located the source of their broadcasting but it wasn't until today that we narrowed down the signal to a small area of deadspace in the outer regions of Audesder. I would like you to investigate the area and report your findings to me.

m.t: The Audesder War Effort, Strike At The Caldari (3 of 8)
goal: Distrugi Caldari Broadcasting Unit.
Destroy the Caldari Broadcasting Unit.
reward: 1 mil. ISK, plus 500.000 ISK bonus.
1M ISK, plus a 500,000 ISK bonus.
steps: Ia Caldari P.A. Keycard Replica în cargo. Poarta din camera 3 îl consumă.
Have the Caldari P.A. Keycard Replica in cargo. The room 3 gate consumes it.
Misiunea e gata când distrugi turnul din camera 4.
The mission completes when you destroy the tower in room 4.
m.brief: Ok. I want you to fly straight to the broadcasting unit that you discovered in your last mission. Destroy it, and return to me. You will probably have to face a number of guards from the Amarrian alliance, but I'm sure you can handle it. They've probably brought in some reinforcements since you're last attack, so be prepared. Good luck.

m.t: The Audesder War Effort, Smuggling The Marines (4 of 8)
goal: Duci 1 Marines (2 m³) din Audesder la Arnola VII - Moon 1 - Trust Partners Trading Post.
Carry 1 Marines (2 m³) from Audesder to Arnola VII - Moon 1 - Trust Partners Trading Post.
reward: 300.000 ISK, plus 200.000 ISK bonus.
300,000 ISK, plus a 200,000 ISK bonus.
steps: Audesder e lowsec (0,3) și zonă de război.
Audesder is lowsec (0.3) and a war zone.
m.brief: "It's time to send you into more dangerous territory, . I really hope you are up to it. This time I want you to smuggle a platoon of our marines into Arnola VII - Moon 1 - Trust Partners Trading Post, which the Ammatar have overtaken to use as a military base close to Kenobanala. The marines we are sending are on a suicide mission to sabotage the production facilities there, which are being used by the Ammatar and Imperial Navies to assemble their ships of war. Return to me immediately once this has been done. I'm counting on you, ."

m.t: The Audesder War Effort, The Khanid Outpost (5 of 8)
goal: Aduci Khanid Commander (1 m³).
Bring the Khanid Commander (1 m³).
reward: 1 mil. ISK și 1.000 Republic Fleet Titanium Sabot L ca bonus.
1M ISK and 1,000 Republic Fleet Titanium Sabot L as a bonus.
steps: Două camere. Când ataci Khanid Kazmaar, vin întăriri.
Two rooms. Attacking the Khanid Kazmaar calls in reinforcements.
Misiunea e gata când moare Kazmaar.
The mission completes when the Kazmaar dies.
m.brief:
Yes, and now is when it starts to get really dangerous. Again I want you to travel to Kenobanala, this time to a Khanid outpost near Fort Kumar. It was erected to accommodate a large force of Kameira soldiers, because they were not considered ‘good enough' to share living quarters with those of true Amarrian ancestry, nor even the traitorous Ammatar! As you well know, the Kameiras are Minmatar slaves of the Amarr and Khanid who are forced to serve in their military, and who's purpose is usually to be cannon fodder on the front lines in times of war.

I want these Kameiras rescued. But doing that will be tricky. The Khanid complex consists of 3 areas, not including the forward point at the entrance of the deadspace pocket. We have managed to acquire the access codes of the first two acceleration gates, but the 3rd one is unknown to us. Unfortunately the last room of the complex is where the Kameiras living quarters are.

I want you to fly to the Khanid outpost and search the rooms we have access to. Try to find something that will help us unlock the 3rd room, and bring it back here. Perhaps someone among the Khanid guards knows the code.

m.t: The Audesder War Effort, Espionage (6 of 8)
goal: Aduci Gallente Intelligence Data Recorder (0,1 m³).
Bring the Gallente Intelligence Data Recorder (0.1 m³).
reward: Social Adaptation Chip - Basic și 1.000 Republic Fleet Proton M ca bonus.
Social Adaptation Chip - Basic and 1,000 Republic Fleet Proton M as a bonus.
steps: Iei înregistratorul din locația misiunii și îl duci agentului.
Take the recorder from the mission location to the agent.
m.brief: While we wait for the interrogation of the Khanid commander to finish, I'd like you to conduct an extremely dangerous mission for me, . The Gallente managed to smuggle a data recorder into Fort Kumar, the base of operations of our enemies in Kenobanala. It's currently located in one of the army quarters inside their base. All you have to do is infiltrate Fort Kumar and retrieve this data recorder. Return to me once you have it.

m.t: The Audesder War Effort, Freeing The Kameiras (7 of 8)
goal: Eliberezi un Kameiras (1 m³).
Free a Kameiras (1 m³).
reward: Ocular Filter - Standard și Ocular Filter - Basic ca bonus.
Ocular Filter - Standard and Ocular Filter - Basic as a bonus.
steps: Plătești garanția de 50.000 ISK.
Pay the 50,000 ISK collateral.
În camera 2, un container lasă Khanid Commander Keycard, care deschide poarta și se consumă.
In room 2, a container drops the Khanid Commander Keycard, which opens the gate and is consumed.
În camera 3 distrugi structura. Lasă 2 Kameiras și un Slaver Hound.
In room 3 destroy the structure. It drops 2 Kameiras and a Slaver Hound.
m.brief:
We managed to locate a key that should work on the 3rd acceleration gate inside the Khanid outpost where the Kameiras are being held. The Khanid commander you captured revealed its location to us. It's more reliable than an access code, since they probably already changed those after your last attack. You'll find the key in a small container not far from the stargate. It is cloaked and locked but since we know it's exact location now, your ship scanner should be able to detect it. You'll have to destroy the container to acquire the key.

Assuming that the key still works, you should be able to get into the 3rd area of the complex and save the Kameiras from captivity. I'm sure the Khanid and their allies have sent in reinforcements after your last attack, so be prepared for a difficult fight. You'll have to bring some friends along if you wish to have any chance of success.

Just a word of warning though, the Kameiras are normally extremely loyal to the Empire, being more efficiently brainwashed than normal slaves. They are raised with no education of their origins, and it usually takes some time to convince them that we speak the truth. So you'll probably have to take them by force. I'll supply you with some Eforte gas which will paralyze them instantly, allowing your crew to safely transfer them into your cargo hold. Good luck, .

m.t: The Audesder War Effort, The Dreadnought Manufacturing Facility (8 of 8)
goal: Distrugi assembly array-ul fabricii de dreadnought-uri.
Destroy the assembly array at the dreadnought factory.
reward: Neural Boost - Standard, plus 5 mil. ISK bonus în 6 ore.
Neural Boost - Standard, plus a 5M ISK bonus within 6 hours.
steps: Două camere cu Caldari, Amarr și Guristas.
Two rooms with Caldari, Amarr and Guristas.
Misiunea e gata când moare Baronul din camera 2.
The mission completes when the Baron in room 2 dies.
Loot bun: Armored Command Mindlink, Mining Foreman Mindlink și itemele lui Whelan Machorin.
Good loot: an Armored Command Mindlink, a Mining Foreman Mindlink and Whelan Machorin's items.
m.brief:
It's time to send you on your last assignment, . I'm sure this will be one of the most difficult encounter you have ever faced. I'm reluctant to send you on such a suicide mission, but you're the only one qualified for the job that we have. If we sent in our fleet they would be instantly attacked by everyone in Fort Kumar. You on the other hand should be able to get by them unnoticed, if you are cautious enough.

What you need to do is destroy the assembly array of the primary Amarr dreadnought manufacturing facility in Kenobanala. It's pumping out dreadnoughts faster than we imagined, greatly boosting their military strength. If we don't take it out soon, they will be ready for a full scale assault into Audesder, and that will spell disaster for our campaign. I just don't think we're ready yet to face such a large fleet.

And I can't stress this enough, get help! You won't be able to do this alone. Good luck! This is an important mission, which will have significant impact on your faction standings.

story: Ison conduce efortul de război Minmatar din Audesder împotriva Amarr, Caldari și Khanid. Intri cu voucher-ul unui recrutor.
Ison runs the Minmatar war effort in Audesder against the Amarr, Caldari and Khanid. You get in with a recruiter's voucher.

goal: Aduci Gist Database Codes (1 m³).
Bring the Gist Database Codes (1 m³).
reward: 1 mil. ISK, plus 500.000 ISK bonus.
1M ISK, plus a 500,000 ISK bonus.
steps: Codurile sunt în Contested Minmatar Legendary Stronghold. Site-ul primește până la battlecruiser.
The codes are in Contested Minmatar Legendary Stronghold. The site allows up to battlecruisers.
m.brief:
Ah, a capsuleer. I see. In that case, you might be of some use after all. Fair enough.

I've been trying to hack into the Gist database in their stronghold within Hjoramold for some time now, but I can't get by their security codes. Get me those codes, and I'll make you rich. Deal?

Oh, yeah, you might find them off the Gist overseer Arrak Nutan. He usually roams around Hraldar's ruins, within the old Legendary Stronghold. {{Co|red|The acceleration gate leading into the complex is inaccessible for anything bigger than a battlecruiser, but the Gist have manufactured a few battleships inside the deadspace pockets.}} Needless to say, this Overseer Nutan flies one of them.

goal: Duci Reports (0,1 m³) la Uisper IX - Moon 5 - Republic Security Services Assembly Plant.
Carry the Reports (0.1 m³) to Uisper IX - Moon 5 - Republic Security Services Assembly Plant.
reward: Un BPC storyline aleatoriu (3 rulări) și 1.000 de muniție Republic Fleet L ca bonus.
A random storyline BPC (3 runs) and 1,000 Republic Fleet L ammo as a bonus.
steps: Destinația e la câteva salturi adânc în lowsec.
The destination is several jumps into lowsec.
m.brief:
Get these reports to the Republic Security Forces base in Uisper. My cousin works as an officer there. The reports contain information on Angel Cartel plans and smuggling routes, which I extracted from the Gist database within Hjoramold. This information is way too important to just send through conventional means; I can't risk the transmission being hacked.

Once my cousin gets a hold of these reports and presents them directly to Bjongausen Agnake, I'm sure he'll get a promotion.

goal: Îl elimini pe Kael Nutan și escorta.
Eliminate Kael Nutan and the escort.
reward: 10 Modified Laser Rifles și un BPC storyline aleatoriu (3 rulări, ME 20, TE 8) ca bonus.
10 Modified Laser Rifles and a random storyline BPC (3 runs, ME 20, TE 8) as a bonus.
steps: Kael are daune medii de battleship, dar 200 EHP/s tank de scut.
Kael has average battleship damage but a 200 EHP/s shield tank.
Cea mai mică rezistență e la exploziv (50%).
The weakest resist is explosive (50%).
m.brief:
Something's come up that's perfectly suited to your ... er, talents. The Gist somehow managed to track down the signal from my computer while I was busy hacking their database. They shut me out and changed their codes. Fortunately, the interference from the Hyperbole Nexus prevented them from finding my exact location, but they at least know who I am.

Apparently, the assassin they sent to deal with me is none other than Kael Nutan, the son of the Gist overseer you killed earlier. Kael is a much better combat pilot than his dad ever was, certainly a force to be reckoned with. He completely obliterated my residence here in Barkrik, despite all the booby-traps I had laid for his men.

If you could fly to the coordinates of my residence and take care of Kael and his henchmen, I would be eternally grateful. Just don't expect it to be easy: You'll have to face a large squadron of Gist ships, including Kael's battleship, which is one of the best in their entire armada. I wish you luck,  ― you're gonna need it.

story: Jippon vânează un hacker Angel Cartel, Kael Nutan, și banda lui.
Jippon is hunting an Angel Cartel hacker, Kael Nutan, and the crew.

goal: Aduci Okelle's Encryption-Protected Hard Drive (0,1 m³).
Bring Okelle's Encryption-Protected Hard Drive (0.1 m³).
reward: Neurotoxin Control, plus 5,5 mil. ISK bonus.
Neurotoxin Control, plus a 5.5M ISK bonus.
steps: Lupți prin valurile Angel Cartel și iei hard disk-ul.
Fight through the Angel Cartel waves and take the hard drive.
m.brief: I'm glad to see you. Things are heating up. You may be aware that we've been hunting the infamous Thukker warlord named Martokar Alash. He's proved quite difficult to provoke out of hiding, but we've finally been given a good lead. Unfortunately it's not to him, but to his brother, Okelle Alash. I don't know if our capturing Okelle will drive Martokar out of hiding, but at the very least it will give him one more thing to worry about. Okelle is a bit of a wild one. He's reportedly done just about every drug in existence, goes through a girlfriend a month and ends up leaving them at that harem of his, has built up a reputation for being near-suicidal in battle, and all in all lives the definite pirate lifestyle. You should be aware that once you start hunting him, though, he may be a little more cautious. He's only foolhardy when he's the one who chooses the battlefield, and this time we're aiming to catch him with his pants down. He'll probably manage to escape before you reach his harem, so if you don't find him there, I want you to bring back something he left that'll allow us to determine his whereabouts. It's a fairly well hidden place, so you'll have to search hard.

goal: Distrugi țintele din DUO-51.
Destroy the targets in DUO-51.
reward: Republic Fleet EM Coating, plus 10,5 mil. ISK bonus în 3 ore.
Republic Fleet EM Coating, plus a 10.5M ISK bonus within 3 hours.
steps: DUO-51 e nullsec (-0,5). Site-ul are restricții de mărime a navei.
DUO-51 is nullsec (-0.5). The site has ship size restrictions.
Poarta se deschide doar după ce omori tot. Valurile pot veni pe timp, deci nu te lăsa copleșit.
The gate opens only after you kill everything. Waves may be time based, so do not get overwhelmed.
m.brief: We ran Okelle's hard drive through disinfection and decryption, and we got lucky! Sometimes these things are set to self-destruct after unauthorized access, or they've been planted and are full of things that attempt to infect our reader programs the instant we start picking them apart. I'd have thought that our data extraction people would be professional enough not to hook the darn things right up to our systems, but sometimes they get a little overzealous. It took us a month to clear out the last infection we got. At any rate, we now know Okelle's whereabouts. Remember that he's undoubtedly aware that we're after him, and that we intend to use him as a bartering chip to lure his brother out of hiding, so he's not going to come quietly. Try not to hang around, either, or he'll just escape. Go in there, kill any backup forces you see, and bring Okelle back to us alive.

story: Lafuni caută urmele unei rude dispărute, Okelle.
Lafuni is tracing a missing relative, Okelle.

m.t: Criminal Minds - Looking Out for Number One (1 of 4)
goal: Aduci 10 Mind-Altering Drugs (10 m³).
Bring 10 Mind-Altering Drugs (10 m³).
reward: 200.000 ISK, plus 250.000 ISK bonus în 54 de minute.
200,000 ISK, plus a 250,000 ISK bonus within 54 minutes.
steps: Le ridici dintr-o stație și le aduci agentului.
Pick them up at a station and bring them to the agent.
m.brief:
Hello there. You are here for work? Well, you might just be the one I´m looking for. We can look out for each other´s interests. I have a few tasks in mind for you: If you complete them in a timely fashion and without making any mistakes, then I will give you a handsome reward. 

I'll be honest with you; I run a highly lucrative business that some people claim involves illegal substances and slavery. I won´t deny that some people would find my line of work somewhat ... hm, distasteful is the word, I guess. Heh. Anyway, I control my slaves using mind-altering drugs that few people know or care much about. Of course, keeping this a secret is now for your own good. Nobody likes mishaps where people get killed, if you know what I mean. 

Okay, you seem solid so far. You want to know more? Alright. I have a delivery coming in from Uttindar V - Moon 17 - Minmatar Mining Corporation Mining Outpost. Go pick it up for me, alright? Some of the slaves get restless without their medicine.

goal: Duci 3 Reports (0,3 m³).
Carry 3 Reports (0.3 m³).
reward: 50.000 ISK, plus 75.000 ISK bonus.
50,000 ISK, plus a 75,000 ISK bonus.
steps: Destinația poate fi în Hagilur, lowsec. Bonusul cere sub 14 minute.
The destination may be in Hagilur, lowsec. The bonus needs under 14 minutes.
m.brief:
Dammit, dammit, dammit! Once again, the narcs are causing me bloody trouble. My inside man just told me that they launched an official investigation against my operation. They're on to me and are trying to figure out what it is that I actually do here. This is bad news for us, character_name. We have to get them to close their investigation. 

I´ve got an idea how to solve this mess, though. If we co-operate with them and get them to think we have nothing to hide, maybe they'll go away. Take these reports to Inder VII - Moon 11 - Sisters of EVE Bureau. They contain fake data on all our assets, journals, and transaction logs. If this isn't enough to convince them we're not up to anything, I don't know what will.

m.t: Criminal Minds - A Way Out (3 of 4)
goal: Aduci Godun Sakt's Diamond Drill (10 m³).
Bring Godun Sakt's Diamond Drill (10 m³).
reward: 50.000 ISK, plus 75.000 ISK bonus.
50,000 ISK, plus a 75,000 ISK bonus.
steps: Burghiul cade de la crucișătoarele Angel Thief, în buzunarele 2 și 3 din Contested Minmatar Guerilla Base.
The drill drops from Angel Thief cruisers in pockets 2 and 3 of Contested Minmatar Guerilla Base.
m.brief:
Frack, it didn't work. The investigation's still going on, and I'm thinking you and me are in some hot water. Hey, don´t try to back out of this now, compadre ― you´re an accessory after the fact, like it or not. Don´t worry, though, loyalty among thieves, and all that. Still, maybe you should start making preparations as well. I wouldn't want both of us to go down just because I screwed up some paperwork. We don't have to worry just yet, though; my contact will fill me in on how the investigation is going, so if they decide to come for us, we'll know. 

Meanwhile, I have another task for you. There is an agent nearby who's been getting on my nerves lately. I hired a small guerilla unit to enter his personal quarters and rob him blind. They were successful, apart from one thing: When they saw how much the stolen goods were worth, they broke the deal and decided to keep the loot for themselves. Go to the contested guerilla base, kill the treacherous Angels, and retrieve the item for me.

m.t: Criminal Minds - Our Ways Must Part (4 of 4)
goal: Aduci 3 Minmatar Republic Narcotic Officer's Tag (0,3 m³).
Bring 3 Minmatar Republic Narcotic Officer's Tags (0.3 m³).
reward: Un BPC storyline (3 rulări), plus 15.000 ISK bonus.
A storyline BPC (3 runs), plus a 15,000 ISK bonus.
tip: Pierzi în jur de 0,24 standing la Minmatar Republic.
You lose about 0.24 Minmatar Republic standing.
steps: Insignele cad de la ofițerii de securitate Minmatar din Contested Minmatar Guerilla Base.
The tags drop from the Minmatar security officers in Contested Minmatar Guerilla Base.
m.brief: Good news! My guy in the Republic's narcs has just informed me that, due to lack of evidence, the investigation has been closed. We don't have to worry any longer, character_name. I still feel a grudge against those cops, though. They meddled in affairs they shouldn't have come near, and I wan't blood. Go back to the contested guerilla base, find the narcotics officers there, and do your work. Leave none alive. Bring me back five of their tags, and I'll reward you handsomely.

story: Madri, agent Amarr, investighează minți criminale din Margin of Error.
Madri, an Amarr agent, investigates criminal minds at the Margin of Error.

m.t: The Plantation Workers - Caught in a Storm (1 of 4)
goal: Recuperezi sclavii răniți (168 m³).
Recover the injured slaves (168 m³).
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Sclavii cad de la una din navele din grupul 2.
The slaves drop from one of the ships in group 2.
Grupurile 4 și 5 sunt pasive dacă nu te apropii. Le poți ignora.
Groups 4 and 5 stay passive unless approached. You can ignore them.

m.t: The Plantation Workers - Treat the Injured (2 of 4)
goal: Aduci 2.000 Antibiotics (400 m³).
Bring 2,000 Antibiotics (400 m³).
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Le cumperi din piață și le predai.
Buy them on the market and hand them in.

m.t: The Plantation Workers - Extra Hand (3 of 4)
goal: Duci 50 Captives (50 m³).
Carry 50 Captives (50 m³).
reward: Un BPC storyline (3 rulări).
A storyline BPC (3 runs).
steps: Curier simplu.
A simple courier.

m.t: The Plantation Workers - Save The Plantation (4 of 4)
goal: Distrugi luptătorii pentru libertate care atacă plantația.
Destroy the freedom fighters attacking the plantation.
reward: Un BPC storyline (3 rulări).
A storyline BPC (3 runs).
tip: Pierzi puțin standing la Minmatar Republic, în jur de 0,012.
You lose a little Minmatar Republic standing, about 0.012.
steps: Daunele sunt mari, nu lua toate grupurile deodată.
Incoming damage is high, do not pull all groups at once.
Ia tot loot-ul: insignele Republic Fleet valorează mult, peste 130 mil. ISK în total.
Loot everything: the Republic Fleet insignia are worth a lot, over 130M ISK in total.

story: Mazed, agent Amarr, are grijă de sclavii de pe plantație după o furtună.
Mazed, an Amarr agent, tends to the plantation slaves after a storm.

goal: Aduci 5 Republic Pilots (5 m³).
Bring 5 Republic Pilots (5 m³).
reward: 3 mil. ISK, plus 2 mil. ISK bonus.
3M ISK, plus a 2M ISK bonus.
steps: Piloții sunt în containerele Podded Pilot din primul coridor al Contested Minmatar Army Complex.
The pilots are in the Podded Pilot containers in the first corridor of Contested Minmatar Army Complex.
Site-ul primește până la battlecruiser.
The site allows up to battlecruisers.
m.brief:
Someone once told me that the road to eternal damnation is paved with good intentions. Welcome to that road, friend. I know people are already mocking the Republic Fleet for its lack of progress here in Ani, but those people don't have a clue about what's really going on here. The Parliament obviously thought it would be enough for us to show up here like we were on some damn military parade and the pirates would fall all over themselves trying to get out of the way. This political blunder has already cost many a good soldier his life. We're not getting any support from back home and morale is at an all time low after we lost our headquarters. You can see what's left of them over there.

Command decided to launch a retaliation attack against the pirates and most of our forces are currently embroiled in the local complex trying to wrench control of it from the Angel Cartel. But the Cartel and us are not the only players out here and I'm not even sure the Cartel was behind the attack on our headquarters. All the same, most of my time is spent on rebuilding our outpost here and give logistic support to our troops in the contested complex. I'm woefully short of staff, meaning many important tasks are not being done. Such as going through the ruins of our former headquarters and retrieve the bodies of our fallen comrades. But such a trivial job is beneath someone of your caliber. I have something more important to ask of you.

One of our squadrons in the contested complex was ambushed recently by particularly mean Angels. The pirates are still hovering around the squadron's remains, gloating over their victory. I need someone well acquainted in the arts of war to teach them a lesson, and most importantly, to retrieve the bodies of the Republic pilots so they can be properly treated. I think you're ideally suited for a task such as this, my best men are already engaging the pirates around the system and the soldiers I have here are too green to be of any use. Interested?

goal: Duci 20 Body Bags (20 m³).
Carry 20 Body Bags (20 m³).
reward: 2 mil. ISK, plus 2 mil. ISK bonus.
2M ISK, plus a 2M ISK bonus.
steps: Destinația e în lowsec.
The destination is in lowsec.
m.brief:
Thanks to the efforts of you and other good pilots, a lot of families are getting the bodies of their loved ones back. You can well imagine how important that is, not having to sit in anguish over the fate of those you love. But having those bodies sitting in the Redoubt's freezer isn't accomplishing this, I need to get these bodies to a Fleet station where they can be properly taken care of. I know it sounds as a menial task, and in many ways it is, but getting the bodies of these soldiers quickly and safely back to their loved ones is critical if we're to have any public support back home.

Take care of this for me and I'm bound to have something more suitable to your talents next time around. Just to make it a little more interesting I'll throw in a good amount of bonus reward if you can finish this quickly.

goal: Omori dezertorii și aduci 4 Republic Fleet Deserters (4 m³).
Kill the deserters and bring 4 Republic Fleet Deserters (4 m³).
reward: 1.000 Republic Fleet Nuclear L și 1.000 Republic Fleet Titanium Sabot L ca bonus.
1,000 Republic Fleet Nuclear L and 1,000 Republic Fleet Titanium Sabot L as a bonus.
steps: Distrugi navele dezertorilor și iei ce rămâne din epave.
Destroy the deserters' ships and loot what is left.
m.brief:
The loss of our headquarters was a tremendous shock to us. Not only did many good man and women lose their lives there, but it also gave the rest of us a serious fright. The combat efficiency of our troops is abysmal and the worst part of it all is that the desertion rate has climbed dramatically. Only in the last month almost hundred pilots deserted. Most have fled home and they're are out of our reach and not our concern. But some are still around, having joined the rebels, or worse, become brigands themselves. It is the latter I'm especially keen on tracking down.

I need to get out a strong sign that deserters will not be treated kindly. Deserting from the Republic Fleet is treason and is punishable by death. Morale is bad enough as it is and if people start thinking that desertion is the easy way out, our cause is lost. Unfortunately, those that desert, particularly those that go and join the pirates, know this. So they have dug themselves in, waiting for the inevitable repercussion to arrive. That means that those that go after these brigands must have exceptional battle prowess. They will be going up against trained soldiers caught in a corner with nowhere to run. That makes them desperate, and desperate people are always more dangerous. I have marked you as someone capable to handling such a difficult assignment. You will be well rewarded if you choose to hunt these deserters down and bring them back to me. Dead or alive.

goal: Duci Republic Repair Kit (1 m³).
Carry the Republic Repair Kit (1 m³).
reward: Repaired Keycard și un BPC storyline (3 rulări, ME 20, TE 8) ca bonus.
The Repaired Keycard and a storyline BPC (3 runs, ME 20, TE 8) as a bonus.
tip: Păstrează cardul pentru ultima misiune.
Keep the keycard for the last mission.
steps: Locul de ridicare e în lowsec.
The pickup is in lowsec.
m.brief:
Thanks again for a job well done with those deserters. One of the pilots I've hired to hunt them down managed to catch one alive. He's been in interrogation for awhile now. He was stubborn at first, but we've been persistent and now he's squealing like a pig. Most of it is just gibberish, but some of it's been sensible. And if what he's telling is true, we've got a serious situation on our hands.

It seems that many of these desertions are not just some random panic attacks. There's a Thukker tribe leader, going by the name Norak Pakkul, hiding out in the contested complex here in Traun that actually has the nerve to recruit Republic pilots for his band of gangsters. And with the jittery nerves of our pilots, he's actually been quite successful. Needless to say, this guy has to be brought down before he damages our cause further.

The only problem is that you cannot access the room he's in without the proper authorization. The Angels keep a tight control on their access cards, so I've been at a loss on how to get to this guy. But I've been digging around and found out that there is another way. It seems the old Nefantar access cards are still useable. I heard about a guy out by the Sister Camp that had repaired some damaged cards he received and made them operational again. My pilots have brought back all kinds of stuff they've picked up in the contested complex and I actually have a good number of these old Nefantar keycards.

All I need are the tools to fix one of these keycards. I want to do this quickly before this Pakkul guy discovers we're on to him and makes himself scarce. So I'm asking you to whisk over into Minmatar space and bring me one of those Fleet repair kits that makes this kind of a job a breeze. Again, I'll make this interesting for you by giving you a good bonus reward if you hurry. Once this is done, we're all set to take this Norak Pakkul out of the picture for good.

goal: Aduci Norak Pakkul's DNA (0,1 m³).
Bring Norak Pakkul's DNA (0.1 m³).
reward: Standing de facțiune, un BPC storyline și 5 mil. ISK bonus.
Faction standing, a storyline BPC and a 5M ISK bonus.
steps: Ia Repaired Keycard cu tine.
Bring the Repaired Keycard with you.
Nava de luptă a lui Norak e în Destroyed Nefantar Base din Contested Minmatar Army Complex.
Norak's battleship is in the Destroyed Nefantar Base of Contested Minmatar Army Complex.
m.brief:
Ok, we're all set to take this Norak Pakkal out of business. The card I gave you gives you and your friends entrance to the inner most room of the contested complex. And you're going to need your friends for this one. You can only enter the room in cruisers, but you should expect some very heavy resistance in there, from what I've heard. Nothing that a pilot of your caliber can't handle, but if my army life has taught me anything it is that the careful survive.

Bring me Pakkul's DNA and I'm authorized to give you a very rare BPC as a reward.

story: Poreg e intendentul armatei și se ocupă de piloții dispăruți, morți sau dezertori.
Poreg is the army quartermaster, dealing with missing, dead and deserting pilots.

goal: Elimini grupul de cercetași inamic.
Eliminate the enemy scout party.
reward: Republic Fleet 100MN Afterburner, plus 8 mil. ISK bonus.
Republic Fleet 100MN Afterburner, plus an 8M ISK bonus.
steps: O cameră cu trei valuri.
One room with three waves.
Misiunea e gata când moare tot valul 3.
The mission completes when all of wave 3 is dead.
m.brief: "We've run into a little trouble. Word has spread that Okelle Alash is being held captive, and his legion is going absolutely insane. Apparently it's all right for them to terrorize innocent citizens, but not for us to start hitting back. They're tearing through the constellation, firing at everything in sight and demanding that Okelle be returned to them in one piece. This, unfortunately, is no longer an option, not unless they have a surgeon on their team who specializes in reattaching fingers. We will have to fight them. Their fleet is disorganized as you'd expect pirates to be, but nonetheless they have a small scouting party that flies ahead and coordinates the primary fleet. You have to take out the scouting party first, so that the primary fleet will be left blinded and confused. Once you're done with that, report to me and we'll see if we can use you in taking care of the remnants of Okelle's fleet."

goal: Îl elimini pe Overlord Sgnard și escorta.
Eliminate Overlord Sgnard and the escort.
reward: Memory Augmentation - Improved și Gas Cloud Harvester I ca bonus în 3 ore.
Memory Augmentation - Improved and Gas Cloud Harvester I as a bonus within 3 hours.
tip: Comandantul lasă Domination Crystal Tag și Domination EM Shield Amplifier.
The commander drops a Domination Crystal Tag and a Domination EM Shield Amplifier.
steps: Două camere. Misiunea e gata când moare valul 3.
Two rooms. The mission completes when wave 3 dies.
După asta pot veni încă două valuri opționale.
Two more optional waves can spawn afterwards.
m.brief: "Since the scouting party is dead and gone, we've got the primary fleet hanging around in space and practically begging for someone to blow them to pieces. Seeing as how you did such a thorough job with their scouts, you were naturally our first choice for taking on their big guns. Once you're finished with them, Okelle won't have anyone to help him except his brother. And once our interrogators are done with Okelle, he'll have given us all the information we need to hunt down Martogar. It's only a matter of time - that is, unless the primary fleet manages to deploy more scouts and continue their murderous rampage, so you better get on your way to stop them. This is an important mission, which will have significant impact on your faction standings."

story: Sigulo vrea oprită o patrulă Angel Cartel și pe liderul ei, Overlord Sgnard.
Sigulo wants an Angel Cartel patrol stopped, along with its leader, Overlord Sgnard.

m.t: Treasure Hunter - The Vherokior Medallion (1 of 4)
goal: Aduci Ancient Vherokior Medallion (0,1 m³).
Bring the Ancient Vherokior Medallion (0.1 m³).
reward: 1 mil. ISK, plus 1 mil. ISK bonus în 5 ore.
1M ISK, plus a 1M ISK bonus within 5 hours.
steps: Medalionul cade de la Arrak Nutan (battleship), în Hraldar's Overrun Station din Contested Minmatar Legendary Stronghold.
The medallion drops from Arrak Nutan (battleship) in Hraldar's Overrun Station of Contested Minmatar Legendary Stronghold.
m.brief:
The first artifact I'm looking for is the famous Vherokior Medallion. Since ancient times, the Vherokior tribe has awarded it's greatest achievers and leaders with medallions, signifying their status within the community. These medallions are rare, and usually they are buried along with the wearer after his death. The medallion worn by the leader of the Vherokior is an exception, as it is given to whoever takes control of the tribe to signify a change of leadership.

A long time ago, before the Great Rebellion, the Nefantar claimed the Vherokior Medallion as tribute when they took control of most Minmatar worlds. It was never returned to the Vherokior, and although it was eventually remade after the Minmatar rebellion, the original is worth more than you can imagine.

After tracking down this artifact for many years, I finally found out where it is being kept. To my utter dismay I was told it had fallen into the hands of the Cartel, sold to one of their leaders for an obscene amount of ISK from a private dealer. This Gist overlord's name is Arrak Nutan, and he currently resides in the Legendary Minmatar Stronghold within Hjoramold. Getting to him will be difficult, as the place is a virtual deathtrap.

I'll pay a very handsome amount for this medallion, as long as it's still fully intact. Not that I expect you to get past the Gist fleet inside ...

goal: Aduci Hraldar's Sculpture (5 m³).
Bring Hraldar's Sculpture (5 m³).
reward: Muniție de facțiune și 1 mil. ISK bonus.
Faction ammo and a 1M ISK bonus.
steps: Sculptura e în site-ul Bazeri Palen din Hjoramold.
The sculpture is in the Bazeri Palen site in Hjoramold.
m.brief:
The next artifact on the list is Hraldar's sculpture. Hraldar was a Nefantar general which defected to the Minmatar cause during the rebellion. After his death a sculpure was made of him to honor his name. Originally it was placed within the Legendary Minmatar Stronghold, but after it was abandoned the sculpture was moved to the historical museum in Barkrik. A few years ago however, it was stolen by Maru raiders.

I have reliable information that the current owner of the sculpture is Bazeri Palen, one of the leaders of the Maru Rebels. He's an old-time criminal who pretends to be a 'freedom fighter', like most of those Maru scum. He flies a formidable battleship, and usually has a few of his goons around for protection. Taking him out will be hard, but I'm confident in you, .

I don't know where you will find him, but the last I heard he was orbiting one of the moons of Hjoramold. The Maru are extremely protective of their territory, so he might attack you when you find him. But don't worry about the legal implications of killing him, he's a wanted man within the Republic and therefore I doubt they will look harshly upon his murder.

goal: Aduci Telligman's Stone (180 m³).
Bring Telligman's Stone (180 m³).
reward: Muniție de facțiune și 2 mil. ISK bonus.
Faction ammo and a 2M ISK bonus.
tip: Pierzi în jur de 0,24 standing la Minmatar Republic pentru muzeu.
You lose about 0.24 Minmatar Republic standing for the museum.
steps: Piatra cade când distrugi Bastion Museum, lângă agent.
The stone drops when you destroy the Bastion Museum next to the agent.
Gărzile sunt pasive și nu atacă nici când distrugi muzeul.
The guards are passive and do not attack even when you destroy the museum.
Îți trebuie 180 m³ liberi.
You need 180 m³ free.
m.brief:
Telligman's stone is an old symbol of Minmatar independence. Crad was the famous Amarrian architect who designed the Nefantar palace in Hjoramold, shortly before the Rebellion took place. When the Minmatar forces tore down the palace during the rebellion, they left a single stone intact which they called 'Telligman's stone'. It was later moved to the Bastion museum to be shown as one of the symbols of Minmatar victory in Ani over the occupation.

Find the Bastion museum and steal the stone. I don't care how you do it, just bring it to me intact and I will reward you well.

goal: Duci 3 Namian's Artifacts (30 m³) la o stație din Sasta.
Carry 3 Namian's Artifacts (30 m³) to a station in Sasta.
reward: Un BPC storyline (3 rulări) și Memory Augmentation - Standard ca bonus în 4 ore.
A storyline BPC (3 runs) and Memory Augmentation - Standard as a bonus within 4 hours.
tip: Agentul e Amarr: îți trebuie standing cu Amarr Empire.
This agent is Amarr: you need Amarr Empire standing.
steps: Iei artefactele de la agent și le predai.
Take the artifacts from the agent and deliver them.
m.brief: The last task I have for you, , is to transfer my artifacts to Sasta, which is located within Ammatar space. The system is en route to my home world within the Empire, so I'll pick up the goods there. I'm much more confident in your abilities to smuggle these items out of Minmatar space undetected than my own, and I certainly wouldn't want to be caught by the Republic authorities with these items in my cargo hold. No telling what they'd do to me, especially considering I'm a citizen of the Amarr Empire.

Agentul cere 7,0 standing cu Angel Cartel.
The agent needs 7,0 Angel Cartel standing.
O predai agentului.
Hand it in.
m.brief:
We have a policy here within the Angel Cartel that our more prominent members fly a suitable ship according to their status, both to give them an edge during combat and to uphold our image, especially within our borders. We have recently decided to extend this benefit to mercenaries or freelancers employed by us that have shown admirable bravery and skill in the field, or earned the right through countless hours of dedicated service to our corporations.

As you undoubtedly already know I have been assigned the task of allocating these ships to their deserved owners. After looking at your record, we decided that you, , are worthy of such an honor. There is just one catch, since you aren't an official member we need something in exchange for this gift. Cough up 1 x Republic Fleet Navy Commander Insignia and the Machariel Blueprint is yours.

Dismissed

goal: Aduci 10 Rogue Harvester (50 m³) din MSKR-1.
Bring 10 Rogue Harvesters (50 m³) from MSKR-1.
reward: 500MN Quad LiF Restrained Microwarpdrive, plus 8 mil. ISK bonus în 6 ore.
500MN Quad LiF Restrained Microwarpdrive, plus an 8M ISK bonus within 6 hours.
steps: Site-ul are restricții de mărime a navei. La sosire sunt trei porți.
The site has ship size restrictions. There are three gates at warp-in.
Ia poarta din stânga, la 32 km. Ultima navă omorâtă lasă un container cu cele 10 Rogue Harvester.
Take the left gate, 32 km out. The last ship killed drops a can with the 10 Rogue Harvesters.
Uneori trebuie să omori tot ca misiunea să fie gata. Inamicii te încetinesc cu web.
Sometimes you must kill everything for the mission to complete. The enemies web you.
m.brief: The concept of 'miner's justice' is new to some freelancers here. Have you heard of it? No? It's rather simple, really. Space can be dangerous, and we at the Angel Cartel are charged with keeping the peace, ensuring that people don't step out of line. We don't have the luxury of courts and lawyers, nor the option to hold long and protracted trials, so justice tends to be meted out in swift, decisive doses. It's quite a convenient arrangement for the most part, and the mining harvesters only need to defray the slight cost involved. Sadly, though, not everyone sees it this way. There are some who feel themselves to be beyond the reach of justice, and who apparently believe they won't have to face the consequences of their rebellious actions. I've received word of a group of harvesters who have been misreporting their earnings and paying only a fraction of what they should, thus swindling the Cartel out of our rightly-earned tribute. Needless to say, this kind of behavior is absolutely unacceptable. You are to head out, destroy their equipment and ships along with anything else you find, but return the harvesting personnel to us intact. While normally I wouldn't hesitate in demanding their bodies be splattered all over deep space, we need them alive to extract information about any other rogue operation.

goal: Distrugi țintele din M-PGT0.
Destroy the targets in M-PGT0.
reward: Neural Boost - Improved și Eifyr and Co. 'Alchemist' Neurotoxin Recovery NR-1003 ca bonus în 2 ore.
Neural Boost - Improved and Eifyr and Co. 'Alchemist' Neurotoxin Recovery NR-1003 as a bonus within 2 hours.
steps: Site-ul are restricții de mărime a navei.
The site has ship size restrictions.
Inamicii folosesc web și target painter.
The enemies use webs and target painters.
m.brief: We've finished with the harvesters you brought in, and it turns out they weren't just skimming the profits. There is a gas cloud there, a very valuable gas cloud, which they had discovered and were hoping to keep all for themselves. This isn't some minor act of subterfuge, it's outright betrayal! I cannot express how angry I am at this. Here we are, working day and night to ensure the safety of these people, and for very little pay, I might add, and this is how they treat us. Rest assured, we will make a memorable example of these traitors. Their bodies will be flayed open and their skin will flap in the wind like the bloodied flags of a failed uprising. As for the gas cloud, since you were the one who brought these miscreants to justice, you're the only one I trust to inspect the cloud and verify whether it's as valuable as they claimed. Head out there, give it a look, and tell me what you saw. I suppose it's possible that the Minmatars will get a little cranky at the fact that you were responsible for the mutilation and death of their kind, but I'm sure they won't do anything drastic about it. Still, I'd appreciate if you also made sure that the area was clear of enemies.

story: Bleur vrea scoși minerii Minmatar care recoltează gaz pe teritoriul Angel Cartel.
Bleur wants the Minmatar miners harvesting gas in Angel Cartel territory driven out.

goal: Distrugi țintele și aduci The Damsel (0,1 m³) din BLC-X0.
Destroy the targets and bring The Damsel (0.1 m³) from BLC-X0.
reward: Gas Cloud Harvester I ca bonus.
Gas Cloud Harvester I as a bonus.
steps: Un singur buzunar cu restricții de mărime a navei.
A single pocket with ship size restrictions.
The Damsel e într-un container care trebuie spart. Ia un Data Analyzer.
The Damsel is in a container that must be hacked. Bring a Data Analyzer.
m.brief: This one is personal. I haven't usually bothered too much about Sansha's Nation; they're here, and we're going to kick them out eventually, but until now they haven't been worth the effort. That's all changed. They have taken my sister. Understand, this is one of very few people in the world who means anything to me. We grew up together, and since I was older by a few years, I was the protector. She isn't too clever, dear Nokana, but she always meant well, and all the times I had to pull her out of trouble were paid for a thousand times over by the times she stood by me when no one else would. When I got this job as an Angel Cartel agent, she demanded that she be employed here as well so that she could keep an eye on me. It's risky business sometimes, being an agent for the pirates, and Nokana wouldn't let me do it alone. But now it's all gone wrong. Nokana apparently heard of a group of Sansha's who had it in for me, and went to try and negotiate with them. She's wonderful, my sister, but she's no diplomat, and they ended up kidnapping her. If my bosses find out about her meddling they'll fire both of us, so I need you to go in, get her, and return her to me before anyone else finds out. I hear they're keeping her in a slave pen, the barbarians!

goal: O duci pe The Damsel la XX9-WV VII - Moon 1 - Dominations Logistic Support.
Carry The Damsel to XX9-WV VII - Moon 1 - Dominations Logistic Support.
reward: 720mm Gallium Cannon.
720mm Gallium Cannon.
steps: Poate fi nevoie de garanție la acceptare.
A collateral may be required on accept.
m.brief: Now that Nokana is safe, I've decided it's too much of a risk to let her stay here. Wanting to protect me is good and fine, and exactly what I'd expect from her, but she's going to end up getting both of us into serious trouble, and if anything happened to her I would never forgive myself. Not to mention that I'd have to tell our parents, and they'd have my hide. I would like you to take her back to my parents' place in Cartel space. I know this is a little outside the realm of your usual work, to be escorting someone home like a chaperon, but I'd really appreciate it. You did a good job in bringing Nokana back, and I'm sure you're as eager as I am to ensure that she doesn't cost us any more time and effort. I'll arrange matters here, talk to her superiors and give them some reasonable explanation. A friend of mine will meet Nokana at the landing point, so once you've docked safe and sound, let me know and we'll take care of the rest. Just don't let her convince you to turn around or do anything silly. Head straight home with her. And for heaven's sake, don't tell her anything about this conversation. I'll take care of that as well.

story: Henara vrea înapoi o fată, The Damsel, ținută de Sansha.
Henara wants back a girl, The Damsel, held by Sansha.

goal: Aduci 6 Minecore Harvester (12 m³).
Bring 6 Minecore Harvesters (12 m³).
reward: Gas Cloud Harvester I, plus 5 mil. ISK bonus în 3 ore.
Gas Cloud Harvester I, plus a 5M ISK bonus within 3 hours.
tip: Din 2022 se raportează că misiunea nu se mai bifează, deși itemele cad. Verifică înainte să investești timp.
Since 2022 the mission has been reported not to complete even though the items drop. Check before investing time.
steps: Fiecare Rogue Drone Saboteur lasă un Minecore Harvester.
Each Rogue Drone Saboteur drops one Minecore Harvester.
Site-ul are restricții de mărime a navei și două camere.
The site has ship size restrictions and two rooms.
m.brief:
We had a team of people doing mining work for us in one of our harvester outposts. It's a thankless and hazardous job, eons away from the safe mining you ship pilots get to engage in. The harvesting equipment they have to use is incredibly dangerous in untrained hands and requires both physical strength and endurance, particularly for the length of time these people have to work. I daren't even think of the accidents that might have occurred had the Minecore harvesters not taken it on themselves to ease their working days a bit with some innocent entertainment. It breaks up the monotony somewhat, so that one's focus on the mining laser won't accidentally slip, leaving some poor soul plastered all over the nearby asteroids.

The Minecore harvesters aren't allowed to have any signals in their suits apart from the ones required to run their equipment. All they have is closed communication channels. So a few began telling jokes, and some of them shared stories from past work, and eventually it turned out that one or two of them, embarrassed though they were at first, could even carry a tune. There is now a core troupe of harvesters who have dedicated themselves to keeping up their coworkers' spirits, maintaining a steady stream of radio talk all through the day. These are men whose only thoughts were how long it was until the end of their shift and how much they were going to drink when they got back to their quarters, and now for the first time they all have something to look forward to.

Except that their workplace is now under siege by rogue drones, and the company apparently refuses to waste manpower rescuing 'expendable resources'. If these people die, the tradition dies with them, and the entire workforce slides back into old, ugly habits. I cannot let that happen, no matter what the company thinks. I want you to go in there and get them.

goal: Aduci 5 Mining Equipment (6 m³).
Bring 5 Mining Equipment (6 m³).
reward: Domination Thermal Shield Amplifier, plus 10 mil. ISK bonus în 3 ore.
Domination Thermal Shield Amplifier, plus a 10M ISK bonus within 3 hours.
steps: În camera 2 aterizezi în interiorul unei structuri de drone. O distrugi ca să ieși.
In room 2 you land inside a drone structure. Destroy it to get out.
m.brief:
Here is a mission suited for someone of your caliber.

Thank you for your task. I know not everyone cares about company morale, but with these poor people, distraction and boredom can kill. I'm sure the whole mess will give them plenty to talk about when they feel up to returning to work.

Unfortunately, we have a new problem. Not everyone feels so philanthropical toward their fellow man, even under circumstances where you'd think that people would stick together and help one another out. Now that you've cleared the last of the Minecore harvesters out of the area, the scavengers arrive. I have reason to believe that these rogue harvesters, unaffiliated with Minecore, have moved in and are proceeding to rob us of our equipment. These people undoubtedly intend to set up a business of their own, and plan to use our property as a starting point. The next step will certainly be attempts to headhunt our own employees, with extravagant offers of better working conditions, higher pay, more benefits and time off. Total and utter lies, all of it. Rogue operators pay even less, and if you desert the company to go work for them, you might as well have placed yourself in indentured servitude. I am not letting that happen to my people, especially now that they've built so much camaraderie and trust. I want you to return to the outpost, find these cowardly harvesters and destroy them, and retrieve our mining equipment.

Declining a mission from a particular agent more than once every 4 hours may result in a loss of standing with that agent, except in the case of special missions that clearly state otherwise in their description.

story: Kanmilia are nevoie de echipamentul minier pierdut de colonie.
Kanmilia needs the mining equipment the colony lost.

goal: Distrugi țintele și aduci 3 Sansha Infiltrator Tag (0,3 m³) din 3L-Y9M.
Destroy the targets and bring 3 Sansha Infiltrator Tags (0.3 m³) from 3L-Y9M.
reward: Gas Cloud Harvester I ca bonus.
Gas Cloud Harvester I as a bonus.
steps: Două camere cu restricții de mărime a navei.
Two rooms with ship size restrictions.
m.brief: You are talking to the last survivor of a vicious, dishonorable assault. I used to soar through this area with the rest of my gang, taking care of business, talking to people who needed a good talking to, maybe knocking them around a bit, keeping things tight and running. I loved my job, and I was good at it. But then we ran into a bunch of Sansha's, and things went very wrong. They snuck up on us while we were minding our own business, and they murdered every single one of my gangmates. I still have nightmares about those last few seconds, when each one of my communication channels to them was filled with screams, then static. Then nothing at all. The Sansha's left me alive only so that I could crawl back to home and tell the tale, a message that they were coming to push us out of the territory. We're going to send them a message in return. We don't dare risk total war, though, so we need a freelancer. You are going to head out, find a bunch of Sansha's puppets, and kill them. Bring me back their tags so that I can hang them over my bed like a set of wind chimes; that ought to stop then nightmares for good.

goal: Distrugi țintele din DUU1-K.
Destroy the targets in DUU1-K.
reward: ISK.
ISK.
steps: Varianta rapidă: distrugi cele două Tyrant, apoi pe Abufyr Joek.
Quick route: destroy the two Tyrants, then Abufyr Joek.
Capul nu trebuie predat, chiar dacă misiunea îl cere.
The head is not required for turn-in, even though the mission mentions it.
m.brief: After you left, I got to thinking. Killing some random gang of Sansha's is good, but it's not enough. All we did was send the message that someone had wanted to kill their grunts. We need more. As luck would have it, the person reputed to be Sansha's provincial leader in this area, a man named Abufyr Joek, is situated not far from us. If we take him out, along with all his staff and guards, we will be sending a clear message to those brainless drones. They won't dare declare war on us, since they'll have nothing to officially tie the attack to our forces, but they'll know exactly who was responsible. Abufyr probably gave permission for his troops to roam around and viciously murder anyone they met, and even if he didn't he's still the nominal figurehead for them, so his death will be a statement. Kill everyone you see at that place, then bring me back Abufyr's head, and we'll show Sansha's Nation what happens when you get the stupid, stupid idea to attack the Angel Cartel. Don't worry about special storage, either, just put it in your cargo hold like everything else. We want it to be good and ripe before we vacuum-seal it to send off to the Sansha.

story: Lunuin vrea Sansha alungați din teritoriul Angel Cartel.
Lunuin wants the Sansha driven out of Angel Cartel territory.

goal: Distrugi țintele din TSG-N0.
Destroy the targets in TSG-N0.
reward: Gas Cloud Harvester I.
Gas Cloud Harvester I.
steps: Varianta rapidă: distrugi Scanner Sentry.
Quick route: destroy the Scanner Sentry.
m.brief: As you may know, Minecore has been launching expeditions into BLC-X0 in order to find more gas cloud sites. We've been pretty successful so far, if I do say so myself. But success breeds the need for more success, and also breeds a certain type of man who expects that success. My superior, Akrada Ubje, is that type of man. Akrada is one of the few people in Minecore who can deal with the pirates on their own terms. The Angel Cartel have us in a stranglehold, but Akrada is so defiant of everything and everyone that the Angels respect him, and even if it's the grudging respect a predator may show its prey, it's one of the things that has kept them from completely devouring our operations here. Problem is, Akrada expects everyone else to be defiant, showing constant bravery and strength so that the pirates won't think us weak. This means he occasionally demands too much, and the rest of us have to ensure he doesn't push us into something dangerous. We've recently received word of quite a promising gas cloud. However, we have also heard that Sansha's Nation plans to establish a base there, intending to beat us to the punch. They have put up a scanning sentry there which will call for backup the instant an enemy force approaches. I want you to destroy this sentry, and do it quickly. No matter what Akrada says, we cannot deal with this on our own.

goal: Distrugi restul țintelor din TSG-N0.
Destroy the remaining targets in TSG-N0.
reward: Type-D Restrained Overdrive Injector.
Type-D Restrained Overdrive Injector.
steps: Poarta se deschide doar după ce omori tot din prima cameră.
The gate opens only after you kill everything in the first room.
A doua cameră are doar un nor de Vermillion Cytoserocin.
The second room only has a Vermillion Cytoserocin cloud.
m.brief: Unfortunately, the Sansha's Nation isn't so easily deterred. They received backup right after you left, and have now set up a full base in the area. The place is crawling with Sansha's pirates and we desperately need your services again. I can't let this get to Akrada, since he'll go berserk and demand we all fly in there, guns blazing. Anyone who refuses will find themselves out of a job at the very least, which in this part of space is tantamount to death by starvation. So we need this done on the quiet, like. No major forces, no big deal made, and no bragging afterwards. You simply head back out there, kill everything you see, then silently head back to me for debriefing. I should warn you that if you find yourself in trouble, no one will be able to help you, and I will not admit to knowing anything about your mishaps. All I wanted was to do my nice desk job in this company, pay my dues to Minecore and the Angel Cartel, and head back home at the end of the harvesting season. Flying out on suicide missions wasn't part of the job description, and neither was having to hire freelance pilots to sneak around behind my boss's back.

story: Urandi se teme de Akrada și vrea scăpare de Sansha din TSG-N0.
Urandi fears Akrada and wants the Sansha in TSG-N0 dealt with.

goal: Elimini navele Blood Raider renegate.
Eliminate the renegade Blood Raider ships.
reward: Standard Frentix Booster Reaction Formula, plus 5 mil. ISK bonus în 3 ore.
Standard Frentix Booster Reaction Formula, plus a 5M ISK bonus within 3 hours.
steps: Trei camere cu mai multe valuri. Site-ul are restricții de mărime a navei.
Three rooms with several waves. The site has ship size restrictions.
m.brief:
"I have a very dire situation on my hands at the moment. I have been the caretaker of a few dozen slaves for 5 years now, and recently the unthinkable happened. They managed to convert a few of our pod clones to their side, and together they have made an audacious get-away from the slave pens. Fortunately, we still have them on our radar, but we fear they might try to use one of the smuggler gates in CX8-6K to escape. 

Obviously, it will set a very bad precedent should they manage to successfully get away. We can't have that. There's enough rebelliousness and infighting as it is within our ranks. 

Although it pains me to say this, I require that you destroy all of the vessels carrying these rebels. They will be flying our ships, but will not hesitate to fire upon you - so feel free to extend the same courtesy. I will give you the precise coordinates of their whereabouts, of course."

goal: Aduci Head in a Jar (1 m³).
Bring the Head in a Jar (1 m³).
reward: Extruded Compact Heat Sink, plus 10,5 mil. ISK bonus în 3 ore.
Extruded Compact Heat Sink, plus a 10.5M ISK bonus within 3 hours.
steps: O singură cameră. Omori renegații și iei borcanul.
A single room. Kill the renegades and take the jar.
m.brief:
"Unfortunately, we discovered a few stragglers who avoided the fate of those rebels you took care of in that last assignment. Worse, we think they're about to make an attempt to reach an old abandoned stargate in CX8-6K. Their getting away would be a huge embarrassment, so I want you to get to that stargate first in order to foil their plans. 

There's something that will work in your favor though: This particular stargate is a very old model, and it needs to be powered up for a while before it will work. Therefore you'll have a few minutes to destroy the escapees before the stargate is completely powered up. Don't bother to attack the stargate itself ? if you destroy it they'll just warp away, and then who knows when we'll have another chance to catch them.

Oh, and bring me the head of their leader. I will present that to our people as a reminder of what happens to those who double-cross the Blood Raiders.

This is an important mission, which will have significant impact on your faction standings."

story: Charit urmărește niște Blood Raiders renegați care au fugit cu o clonă.
Charit is hunting renegade Blood Raiders who ran off with a clone.

goal: Recuperezi Dalitat Dakpor's Clone (5 m³) din epavă.
Recover Dalitat Dakpor's Clone (5 m³) from the wreck.
reward: Mega Afocal Pulse Maser I, plus 2 mil. ISK bonus în 3 ore.
Mega Afocal Pulse Maser I, plus a 2M ISK bonus within 3 hours.
tip: Pierzi standing pentru fiecare Blood Raider omorât.
You lose standing for every Blood Raider you kill.
steps: Zbori la epavă și iei clona. Primul val apare, dar îl poți ignora.
Fly to the wreck and take the clone. The first wave spawns, but you can ignore it.
Nu te apropia prea mult de Pagera Manton: dacă îl ataci, vine un val masiv.
Do not get too close to the Pagera Manton: attacking it brings a massive wave.
Unii inamici folosesc neut.
Some enemies use energy neutralizers.
m.brief:
I need someone to help me retrieve one of my clones. He's stuck near the Pagera Manton, his ship pretty much destroyed by Kalorr's gang when it accidentally ventured too close to the Pagera. We must act quickly, before Kalorr decides to make a meal out of the guy. 

I will give you a bookmark to the Pagera. But whatever you do, don't venture too close to the holy site. Kalorr will not look too kindly upon that, and I have a feeling he's not in the best of moods ... not ever.

goal: Te ocupi de High Priest Heftah Nekmar, într-o fortăreață Amarr.
Take care of High Priest Heftah Nekmar in an Amarr fortress.
reward: Social Adaptation Chip - Improved și Eifyr and Co. 'Alchemist' Neurotoxin Control NC-903 ca bonus în 3 ore.
Social Adaptation Chip - Improved and Eifyr and Co. 'Alchemist' Neurotoxin Control NC-903 as a bonus within 3 hours.
steps: În primul buzunar, valurile vin când omori Amarr Wingman. Poarta se deschide după ce mor toți.
In the first pocket, waves come when you kill the Amarr Wingman. The gate opens once all are dead.
În al doilea, totul e la 40 km. Trebuie să distrugi Amarr Battlestation, cu 800.000 EHP.
In the second, everything is 40 km out. You must destroy the Amarr Battlestation, with 800,000 EHP.
Inamicii au point, web, tracking disruptor și neut. Întăriri vin la fiecare treime de scut.
The enemies have point, web, tracking disruptors and neuts. Reinforcements arrive at each third of shield.
m.brief: I believe it's time to turn our eyes towards the defilers, led by the vile High Priest Heftah Nekmar. He's been a problem for years, and now he has the audacity to venture into our territory to attack our beliefs! He must be punished! An example must be set! And you shall be the deliverer of our wrath.

story: Clona lui Dalitat a rămas într-o epavă, iar un mare preot Amarr îi stă în cale.
Dalitat's clone is stuck in a wreck, and an Amarr high priest stands in the way.

goal: Mergi la închisoare și recuperezi prizonierii.
Go to the prison and recover the prisoners.
reward: Standard Frentix Booster Reaction Formula, plus 5,5 mil. ISK bonus în 3 ore.
Standard Frentix Booster Reaction Formula, plus a 5.5M ISK bonus within 3 hours.
steps: Misiunea se bifează imediat ce ajungi. Nu trebuie să iei nimic.
The mission completes as soon as you warp in. You do not need to loot anything.
Inamicii și containerul sunt la circa 20 km. Containerul are 500 de prizonieri, dacă îi vrei.
The enemies and the can are about 20 km out. The can holds 500 prisoners if you want them.
m.brief:
I have just the job for someone like you. My underlings have rounded up hundreds of those pesky gas harvesters who keep flooding into OK-FEM. I want them all moved here to Blood Reach, where they'll be used for various purposes *sly grin*.

I'll upload a bookmark to where my men are holding them, just retrieve them from the prison and bring them to me.

goal: Îl găsești și îl distrugi pe Nevar Took.
Find and destroy Nevar Took.
reward: Faint Scoped Warp Disruptor, plus 10,5 mil. ISK bonus în 3 ore.
Faint Scoped Warp Disruptor, plus a 10.5M ISK bonus within 3 hours.
tip: Nevar lasă Imperial Navy Explosive Coating și Zainou 'Gnome' Weapon Upgrades WU-1003.
Nevar drops an Imperial Navy Explosive Coating and Zainou 'Gnome' Weapon Upgrades WU-1003.
steps: Inamicii vin în mai multe valuri, cu mercenari și nave Amarr.
Enemies come in several waves, with mercenaries and Amarr ships.
Divine Imperial Imran și Sixtus te blochează, iar alții te încetinesc cu web.
The Divine Imperial Imran and Sixtus point you, and others web you.
m.brief:
Nevar's gang needs to be taken care of. It's comprised of mercenaries and militia under the command of the mercenary general Nevar Took, and they've been hounding us ever since we raided one of the harvester colonies under their protection. I want as many of them dead as possible, especially the leader. They probably won't recover from a blow like that.

I want you to venture to one of their hideouts which we've discovered. Hopefully you'll find Nevar there, if not then simply dispatch as many of them as possible.

story: Neyan vrea înapoi prizonierii luați de mercenari, iar pe liderul lor, mort.
Neyan wants the prisoners taken by mercenaries back, and their leader dead.

goal: Aduci 20 VIPs (60 m³).
Bring 20 VIPs (60 m³).
reward: Gas Cloud Harvester I, plus 5 mil. ISK bonus în 3 ore.
Gas Cloud Harvester I, plus a 5M ISK bonus within 3 hours.
tip: În 2023 s-a raportat că poarta de accelerare lipsește și misiunea nu se poate termina. Verifică înainte.
In 2023 the acceleration gate was reported missing, making the mission impossible. Check first.
steps: În primele două camere lupți cu drone. Fregatele te blochează și te încetinesc.
In the first two rooms you fight drones. The frigates scram and web you.
În a treia cameră, Khanid Kazmaar lasă un container cu VIP-urile.
In the third room, the Khanid Kazmaar drops a container with the VIPs.
m.brief:
Those blasted migrants are causing trouble again. Because of the abundance of gas clouds in OK-FEM, our space is just crawling with them. As a matter of fact, a large group of Khanid harvesters built an outpost right next to my hideout in M0O-JG! I spent years building that place, and now they want to keep me out of my own home. I can't even go back without being shot at. It's just not right I tell you.

What I need you to do is find their outpost and blow it to bits. That should nudge them away, but it's not going to be easy. They locked and booby-trapped the acceleration gate leading into the deadspace pocket containing their base, so we have to find the key somehow. I know where they normally work, which is near a collection of massive gas clouds which they tend to harvest. I want you to ambush them there, and bring back captives for interrogation.

Objective: Find your way to the Khanid outpost inside the gas fields, and destroy the ship carrying their highest ranking personnel. Bring back the VIPs to your agent for interrogation.

goal: Aduci 30 Civilians (150 m³).
Bring 30 Civilians (150 m³).
reward: Large I-a Enduring Armor Repairer, plus 10 mil. ISK bonus în 3 ore.
Large I-a Enduring Armor Repairer, plus a 10M ISK bonus within 3 hours.
steps: Omori navele Khanid și iei civilii.
Kill the Khanid ships and take the civilians.
m.brief:
The interrogation is going well. They coughed up the access codes to the acceleration gate immediately. They look like frightened animals in fact, so entertaining. We'll have such fun together...

But now to more important matters. I will upload the access codes into your ship's mainframe, that should allow you to use the acceleration gate without problems. Once you have the bookmark, I expect you to warp out there and obliterate that base. And bring any stragglers to me, I so enjoy those sacrificial rituals.

This is an important mission, which will have significant impact on your faction standings.

Objective: Destroy the Khanid Innovation Depot and then report back to Pondah Shanjih at Blood Reach.

story: Oaspeți nepoftiți: drone rogue și Khanid au luat ostatici VIP și civili.
Unwelcome guests: rogue drones and the Khanid have taken VIPs and civilians hostage.

goal: Distrugi grupul de cercetași Amarr de lângă câmpul de asteroizi din YAW-7M.
Destroy the Amarr scouting party near the asteroid field in YAW-7M.
reward: Standard Frentix Booster Reaction Formula, plus 5 mil. ISK bonus în 3 ore.
Standard Frentix Booster Reaction Formula, plus a 5M ISK bonus within 3 hours.
steps: YAW-7M e nullsec (-0,8).
YAW-7M is nullsec (-0.8).
Omori cercetașii Amarr. Uneori urmează direct a doua parte, cu mai multe valuri.
Kill the Amarr scouts. Sometimes the second part follows directly, with more waves.
m.brief:
I've been looking for someone of your talents. It has come to our attention that an armada of Amarr crusaders has arrived in OK-FEM. According to our sources, their primary objective is to destroy the Pagera Manton, which they view as being a sacrilegious icon of the Blood Raider faith. They believe the Blood Raider organization is defiling the graveyard of their ancestors, and their aim is to 'give them rest'.

These sorts of incursions are nothing new, but this time they mean business. I've never seen such a huge armada threaten our beloved holy site, and to top it off it's being led by one of the Amarrian High Priests, Heftah Nekmar, which is of some concern to us. He has recently led a campaign of propaganda against the Blood Raider religion from inside the Amarrian territories, and the destruction of the Pagera Manton would certainly be viewed as a mighty victory by his people.

Your job is to intercept a squadron of ships that have split off from the main armada. It's probably a scouting party, and they've ventured awfully close to the Pagera's resting place. You will be supplied with a bookmark, of course.

goal: Aduci agentului 20 Amber Cytoserocin (200 m³) și primești un blueprint de booster.
Bring the agent 20 Amber Cytoserocin (200 m³) and get a booster blueprint.
reward: Standard Blue Pill Booster BPC (10 rulări, ME 5, TE 2) și standing la Guristas Pirates.
Standard Blue Pill Booster BPC (10 runs, ME 5, TE 2) and Guristas Pirates standing.
tip: Aceeași misiune există la Fetosa Kanim, Ocho Shusiian, Ozomi Obanen și Vena Saapialen. O poți face o dată la fiecare.
The same mission exists at Fetosa Kanim, Ocho Shusiian, Ozomi Obanen and Vena Saapialen. You can do it once with each.
steps: Cumperi gazul din piață sau îl minezi chiar tu în zonă, cu o Venture sau o Prospect și probe Core.
Buy the gas on the market or harvest it yourself nearby with a Venture or Prospect and Core probes.
Agentul e în nullsec, așa că pentru transport e bun un Blockade Runner sau o Prospect.
The agent is in nullsec, so a Blockade Runner or a Prospect is a good choice for hauling.
Predai gazul din fereastra misiunii.
Hand in the gas from the mission window.

We have recently decided to extend this benefit to mercenaries or freelancers employed by us that have shown admirable bravery and skill in the field, or earned the right through countless hours of dedicated service to our corporations.

As you undoubtedly already know I have been assigned the task of allocating these ships to their deserved owners. After looking at your record, we decided that you, , are worthy of such an honor. There is just one catch, since you aren't an official member we need something in exchange for this gift. Cough up 1 x Caldari Navy Squad Leader Insignia and the Worm Blueprint is yours.

m.brief:

Get something for Gue Mouey that will convince him to give you the information Isana wants.

story: Rakka a pierdut tot și vrea răzbunare pe cei care l-au trădat.
Rakka has lost everything and wants revenge on those who betrayed them.

goal: Aduci Tantima Areki (5 m³).
Bring Tantima Areki (5 m³).
reward: 10 mil. ISK, plus 5 mil. ISK bonus.
10M ISK, plus a 5M ISK bonus.
steps: Ia un probe launcher cu tine, îți va trebui mai târziu în lanț.
Bring a probe launcher, you will need it later in the chain.
Predai itemul agentului.
Hand the item to the agent.
m.brief:
You heard right, . We've been plagued by Caldari agents trying to infiltrate our operations here in E-8CSQ. One such agent, Tantima Areki, managed to fool us for weeks, pretending to be a Guristas loyalist. When we finally discovered his true identity, he fled to somewhere within O-LR1H. We haven't found him yet, but I'm hoping you will succeed where my lackeys failed. Bring me Tantima Areki, preferably alive, and I will reward you well.

Use a system scanner and look for deadspace signatures. He will most likely be orbiting a Caldari Tactical Outpost.

goal: Aduci Hakiro's Scanner Data.
Bring Hakiro's Scanner Data.
reward: Guristas War Plans, plus 350mm Carbide Railgun I bonus.
Guristas War Plans, plus a 350mm Carbide Railgun I bonus.
tip: Planurile le duci apoi lui Knaaninn Aranuri în G5ED-Y.
You then take the plans to Knaaninn Aranuri in G5ED-Y.
steps: Datele le obții de la Tomi Hakiro.
You get the data from Tomi Hakiro.
Le predai lui Airkio.
Hand them to Airkio.
m.brief: The Caldari have erected a base of operations close to the stargate we use in G5ED-Y. Not only that but they are closely monitoring our movements from a static long range scanner. They use this information to send in reinforcements to the Caldari Navy positions before we attack, among other things. I'm tempted to launch a major assault against their outpost, but perhaps you can spare me the manpower by doing the job yourself. You will be adequately rewarded of course.

m.brief: As a matter of fact, I could use a hand in finding out what has actually become of Black Jack. A colleague of mine in UL-4ZW, Gue Mouey, might know something. He's one of the overseers of the Syndicate Trade Hub in that system, you'll find it near UL-4ZW IX. He has had extensive dealings with agents of the Guristas and Caldari Navy, if anyone is qualified to scrounge up information on what happened to Black Jack, it's him.

goal: Recuperezi Tikui's Message.
Recover Tikui's Message.
reward: Zainou 'Deadeye' Missile Bombardment MB-705, plus 8 mil. ISK bonus.
Zainou 'Deadeye' Missile Bombardment MB-705, plus an 8M ISK bonus.
steps: Camera 1 se poate sări, poarta nu e blocată.

Poarta din camera 2 se deschide doar după ce omori tot.
