În camera 3 mesajul e într-un container. Fregatele elite te încetinesc cu web.
In room 3 the message is in a can. The elite frigates web you.

goal: Distrugi Kois City Civilian Quarter din E-8CSQ și recuperezi datele expediției.
Destroy the Kois City Civilian Quarter in E-8CSQ and recover the expedition data.
reward: Memory Augmentation - Improved și Fourier Compact Tracking Enhancer.
Memory Augmentation - Improved and a Fourier Compact Tracking Enhancer.
steps: Zbori în E-8CSQ, la locația din misiune.
Fly to E-8CSQ, to the mission location.
Distrugi structura de depozitare și iei datele.
Destroy the storage facility and take the data.
m.brief:
I think it's time for you to know the objective of my mission here in E-8CSQ. We were to infiltrate Kois City, the central administrative complex in G5ED-Y, from where the Caldari send all of their expeditions, and answer the question that has been nagging my superiors back home, "Why are they here?".

Now getting into Kois City will be no easy task. It's heavily fortified. But on the bright side I think I know exactly what we're looking for. My sources tell me that the expeditionary forces store most of the data they have collected in a computer within the city's science labs. Backup data is also stored in data chips within their storage facility in the civilian sector of the city. Therefore your task is to somehow get into the civilian quarter and acquire at least one of those data chips. From this data we will hopefully be able to piece together their objective, and find out if it's worth our time to get involved.

This used to be Black Jack's task, but I assume he discovered something that convinced him to cut ties with us and go solo. But I will tell you this, it is in your best interest to complete this task at any cost. Should you fail, or decide to 'keep' the data for yourself, the Syndicate will hunt you down like a dog and force you to watch your own family executed in the cruelest of ways.

story: Isana face afaceri pe ascuns cu Guristas și are nevoie de un curier de încredere.
Isana does secret business with the Guristas and needs a trusted courier.

m.t: Serpentis Gansters - Enemies of the Federation (1 of 3)

Bring 20 Serpentis Gold Tags (2 m³) to IGE-RI.

1M ISK, plus a 0.5M ISK bonus within 5 hours.

The tags drop from Serpentis ships or you buy them on the market.
IGE-RI e în lowsec, zbori atent.
IGE-RI is in lowsec, fly carefully.
m.brief: I'm so glad to have a friend of the Federation around here, . Now if you can only eliminate some of those pesky Serpentis fighters in the area, I'll pay you a lot of ISK. Bring me some of their Gold tags as proof of the deed.

m.t: Serpentis Gansters - Clear The Way (2 of 3)

Bring 20 Serpentis Diamond Tags (2 m³) to IGE-RI.
reward: Memory Augmentation - Basic, plus 3 mil. ISK bonus în 5 ore.
Memory Augmentation - Basic, plus a 3M ISK bonus within 5 hours.

The tags drop from larger Serpentis ships or you buy them on the market.
Le predai în IGE-RI.
Hand them in at IGE-RI.
m.brief: Since your valiant efforts to aid our cause still hasn't provided us with the results we need, I'd like you to try something a little harder. Some of the Serpentis top-tier battleship captains carry a Diamond embedded tag to display their status within the Serpentis fleet. Bring me these tags as proof of their demise, and I'll reward you well. That should put a serious dent in their forces.

m.t: Serpentis Gansters - The Serpentis Officer (3 of 3)
goal: Aduci Brynn Jerdola's Tag (0,1 m³) în IGE-RI.
Bring Brynn Jerdola's Tag (0.1 m³) to IGE-RI.
reward: Social Adaptation Chip - Standard, plus Neural Boost - Standard bonus în 5 ore.
Social Adaptation Chip - Standard, plus a Neural Boost - Standard bonus within 5 hours.
tip: Ultima misiune din lanț, cu impact mare pe standing. Agentul îți mai oferă ceva după, dar nu mai are misiuni.
Last mission of the chain, with a big standing impact. The agent offers more afterwards, but has no further missions.
steps: Tag-ul cade de la ofițerul Serpentis Brynn Jerdola sau îl cumperi din piață.
The tag drops from the Serpentis officer Brynn Jerdola or you buy it on the market.
Îl predai în IGE-RI.
Hand it in at IGE-RI.
m.brief: Before we leave back to Federation space, I want a certain Serpentis officer killed. Her name is Brynn Jerdola, and she roams the asteroid belts of Fountain, searching for unwary prey to murder in cold blood. She, of all the Serpentis I've encountered, has caused my men the most grief. We've lost over a dozen miners to her battleship, and the last encounter I had with her I barely escaped with my life. Bring proof of her death and I will reward you greatly. Then at least I can return home with the satisfaction of having caused the death of my greatest enemy.

story: Barou vânează bandele Serpentis și plătește pentru dovezi.
Barou hunts Serpentis gangs and pays for proof.

goal: Distrugi nava-închisoare CTF și eliberezi prizonierul.
Destroy the CTF prison ship and free the prisoner.
reward: Gas Cloud Harvester I, plus 5,5 mil. ISK bonus în 5 ore.
Gas Cloud Harvester I, plus a 5.5M ISK bonus within 5 hours.
steps: Site-ul are restricții de mărime a navei.
The site has ship size restrictions.
Navele CTF sunt nave Gallente redenumite, așa că tipurile de damage din misiune pot fi greșite.
The CTF ships are renamed Gallente ships, so the damage types in the mission may be wrong.
Misiunea e gata când nava-închisoare moare. Prizonierul cade într-un container.
The mission completes when the prison ship dies. The prisoner drops in a can.
m.brief: One of our labs a few systems out is under a DED blockade, and all our "material" there is being confiscated. Our guards are being hit with serious firepower even as we speak. Now, most of our mobile research facilities are expendable, but this one is a bit special. Get in there and retrieve the imprisoned chemist, Achove Oullen.

goal: Distrugi șantierele și depozitele CTF din A8-XBW.
Destroy the CTF shipyards and supply facilities in A8-XBW.
reward: J5b Enduring Warp Scrambler, plus 10,6 mil. ISK bonus în 5 ore.
J5b Enduring Warp Scrambler, plus a 10.6M ISK bonus within 5 hours.
tip: Un pilot a raportat că misiunea nu s-a marcat ca terminată. Dacă nu mai apare nimic după ce cureți tot, întreabă agentul.
A pilot reported the mission did not flag as complete. If nothing else spawns after you clear everything, check with the agent.
steps: A8-XBW e în lowsec. Site-ul are restricții de mărime a navei.
A8-XBW is in lowsec. The site has ship size restrictions.
Camera 1 se poate sări, poarta nu e blocată.
Room 1 can be skipped, the gate is not locked.
În camera 2 distrugi structurile și tot ce te atacă.
In room 2 destroy the structures and anything that attacks you.
m.brief:
While on a routine courier job, one of my pilots recently ran into CTF forces that nearly destroyed his ship. Fortunately, his systems were intact enough that he could track their heading. Our covert ops ships later scanned the area and eventually discovered what is likely a DED communications and supply station. 

I want you to scope out the location, and if you find any hint of a CTF depot there, I want you to conduct a surgical strike on them before they know what's happening. If you come across any shipyards or supply facilities, I want them blown to pieces so they can't fuel and repair their ships, and if anyone stands in your way, hull their ships. Show no mercy.

story: Bley vrea scoasă din joc o operațiune CTF care vânează oamenii Serpentis.
Bley wants a CTF operation hunting Serpentis people shut down.

goal: Duci cipul la locația din A8-XBW.
Take the chip to the location in A8-XBW.
reward: Neurotoxin Control, plus 5,6 mil. ISK bonus în 5 ore.
Neurotoxin Control, plus a 5.6M ISK bonus within 5 hours.
steps: A8-XBW e în lowsec. Site-ul are trei camere cu rogue drones.
A8-XBW is in lowsec. The site has three rooms with rogue drones.
Misiunea se marchează gata când ajungi destul de aproape de țintă în camera 3.
The mission flags as complete once you get close enough to the target in room 3.
m.brief:
For quite some time now, we have been aware of a COSMOS leak within our organization. Federal operatives have always been willing to pay a lot of money for inside information, and it has become abundantly clear to us in recent days that one of our commanders has fallen prey to the temptation of working for both sides.

We have no proof as to who the leak might be, but recently some of our people retrieved an encoded computer chip from the wreckage of a scout outpost. The chip contained documents which we think provide clues to the mole's identity. The chip is slightly damaged, so some parts are unencrypted and other parts missing entirely.

I want you to take the chip and bring it to our best code decryptor. He currently resides deep within the A8-XBW system, and you might have to go through some rogue drones to reach him there. Don't annoy him too much: He values his privacy and doesn't like being disturbed. There is a data terminal at his docking bay, so dock there and then bring me back the news.

goal: Omori comandantul din A8-XBW.
Kill the commander in A8-XBW.
reward: 350mm 'Scout' Accelerator Cannon, plus 10,6 mil. ISK bonus în 5 ore.
350mm 'Scout' Accelerator Cannon, plus a 10.6M ISK bonus within 5 hours.
steps: Primul val apare la sosire. Când îl omori, vine al doilea.
The first wave is there on arrival. When you kill it, the second wave comes.
Misiunea e gata după al doilea val.
The mission completes after the second wave.
m.brief:
Our decryption expert just got back to us with the results. Fortunately, the chip was not too damaged. We have some very trustworthy indications that the snitch is a well known commander within the organization. It came as quite a surprise to me personally that he would start playing for the other team, though in retrospect it does make sense that only someone in his position would have been able to feed the enemy the information they've apparently been receiving. 

The commander is on vacation right now at his residence and doesn't go on active duty for three days, so now is the time to strike. His residence is in the A8-XBW system. Gear up and fly there as fast as you can. Make the bastard suffer for betraying us ― let's hope it will be sufficient warning for others not to do the same. 

Return to me when you have completed your task.

story: Cliene are o problemă de rezolvat în A8-XBW, întâi cu niște drone, apoi cu un comandant.
Cliene has a problem to solve in A8-XBW, first with some drones, then with a commander.

goal: Omori toți inamicii.
Kill all enemies.
reward: Limited Electron Blaster Cannon I, plus 8,6 mil. ISK bonus în 5 ore.
Limited Electron Blaster Cannon I, plus an 8.6M ISK bonus within 5 hours.
steps: O singură cameră. Site-ul are restricții de mărime a navei.
A single room. The site has ship size restrictions.
m.brief: "We have a big problem, and very little time to deal with it, . Four days ago, two of our squadrons conducted a strike on a small outpost not far from here, not realizing the place was a key tactical and scientific asset belonging to the Federation. In retaliation, Fed Navy HICOM has issued three platoons of combat ships to attack the Fountain region. According to our intel, they will be striking several vital targets of ours in the next twenty-four-hour period. Rumor has it the order came from President Roden himself, so we can expect them to bring big guns and larger numbers. Losing these outposts is something we cannot afford, so we have to move swiftly and meet them head-on before they do their damage. Two teams have already been sent to intercept the first two squads. I want you to handle the third. We believe that they are currently residing at 4-EP12. Get over there and send them back to Yulai."

goal: Oprești asediul, salvezi omul de știință și omori toți inamicii.
End the siege, save the scientist and kill all enemies.
reward: Social Adaptation Chip - Improved și Gas Cloud Harvester I bonus în 5 ore.
Social Adaptation Chip - Improved and a Gas Cloud Harvester I bonus within 5 hours.
steps: Două camere. Site-ul are restricții de mărime a navei.
Two rooms. The site has ship size restrictions.
Comandantul din camera 2 poate lăsa Federation Navy Fleet Commander Insignia și module Federation Navy.
The commander in room 2 can drop a Federation Navy Fleet Commander Insignia and Federation Navy modules.
m.brief: "Something even bigger has come up, and I'm putting my best pilot, you, on the job. We've just learned that the group of Fed ships you took out wasn't just there for retaliation. It appears that through an informant within our ranks, the Federation have caught wind of our next-gen booster project. The platoons in question were reportedly dispatched for one purpose: to locate and terminate our star scientist, the one who masterminded the project and who currently holds the prototype formulas. The Federate officers you took care of were getting awfully close to him and managed to relay their information back to Fed Central before you took them out, so now we have an even larger Fed group attacking our primary research facilities in 4-EP12. The facility itself is not as important as the scientist himself, and the plans he holds. Should these designs fall into the wrong hands, years of research will be lost and those responsible, myself included, would probably find ourselves swiftly exiled from existence. Load up your guns and put an end to this siege. Save our scientist, and return to me when your task is complete. This is an important mission, which will have significant impact on your faction standings."

story: Un om de știință Serpentis e asediat de Federație și Jarvas vrea să-l scoți de acolo.
A Serpentis scientist is besieged by the Federation and Jarvas wants them out.

goal: Aduci o mostră de 300 Veldspar (30 m³) din site.
Bring a sample of 300 Veldspar (30 m³) from the site.
reward: Gas Cloud Harvester I, plus 5,1 mil. ISK bonus în 5 ore.
Gas Cloud Harvester I, plus a 5.1M ISK bonus within 5 hours.
steps: Ia un mining laser. Site-ul are restricții de mărime a navei.
Bring a mining laser. The site has ship size restrictions.
Un singur ciclu, chiar parțial, e de ajuns ca misiunea să se marcheze gata.
One cycle, even a partial one, is enough for the mission to flag as complete.
Nu e nevoie de luptă, dar pot apărea inamici.
No combat is needed, but enemies can spawn.
m.brief:
Welcome to Yakura Harvesting Depot, . I have use for someone like you. You see, I'm not the typical Serpentis member, in fact I never took up the stereotypical practice of piracy. Instead I've devoted my life to creating a business which specializes in harvesting gas and rock from the Pegasus constellation. I still work for the Serpentis of course, but I've more interest in finding lucrative roid and gas fields than bullying the passersby.

Anyway, I have a small job for you. Our scanners have indicated that there is a large quantity of gas clouds in a certain area in YZS5-4. We think the source is pretty close to a certain asteroid belt, which has been claimed by an Astral Mining Inc. expedition. I want you to warp over to this asteroid belt and take a sample from one of the asteroids there, bring it back to me for inspection. We're hoping to find gas residue on the rock which would indicate the presence of gas clouds nearby.

goal: Alungi expediția Astral Mining Inc. din site.
Drive the Astral Mining Inc. expedition out of the site.
reward: P-S Compact Remote Tracking Computer, plus 10,3 mil. ISK bonus în 5 ore.
P-S Compact Remote Tracking Computer, plus a 10.3M ISK bonus within 5 hours.
steps: O singură cameră cu mineri și escortă Gallente.
A single room with miners and a Gallente escort.
Site-ul are restricții de mărime a navei.
The site has ship size restrictions.
m.brief:
The results of our tests indicate that vast swaths of gas clouds should be located not far from where you retrieved the sample. Since we expect the profits of harvesting these clouds to be extremely profitable, we're willing to risk a possible confrontation with Astral Mining Inc.

But first I want you to take care of their current expedition in the area. I want you to go back to where you found the sample and wait for the expedition to arrive. Destroy as many of their ships as you can, but it's imperative that you at least take out their commanding officers. That should cripple them long enough for us to move in and set up our defense perimeter before any reinforcements arrive. This is an important mission, which will have significant impact on your faction standings.

story: Kaymotin vrea să afle ce e în norul de gaz și apoi să scape de concurență.
Kaymotin wants to know what is in the gas cloud and then get rid of the competition.

goal: Omori inamicii din A8-XBW.
Kill the enemies in A8-XBW.
reward: Gas Cloud Harvester I, plus 5,2 mil. ISK bonus în 5 ore.
Gas Cloud Harvester I, plus a 5.2M ISK bonus within 5 hours.
steps: A8-XBW e în lowsec. Site-ul are restricții de mărime a navei.
A8-XBW is in lowsec. The site has ship size restrictions.
Inamicii folosesc web și sensor dampener.
The enemies use webs and sensor dampeners.
m.brief: Precisely one week from today, the Gallente Gaming Commission will have another Legends Trial tournament. The famed contestant, Kuroki Tselmi, will be going up against his long-time rival, Hadni Riiuto. Now, everybody loves to see two fighters face each other when they also have a personal dislike for each other. It makes the entire fight that much more intense. Of course, given the nature of mankind, everybody and their pet has placed some money on the outcome of this fight. Acquaintances of mine also placed money on this fight and we are all hoping that Kuroki Tselmi will win. He usually does, but it probably won't hurt if we try to give fate a little nudge, here. This is where you come in. I need you to go to Riiuto's agent. When you meet him, have a word with him about this whole business. He'll know what to do next, and we'll all be able to sleep a little easier at night knowing important people won't lose a lot of money on the match. Now, I have spoken to Riiuto's agent and he sounds fine with it, but keep your wits about you; don't go thinking this is going to be a walk in the bio-dome. This needs to go precisely as planned with no screw-ups, otherwise the Betting Commission will be on top of this like a Gallente escort, and they'll ride this thing for all it's worth if they find out.. I suggest you bring some friends to make sure the agent doesn't feel like telling anyone about this. What do you say, do we have a deal?

goal: Distrugi țintele din M-PGT0.
Destroy the targets in M-PGT0.
reward: 500MN Y-T8 Compact Microwarpdrive, plus 10,4 mil. ISK bonus în 5 ore.
500MN Y-T8 Compact Microwarpdrive, plus a 10.4M ISK bonus within 5 hours.
steps: M-PGT0 e în lowsec. Site-ul are restricții de mărime a navei.
M-PGT0 is in lowsec. The site has ship size restrictions.
Inamicii, de la Gallente Gaming Commission, folosesc web și sensor dampener.
The enemies, from the Gallente Gaming Commission, use webs and sensor dampeners.
m.brief:
As it turns out, you did your job a little too well. We seem to have scared Riiuto into seeking protection from the Gaming Commission. Perhaps we should have stuck to bribery. Oh well, we'll remember that for next time. We still need Tselmi to win this match against Riiuto and one way of accomplishing that is having Riiuto pull out of the match prematurely due to “unforeseen circumstances,” or whatever the Commission will choose to call it when you blow him out of the sky.

Because of our previous attempt of nudging fate into the right and profitable direction for my friends, our boy Riiuto is a little more concerned about his safety. He is flying with a heavy escort, but luckily for you I have a plan that cannot fail if you follow the instructions to the letter. It's not that complicated; just go to the location and hide behind an asteroid. After some time you'll see Riiuto and his escort meet up with a fuel tanker to refuel their ships. This will be the time to come out of hiding and attack them. If you attack before this moment, Riiuto and his escort will know something is up.

I trust you will perform as well as you did before. Don't let me down now, because I took the liberty of placing a little more money on this, using another friend of mine. If you're good to me, I might add you to the payroll during the next Legends Trial, or get you better seats if you want to play it safe. You do want to Tselmi to win, right? I mean, you're a sports fan, right?

story: Wessette are nevoie de câteva ținte Gallente eliminate.
Wessette needs a few Gallente targets removed.
